tags.description: Controls the one-shot START take (opening take attempt at order start). 1: a custom START candidate is dropped if a start take was already tried. 2: the strategy itself fires a start take on the configured start venue (start_mode_venue) once, and repeated START work orders are allowed. Values <2 close repeat START work orders as invalid.

allowedValues.meaning: skip START custom candidate if already tried
strategy issues start take on start_mode_venue once

example.explanation: Fire one immediate take on the start venue when the order begins.

interactions.title: Mode 2 needs a valid start venue
interactions.explanation: With 196=2 the take is sent only if start_mode_venue() is a valid, usable venue.

tags.name: Ladder parameters
tags.description: Converts the order into a price-triggered compound ('ladder'): pairs of price,value. The first price is the base; each further price must be monotonically better (lower for buys, higher for sells) and its value replaces tag 9 (or 6, or 7, whichever the order uses) for the leg triggered at that price. All other 9012 tags are copied into each leg; the engine builds a 'C,4,...' compound config.

example.explanation: Buy: rate 5 at 10.00, 10 below 9.90, 20 below 9.80.

interactions.title: Ladder converts order to compound
interactions.explanation: convertLadder builds a compound config (mode 4, price trigger) with one leg per price level, using the original algorithm.

interactions.title: Invalid ladder rejects
interactions.explanation: Odd number of fields or fewer than 2 gives 'LADDER parameters invalid'; non-monotonic prices give 'LADDER prices not monotonically better' (_err_msg).

interactions.title: Ladder values replace tag 9/6/7
interactions.explanation: Each ladder value is written as tag 9 if present, else 6, else 7; those tags are excluded from the copied tag set.

tags.name: Compound price mode
tags.description: Mode passed to quote.lastPrice(side, mode) when compound/relay logic evaluates the current price against price triggers (compound trackers and RelayScheduler). Exact mode meanings are defined in the quote implementation, not visible here.

example.explanation: Use alternate reference price mode for compound price triggers.

tags.name: PT flag
tags.description: Free string stored as pt_flag. No reader of pt_flag() was found in the engine source, so its purpose cannot be determined (name suggests a program-trade flag).

example.explanation: Stored only.

tags.name: Use EQTE post-loud venue
tags.description: When >0, the order may use the EQTE-POST-LOUD venue. If that venue is not configured or is shut off for the order, the flag is reset to 0 at portfolio issue.

example.explanation: Allow posting to EQTE.

interactions.title: Disabled if EQTE unavailable
interactions.explanation: If exchange EQTE-POST-LOUD is missing or shut off, use_eqte is set to 0.

tags.name: Use DQTE (closing quote venue) mode
tags.description: Selects use of the DQTE closing-quote venue. 1: use DQTE as the MOC (CLOSE aggression). 2: extra dquote (QMOC) candidates from the scheduler, MOC not converted. >=3: DQTE used as extra candidate with size from the OPE imbalance feed, not the scheduler; regular MOC candidates are blocked and doClose is set to 0. For >=3 the 2nd/3rd fields give the QMOC match rate and imbalance rate in percent. If no DQTE venue exists the mode is reset to 0.

allowedValues.meaning: OPE smart close via DQTE (7 has extra special handling)

tags.default: 0; crate default qclose_crate+20*aggression, irate default qclose_irate+30*aggression (clamped 0-100)

example.explanation: Smart close on DQTE: 20% of matched, 10% of imbalance.

interactions.title: Mode>=3 disables regular close
interactions.explanation: doClose set to 0 and MOC/MOC368 candidates are not processable (OPE smart close takes over).

interactions.title: No DQTE venue resets mode
interactions.explanation: If no DQTE exchange is found, use_dqte is reset to 0 (and doClose may be set to 0 for scheduled/IIS orders starting after pre-close end).

tags.name: Dual-listing trade/take mode
tags.description: For stocks with a dual listing, enables trading on the dual-listed line. Field 1 (dual_trade): >0 adds dual-code venues and dual ADV to the routing/post-loud decision; >1 also uses dual quotes. Field 2 (dual_take) controls takes: on dual venues takes are blocked if 1 or 2; on home venues takes are blocked if <=0, or allowed only on venues with a dual-code set if 1. Ignored when the stock has no dual listing.
tags.default: dual_trade 0; dual_take from OEO config dual_take(stock)

example.explanation: Use dual venues for posting; no takes on home venues per code.

interactions.title: Ignored without dual listing
interactions.explanation: Parsed only if the stock has a dual stock; otherwise dual_trade is forced to 0.

interactions.title: Dual venues need dual ADV ratio
interactions.explanation: Dual venues are added to tradeable list only if dualAdvRatio > config dual_adv_rmin.

tags.name: Flag-list (set alias tags to 1)
tags.description: Comma-separated list of non-numeric tag names (aliases); each one is set to '1' in the 9012 tag map, i.e. a shorthand for switching on several boolean alias tags at once. Numeric entries are ignored.

example.explanation: Equivalent to RLMOO=1^LOOO=1.

interactions.title: Sets listed alias tags to 1
interactions.explanation: Each non-numeric entry is put into _tag9012map with value 1, which can override or feed rules that check those aliases.

tags.name: Static dark limit
tags.description: Double stored as static_dark_limit. No reader of static_dark_limit() was found in the source, so it appears to have no effect.

example.explanation: Stored only.

tags.name: PM open rate
tags.description: Double stored as pmopen_rate (presumably afternoon/PM open auction participation rate). No reader of pmopen_rate() was found in the source.
tags.default: 0 in code; ai.fixmsg.properties:60 sets 205=100 for SDMA orders when unset

example.explanation: Stored only.

interactions.title: Rule sets 205=100 for SDMA
interactions.explanation: ai.fixmsg.properties:60 defaults 205=100 on SDMA orders; no engine reader found.

tags.name: MOO mode
tags.description: Controls how the open auction (MOO) portion is handled. 1[,t,u]: MOO issued t seconds before the open start and updated every u seconds via OEO (if both >0). 2: MOO handled by OEO/strategy and the order is not marked open-done after MOO candidates. 3[,f]: smart open with rate type defaulting to 1 (or 3 if no indicated open), f = fraction of theoretical open volume. 0: no MOO mode. Forced to 0 when the order does not do the open (doOpen<=0) and returns 0 whenever 217 (moo_rate_type) is set.
tags.default: 0; moo_update_period field 10; ai.fixmsg.properties:96-98 default 3 for PCAP, 2 for VWAP/TMX/PART/NINJA/ICENINJA/LINE/PASS, 1,30,10 for most others

example.explanation: Send MOO 30 s before open, refresh every 10 s.

interactions.title: 217 overrides 206
interactions.explanation: moo_mode() returns 0 whenever moo_rate_type (217) >0, so 206 is ignored.

interactions.title: No effect without open participation
interactions.explanation: setDoOpen forces moo_mode to 0 when doOpen<=0; also 0 when 9014 says not in open or open excluded.

interactions.title: Rule zeros 206 for orders far from open
interactions.explanation: ai.fixmsg.properties:103 sets 206=0 when the order starts more than 2h before the open.

interactions.title: Rule zeros 206 for low-rate SHADOW
interactions.explanation: ai.fixmsg.properties:104 sets 206=0.

interactions.title: Mode 3 implies rate type
interactions.explanation: With mode>=3 and no 217, moo_rate_type() returns 1 (3 if no indicated open), activating smart-open sizing.

tags.name: Would-dark price
tags.description: Would price for dark-only opportunistic (would) orders, same price syntax as tag 10 (IWouldPrice; a leading 'M' means multi-level MultIWouldPrice). If tag 11 (would venue) is not set, 207 implies dark-only would (11=1), or dark+lit (11=3) if tag 10 is also given. Invalid values reject the order.
tags.valueFormat: would price string as in tag 10 (e.g. B-10, M...)

example.explanation: Would-dark when price is 5 bps better than reference (format as tag 10).

interactions.title: 207 implies would venue
interactions.explanation: Without tag 11, would venue becomes 1 (dark only), or 3 (dark+lit) when tag 10 is present.

interactions.title: Bad would-dark price rejects
interactions.explanation: Unparseable value sets _err_msg 'incorrect would dark price tag'.

tags.name: Would-dark percentage
tags.description: Limits how much of the order would-dark can execute. Plain number <=100 is a percent of order; >100 or suffix 'S' is a share count converted to percent of order size (capped 100). Prefix 'C' sets mode 1, 'R' mode 2 (value used as percentage directly, capped 100). Suffix 'S' also makes the would-dark hard size round up to lot.

example.explanation: Would-dark at most 5000 shares.

interactions.title: Meaningful with would-dark
interactions.explanation: Caps sizes of would-dark (e.g. 207) orders.

tags.name: Close-only feature
tags.description: Makes the order trade only in the closing auction. Effective for IIS algorithms when >0, for any algorithm when =9, and always on for MOC algorithms. Then close scheduling/OEO close logic handles the order (non-close candidates suppressed when sched_moc_mode>0). Value 9 has special handling in close sizing.

example.explanation: Execute only in the close auction.

interactions.title: Only 9 works for non-IIS algos
interactions.explanation: close_only_feature() is true for non-IIS, non-MOC algos only when the value is 9.

tags.name: Stop-loss parameters
tags.description: Converts the order into a price-triggered compound for stop-loss: p0,p1[,p2]. The order runs its normal algorithm (limit p0 if >0) until price crosses trigger p1, then switches to the stop-loss algorithm (tag 211, default NINJA^4=1) with limit p2. p2 may be 'A<price>' absolute, 'C<cents>' or 'B<bps>'/number bps offset from p1.

example.explanation: No limit initially; once price crosses 9.50, run the stop-loss algo (211) with a limit 5 cents beyond 9.50 in the order direction.

interactions.title: Stop-loss converts to compound
interactions.explanation: convertStopLoss builds a 'C,4' price-trigger compound; second leg runs tag 211 algo (default NINJA^4=1).

interactions.title: Fewer than 2 fields rejects
interactions.explanation: 'Stop loss parameters invalid'.

interactions.title: SLn aliases used only when 210 absent
interactions.explanation: ai.fixmsg.properties:237-239 copy SL4/SL5/SL6 into tags 4/5/6 for compound children only when 210 is NOT set; with 210 present those aliases are not copied.

tags.name: Stop-loss algorithm
tags.description: Algorithm (with optional sub-tags, ';' converted to '^') used for the stop-loss leg created by tag 210.

example.explanation: After stop triggers, run PART at 20%.

interactions.title: Ignored without 210
interactions.explanation: Only used inside convertStopLoss, which returns early if 210 is absent.

tags.name: Part mode
tags.description: When >0, disables the OPE participation-rate check (checkPartRate) in the candidate regulator for the lag side of a cash/pair order. Also exported as PART_MODE in order info.

example.explanation: Skip lag-side participation rate check.

interactions.title: Only matters with cash lag side
interactions.explanation: checkPartRate only runs when cash_lag_side (130) is 1 or 2 and matches the side.

tags.name: Clean pipe mode
tags.description: Restricts dark venues by their 'clean pipe' attribute. 0: exclude clean-pipe venues; 1: only clean-pipe venues; 3/13: alternate clean/dirty work modes (13 adds timing based on last dark fill); 10/20: clean/dirty switching that turns off mid-point venues in work mode 1; 63: also disables post-loud. Value >0 overrides the default cleanpipe for dark venue selection.

example.explanation: Set by APSHADOW presets (ai.fixmsg.properties:344-346).

interactions.title: 63 disables post loud
interactions.explanation: noPostLoud() returns true when cleanPipe==63 (unless always_post_loud).

interactions.title: APSHADOW presets set 213=2
interactions.explanation: ai.fixmsg.properties:344-346.

tags.name: ICENINJA post all
tags.description: When >0 on an ICENINJA order, the candidate processor posts all (non-NA) candidates rather than iceberg slices.

example.explanation: ICENINJA posts full size.

interactions.title: Only ICENINJA
interactions.explanation: Checked together with algotype()==ICENINJA.

tags.name: Dark passive mode
tags.description: Selects dark venues by their passive attribute: 1 = passive dark venues only; -1 (input 11) = aggressive dark venues; 0 = neutral; 2 = special LC worker handling; 3/5 = dynamic passive switching (with dark_passive_mode), 4 = passive-venue variant; 3 also falls back to neutral when no passive.

example.explanation: Only passive dark pools.

interactions.title: APSHADOW presets set 215
interactions.explanation: ai.fixmsg.properties:344 (215=1) and 348 (215=-1).

tags.name: Prefer inverted posts
tags.description: Preference for inverted (taker-maker) venues when posting: first field sign (+/-) with optional weight. Weight defaults to config plus_/minus_prefer_inverted_posts_weight. No reader outside Parameters was found, so the effect is not visible in this source.

example.explanation: Prefer inverted venues with weight 2.

tags.name: MOO rate type (smart open)
tags.description: Smart open auction sizing type: rate type[,max type[,min type]]. 1 = rate of imbalance theoretical volume, 2 = relative to estimated volume, 3 = historical volume, 5 = ADV, 11 = ML_OPENPR full size at 218 rate, 30-39 = ADV%/size% caps, 100 = fraction of order size, 200 = fixed shares. Max/min types bound size with 218's 2nd/3rd fields. When set and the stock has not opened (and 220=0), the order is relayed as SMART_OPEN/SMOO for the auction.
tags.default: 0 (off); with 206>=3 effective type 1 (3 if no indicated open); max type 5 if 218 field 2 set

example.explanation: Open auction size = 218% of indicated volume.

interactions.title: Smart open relay (SMOO)
interactions.explanation: moo_rate_type>0 with stop_after_moo=0 and stock not opened sets relay algo SMART_OPEN; child is relayed as SMOO.

interactions.title: 217 overrides 206
interactions.explanation: moo_mode() returns 0 when 217>0.

interactions.title: KO with 14=0
interactions.explanation: ai.fixmsg.properties:513 rejects orders with 217/218 and 14=0 (no open).

interactions.title: Zeroed when start time given
interactions.explanation: ai.fixmsg.properties:101-102 set 217=218=219=0 when start_to_moo>0 and an explicit start time (9002 or 9012 tag 2) is given, cancelling smart-open sizing.

interactions.title: Needs 218 rate
interactions.explanation: Size computed from moo_rate (218); without it moo_rate is -1.

tags.name: MOO rate
tags.description: Open-auction rate (percent) used with 217: rate[,second[,third]]. For 217 types outside 30-39 the 2nd field is the max rate and 3rd the min rate (bounded by 217's max/min types); for 30-39 the 2nd is % of ADV cap and 3rd % of order size cap.

example.explanation: 20% of auction volume, capped at 33% by max type.

interactions.title: Needs 217 (or 206>=3)
interactions.explanation: Rate used only when a moo rate type is active.

interactions.title: KO with 14=0
interactions.explanation: ai.fixmsg.properties:513.

tags.name: Imbalance-open rate
tags.description: Rate (percent) for the opening imbalance-offset worker (IMBO): with an active smart open (217 in 1..39) and 219>0, an imbalance worker trades against the open imbalance.

example.explanation: Offset 10% of open imbalance.

interactions.title: Needs 217 in 1..39
interactions.explanation: Imbalance worker created only when moo_rate_type in (0,40) and imbo_rate>0 (or layered SMOO).

tags.name: Stop after MOO
tags.description: When >0 the order only participates in the open auction: non-MOO candidates are not processed, and once the stock has opened the order is rejected/stopped (STOP_AFTER_MOO). Also prevents smart-open relay.
tags.default: 0; ai.fixmsg.properties:462 sets 1 for HK SDMA/ICEDMA market orders starting before continuous open

example.explanation: Open auction only.

interactions.title: Order ends after open
interactions.explanation: Rejected with STOP_AFTER_MOO once stock opened; only MOO candidates processed.

interactions.title: Blocks smart-open relay
interactions.explanation: SMART_OPEN relay only when stop_after_moo==0.

interactions.title: HK DMA market orders default 220=1
interactions.explanation: ai.fixmsg.properties:462.

tags.name: Imbalance-open rate type
tags.description: Type of the opening imbalance worker: 1 = run the imbalance worker with DAY TIF on continuous venues; other values route to IMBO aggression venues with OPG TIF. Mode 0 with pre-open ending at continuous start uses a different worker set-up.

example.explanation: Imbalance worker uses DAY orders.

interactions.title: Needs 219
interactions.explanation: Only used when an imbalance worker exists (219>0).

tags.name: Stock resume delay
tags.description: Delay (minutes) before resuming trading after a stock halt ends. Plain number applies to all halt types; 'k:m' sets m minutes for halt type k (0-5); unspecified types fall back to the plain value. Applied only if the halt lasted longer than config min_halt_time (when configured).

example.explanation: 5 min after halts, 10 min after halt type 2.

tags.name: Volume smoothing
tags.description: factor[,catchup_rate]. Volume smoothing factor for participation: when >0 and quotes valid, the engine adds a portion of the opposite quote size (scaled by factor/catch-up rate) to smooth the market-volume estimate. Catch-up rate defaults to config volume_smooth_rate, else the order minPartLevel.
tags.default: 0; ai.fixmsg.properties:84 sets 223=1 for orders with minPartLevel>0

example.explanation: Smooth with factor 1, catch-up rate 10%.

interactions.title: Rule forces 223=1
interactions.explanation: ai.fixmsg.properties:84 sets 223=1 when minPartLevel>0 (overwrites any value).

tags.name: Volume profile symbol
tags.description: Symbol(s) whose volume profile is used for scheduling instead of the order's own symbol ('ex' maps to the profile group default). Defaults to 'symbol,dualSym' when dual-list volume counting is enabled.

example.explanation: Use the exchange/profile-group default profile.

tags.name: Volume profile averaging mode
tags.description: Integer stored as vprof_avg_mode; no reader of vprof_avg_mode() was found in the source, so effect unknown.

example.explanation: Stored only.

tags.name: Fair price limit
tags.description: Dynamic 'fair' limit: mode,msig0,msig1,tmin_ms,tmax_ms,tnt,sigma_min,sigma_max. With mode 1 the engine tracks a fair mid price and caps the order's limit at fair price +/- msig spreads/volatility (combined with any client limit: tighter wins). tmin/tmax/tnt bound the time window (tnt trades), sigma_min/max bound volatility.
tags.default: AlgoConfig plim_mode 0, msig0 5, msig1 2, tmin 3000, tmax 300000, tnt 25, sigma_min 0.0025, sigma_max 0.025; ai.fixmsg.properties:86 sets 226=1,50,50,1000,300000 when unset

example.explanation: Fair limit on with wide 50-sigma bands.

interactions.title: Tightens client limit
interactions.explanation: withinLimit uses min(fair,limit) for buys / max for sells; fair limit used if no limit.

interactions.title: Rule enables fair limit by default
interactions.explanation: ai.fixmsg.properties:86 sets 226=1,50,50,1000,300000 on every order that does not carry 226, so a fair limit is active on effectively all orders.

tags.name: Preferred venue
tags.description: Regex of preferred venue ids, optional weight, optional mode. Weight is absolute, or 'xa' = x times average weight of other venues, 'xt' = x times total. Mode 0 updates selection weight only, 1 updates size scale (more shares), 2 both. Default weight 0.5 when only pattern given.

example.explanation: Prefer CHIX venues with 2x average weight and more size.

tags.name: Emergency take venue
tags.description: Venue id to use for emergency takes; only take-aggression venues with this id qualify, and it must be enabled for the order. Defaults per exchange code from AlgoConfig emergency_take_venue map.
tags.default: AlgoConfig emergency_take_venue (per exchange code), else none

example.explanation: Emergency takes via TSE-TAKE.

tags.name: Post-fill reaction
tags.description: reaction[,tick[,spread[,dtmin_ms[,dtmax_ms[,ntrade]]]]]. Reaction 1 = chase: after a post fill, replenish hot venues (tryReplenish). 2 = pause: record the post fill price as a limit (limitPostFill). Other fields (tick 1, spread 0.5, dtmin 6000, dtmax 60000, ntrade 10) are stored; dtmax forced >= dtmin.

example.explanation: Pause posting relative to last post fill price.

tags.name: FX-denominated limit price
tags.description: Limit price in another currency: [currency,]price[,mode,offset][;range]. Currency defaults to USD. Mode (0 last, 1 mid, 2 passive, 3 aggressive quote) and offset govern the FX conversion. When valid, strategies do nothing until the converted FX limit is available.
tags.default: currency USD; mode AlgoConfig limitprice_fx_mode 2; offset 0.01

example.explanation: Limit 1500 JPY converted to listing currency.

interactions.title: Trading waits for FX price
interactions.explanation: If limitprice_fx_valid() and no FX limit is available, the strategy returns without trading.

tags.name: Pair spread sensitivity
tags.description: Sensitivity factor for pair-spread trading, clamped to [0,1]. Value is only copied into the scheduler order-info map (OrderHolder); no other engine logic reads it in this source tree. Tag 231 is also in the hard-coded list of sub-tags inherited by legs of a compound portfolio-tracker order (compound mode 5).

example.explanation: Half sensitivity to the pair spread (passed to the scheduler).

tags.name: MOC mode (scheduler-driven close)
tags.description: Turns on scheduler-driven MOC handling. When moc_mode>0 the close-auction size comes from the scheduler's MOC candidates (setSchMocSize) and the OEO strategy does not send its own close-auction order (ConcertStrategy returns NONE; non-step-up MOC orders are blocked). A value above 10 is split: tens digit = moc_maxpart_mode, units digit = moc_mode (e.g. 11 -> maxpart mode 1, moc mode 1).

allowedValues.meaning: Off: the OEO close logic owns the auction order

tags.default: 0; moc_maxpart_mode from AlgoConfig moc_maxpart_mode (per exchange, default 0)

example.explanation: Scheduler-driven MOC with max-participation mode 1 on the close.

interactions.title: moc_mode forced to 0 when there is no close
interactions.explanation: moc_mode() returns 0 when tag 9009 is present with doClose=0, when 9015 inclose=0, when the close is excluded, or for DLP-sourced orders; setDoClose(0) also resets it (restored from the original value when doClose goes back to >0). So 232 has no effect unless the order participates in the close.

interactions.title: OEO stops sending its own MOC
interactions.explanation: With moc_mode>0 ConcertStrategy returns ActionType.NONE for its close action and FlexOrderStream refuses non-STEPUPMOC MOC orders; the close quantity is the scheduler MOC candidate size, zeroed after pre-close end.

interactions.title: Rule file writes 232 from 20 rules (conflict C-15)
interactions.explanation: ai.fixmsg.properties writes 232 in many rules with values 0/1/11 (e.g. L198/L199 set 0 for VWAP by moc_rate_type, L245 sets 1 for orders starting at/after close, L246/L247 reset to 0, L301 default 1 for non-schedule algos, L306 sets 11 for VWAP/TMX in AU/NZ/TB/PM/SP/KS/TT/HK/MK, L622-L644 set 1 for China/KS/IN). The final value is decided by rule order (conflict C-15); L246 contains the misspelling 'echangeCode' (conflict C-03).

interactions.title: VWAP/TMX in APAC get 232=11 by default
interactions.explanation: If 232 is not set and the order has close participation (tag 15 != 0), VWAP/TMX orders in AU/NZ/TB/PM/SP/KS/TT/HK/MK get 232=11.

interactions.title: SDMA with 312 in SEA/AU: 232 forced to 0
interactions.explanation: For SDMA in SP/IJ/MK/PM/AU with tag 312 present and start before MOC, the rule file sets 232=0.

tags.name: MOO PM (afternoon open) mode
tags.description: Mode for participating in the afternoon (PM) opening auction, with an optional theoretical-open-volume fraction. moopm_mode>0 makes moo_pm_rate_type() default to 1 (3 if the stock has no PM indicative open) when 233 is not combined with 276; mode 4 makes the theo fraction follow the morning moo_theov_fraction. With moopm_mode>0 a FlexOrderStream PM-open path returns early.
tags.default: mode 0; theov fraction from OEO config moo_theov_fraction(exchange) when not given, clamped [0,1]

example.explanation: Join the PM open, using 20% of theoretical open volume.

interactions.title: 233 implies a PM-open rate type
interactions.explanation: If 276 is not set (rate type <= 0) and moopm_mode>0, moo_pm_rate_type() returns 1 (or 3 when the stock has no PM indicative open), enabling PM open participation. Ignored entirely when the stock has no PM open.

tags.name: Cash residual-imbalance aggression
tags.description: Aggression used for residual imbalance in cash (portfolio) trading. Value is only copied into the scheduler order-info map (OrderHolder); no other engine logic reads it in this source tree. (key cash_res_imb_aggr).

tags.name: I-Would ignores relative limit
tags.description: When >0, I-Would (would-price) liquidity is allowed to ignore the order's relative limit price: the checks in CandidateProcessor and FlexOrderStream treat the would price separately from the relative limit.

allowedValues.meaning: Would orders respect the relative limit
Would orders ignore the relative limit

tags.name: Portfolio PM-tracker limit style
tags.description: Integer style passed to the PortfolioPMTracker constructor (portfolio P&L/price-move tracker). Only meaningful when the portfolio PM tracker mode/reftype strings are set.

tags.name: Inherit sub-parameter tags
tags.description: Comma-separated list of 9012 sub-tag ids that a compound/parent order passes to its child (sub) orders. 'ALL' copies every 9012 tag except those in config exclude_from_inherit_subparam. Overrides the AlgoConfig inherit_subparam_tags list for this order.

example.explanation: Children inherit I-Would price (10), 11, 19, 155 and 284 from the parent.

interactions.title: Compound templates set 237
interactions.explanation: Rule-file COMPOUND templates (T.Rowe preopen L501/L502, STARSLTSC L534 with 237=ALL) set 237 so that parent tags flow into the legs.

tags.name: I-Would price currency
tags.description: Currency (CurrencyType code, e.g. USD) in which the I-Would / would-dark / would-stop / begin prices (tags 10, 207, 33, 39) are expressed; passed to IWouldPrice parsing so the price is converted to the stock currency.

example.explanation: I-Would price in tag 10 is given in USD.

interactions.title: Only matters with an I-Would price
interactions.explanation: 238 only changes the interpretation of would-type prices (tags 10/207/33/39).

tags.name: IEX dark mode
tags.description: Controls use of IEX dark (midpoint) liquidity. First field: units digit = mode, tens digit = would-dark flag. Mode 1: field2 = % of order shares to rest on IEX dark, field3 = max %; mode 3: field2 = trade-filter name used to size IEX dark from filtered IEX volume. Other modes clear the would-dark flag. When >0, IEX is excluded from some generic venue lists and pmid/dark aggressions are routed specially.

example.explanation: Keep 20% (max 40%) of the order resting in IEX dark.

interactions.title: IEX max fraction disallows tag 213
interactions.explanation: When the IEX max fraction (field 3 of mode 1) is >0, CandidateProcessor adds tag 213 to the disallowed tags for the order.

interactions.title: Reset when no IEX dark worker
interactions.explanation: If no IEX dark worker can be set up, ConcertStrategy logs 'no iex dark, resetting tag 239' and sets the mode to 0.

interactions.title: Parser bug: 4th field re-reads field 3
interactions.explanation: When a 4th field is given, iex_would_split is parsed from a[2] (the max-pct field) instead of a[3].

interactions.title: AU default trade filter only when 239 absent
interactions.explanation: Rule L261 sets 317=CP:1 for AU only when both 317 and 239 are unset.

tags.name: IEX check (ping) mode
tags.description: IEX check/ping behaviour. First field m: units digit = iex_check_init (if >0, an initial IEX check order of field2 % of shares is sent; field3 selects the price type), tens digit = iex_check_take (1/5: IEX check before taking; 3: special handling of TAKE aggression in ExchangeMaster).

example.explanation: Initial IEX check with 10% of shares and check IEX before takes.

tags.name: IEX would mode
tags.description: Parsed into _iex_would_mode, but the accessor iex_would_mode() is not called anywhere in this source tree; no observable effect.

tags.name: Free style
tags.description: Integer flag; Value is only copied into the scheduler order-info map (OrderHolder); no other engine logic reads it in this source tree. (key FreeStyle). Meaning not determinable from the engine.

tags.name: Profile deviation aggression
tags.description: Scales the allowed deviation from the volume profile: min/max schedule deviation are multiplied by max(0.01, 1+value). Positive values widen the band, negative narrow it. Max deviation is 0 regardless when impact_profile_mode>0.

example.explanation: Allow 1.5x the configured min/max schedule deviation.

tags.name: Peg size fraction
tags.description: Fraction (clamped 0..1) of workable shares used as the size of a peg candidate.

example.explanation: Peg the full workable quantity.

interactions.title: HK SDMA short sell defaults 244=1
interactions.explanation: Rule L5 sets 244=1 for SDMA short sells in HK when 244 is unset.

tags.name: Work all shares
tags.description: When >0 the workable/must-make size is the whole available quantity rather than the schedule target (CandidateProcessor, DMA strategy, LC worker). In DMAStrategy mode 2 additionally loops over venue allocations until all shares are placed.

allowedValues.meaning: Work all, DMA places every share across venues (retry loop)

interactions.title: DMA family default 245=2
interactions.explanation: Rule L472 sets 245=2 for DMA/SDMA/ICEDMA when unset; but L375 (245=1 when tag 57 is set) fires first, so L472 is dead for those orders (conflict C-12).

interactions.title: SDMA MPO default skipped when 245=2
interactions.explanation: Rule L273 only sets MPO=1 for SDMA when 245 != 2.

tags.name: Post participation rate cap
tags.description: Caps passive (post) shares at value% of the eligible market volume (advltEffNoWould) minus shares already made; also requires minimum traded volume before posting. Divided by the number of split sub-orders when an order is split.

example.explanation: Passive fills limited to 10% of volume.

tags.name: Work participation rate cap
tags.description: Caps total working size at value% of adv1t (effective volume since start, no would); if market volume is too small the size upper bound is frozen at current makes. Divided across split sub-orders.

example.explanation: Never work more than 15% of traded volume.

tags.name: Take order duration
tags.description: Lifetime of take (aggressive) child orders in seconds (stored as ms); used as the end stamp of take work orders in Concert/DMA/NDMA/Take workers.

example.explanation: Take orders live 7 seconds.

interactions.title: TT and China default 248=7
interactions.explanation: Rules set 248=7 for TT and C1/C2/CH when not set.

tags.name: Post during pre-open
tags.description: Posting in the pre-open session. Units digit = post_preopen level (values >2 require a limit price, otherwise reduced to 2), tens digit = post_preopen_mode, field 2 = buffer (ms) used by NDMA. Any value >0 disables open-auction participation (doOpen and doPMOpen set to 0). Levels >2 let DMA/DLP post before open; >=2 changes several pre-open checks in FlexOrderStream.

allowedValues.meaning: Pre-open posting at limit (needs limit price)

interactions.title: Pre-open posting cancels open auction participation
interactions.explanation: If post_preopen()>0 the order's doOpen and doPMOpen are set to 0, so any open-auction instruction is dropped.

interactions.title: Level >2 reduced to 2 without limit price
interactions.explanation: post_preopen() lowers values >2 to 2 when the order has no limit price (and no limit-price percent).

interactions.title: DMA family defaults (conflict C-11)
interactions.explanation: Rules default 249=2 for DMA/SDMA (L464) and 249=3 for ICEDMA (L471); L479 forces 249=0 when tag 14=0.

tags.name: Min participation rate (RT)
tags.description: Minimum participation rate in percent on the 'RT' volume basis (advrt, separate from the normal min part level). Validated in checkForError: rejected if >0 but below config minpart_reject_min, or above minpart_reject. Divided across split sub-orders.

interactions.title: Out-of-range RT min rate rejects
interactions.explanation: checkForError returns 'min part level rt too small' / 'min part level rt > bound' and the order is rejected.

tags.name: Max participation rate (RT)
tags.description: Maximum participation rate in percent on the RT (advrt) basis; ConcertStrategy caps the part-cap using advrtEffNoWould. Rejected if above maxpart_reject or >0 but below maxpart_reject_min. Divided across split sub-orders.

interactions.title: Out-of-range RT max rate rejects
interactions.explanation: checkForError returns 'max part level rt > bound' or 'too small' and the order is rejected.

tags.name: Target participation rate (RT)
tags.description: Target participation rate in percent on the RT (advrt) basis; used as the RT cap when 251 is not set. Same reject bounds as 250/251. Divided across split sub-orders.

interactions.title: 251 beats 252 as RT cap
interactions.explanation: ConcertStrategy uses maxPartLevelRT and only falls back to targetPartLevelRT when 251 is <=0.

interactions.title: Out-of-range RT target rate rejects
interactions.explanation: checkForError rejects when the RT target is above maxpart_reject/minpart_reject or >0 but below maxpart_reject_min.

tags.name: Pre-close period adjust
tags.description: Moves the pre-close period: the new period runs from preCloseEnd - a seconds to preCloseEnd - b seconds (order-specific copy of market hours). Optional 3rd field preclose_adj_strict>0 changes ExecutionCustomizer close handling (same branch as moc_submission_no_wait). '0,0' disables.

example.explanation: Pre-close period starts 35 s before its normal end.

interactions.title: JP defaults 253=25/35
interactions.explanation: Rules set 253=25 for NINJA/ICENINJA in JP (unconditional, overrides client) and 253=35 for other non-schedule algos in JP when unset (not JT).

tags.name: Pre-open period adjust
tags.description: Moves the pre-open period on an order-specific market-hours copy: from preOpenEnd - a s to max(preOpenBegin, preOpenEnd - b s). '0,0' disables.

tags.name: PM pre-open period adjust
tags.description: Same as 254 for the afternoon pre-open period; ignored for markets without a PM open.

tags.name: True min-size threshold
tags.description: Threshold (ratio) used by adjustMinSize to reduce min execution size near the end of the order: values <1 become 0. When >0.99 the last slice ignores min fill. Used by WorkOrder, Concert, LC and Take workers.

tags.name: Min-exec only on cancellable venues
tags.description: When >0 (and the order has a min exec size/value), work orders with a min-exec size are not created on exchanges where minExecCxl()==0.
tags.default: AlgoConfig min_exec_cxl_only (0) when a min exec size/value is set

tags.name: Continuous session end adjust
tags.description: Shortens continuous trading for this order: continuousEnd is rolled back by the given duration (suffix s/m/h, plain number = seconds). Applies to both normal and PM market-hours copies.

example.explanation: Stop continuous trading 2 minutes before the normal end.

interactions.title: Setting 258 removes close participation
interactions.explanation: Rule L495 sets 15=0 whenever 258 is present, so the order will not go into the close.

interactions.title: HK/TB short-sell templates set 258=120
interactions.explanation: Short-sell rules for HKNC and TB VWAP/TMX ending at close set 258=120 with 15=0.

tags.name: Trade on non-primary exchange
tags.description: Trades the order on another listing: the value is looked up in config trade_ex_map to get the exchange suffix; if it differs from the stock's exchange, the symbol is rewritten to <root>.<exch> and the stock is reloaded from the security master.

interactions.title: Unknown trade exchange or stock rejects
interactions.explanation: If the key is not in trade_ex_map the order gets _err_msg 'invalid trade exchange'; if the alternate stock cannot be loaded, 'cannot get stock for trade_ex'. Both are returned by checkForError.

interactions.title: Symbol replaced for the order
interactions.explanation: When trading non-primary the order symbol (latch.symbol) becomes the alternate listing; the original is kept as psymbol.

tags.name: Prorate mode
tags.description: Portfolio prorating: mode[,prorate]. mode>0 forces portfolio level 1. Orders in a portfolio must use the same prorate mode/value as the portfolio (FlexOrderStream compares them). Also read by ExecutionCustomizer and ConcertStrategy (prorate_mode<1 is a condition for must-complete handling); passed to scheduler.

interactions.title: Forces portfolio level
interactions.explanation: A prorate mode >0 sets _portfolio_level=1.

tags.name: Price swing check
tags.description: Large intraday price-swing detection for portfolio orders: mode,trigger1,spread1,trigger2,spread2,... (if an odd trailing trigger, its spread is 999999). Only checked during continuous trading (not lunch), for live orders in a portfolio; mode>=3 changes the action taken.

interactions.title: Only for portfolio orders
interactions.explanation: detectedLargePriceSwing returns false when the order has no portfolio.

tags.name: LINE benchmark
tags.description: Benchmark price for LINE orders. mode[,bps]: 0 strike/arrival, 1 VWAP, 2 dVWAP, 3 TWAP, 4 open, 5 prev close, 6 first fill, 7 fixed price (or give a decimal price directly), 8 cVWAP, 9 filtered VWAP, 10 effective VWAP. bps shifts the bench by side*bps.

example.explanation: Benchmark = interval VWAP moved 5 bps in the side direction.

interactions.title: 263=11 is rewritten by rule
interactions.explanation: Rule L351 replaces 263=11 by 0 if the stock opened else 5 (prev close). Rule L206 sets 263=0 for MFSIS.

tags.name: Display size mode
tags.description: Display (shown) size formula used when inviting liquidity: mode,base,delta. Mode 1: pct = base*exp(delta*aggression); mode 2: base + delta*aggression. Unset/zero fields fall back to AlgoConfig.

tags.name: Ninja post
tags.description: When >0, NINJA (and shadow-ninja for would candidates) orders also post passively; read by ConcertStrategy for algotype NINJA / likeShadowNinja.

tags.name: Modify as cancel/new
tags.description: Controls how amends are handled. When the order's modCxlNew is on, a replace is treated as cancel-old/new-order: live child orders are not transferred to the new order, the old order is not put into CLOSE_REPLACE, and the amend waits during no-cancel lockout periods.

interactions.title: Flipped by rule file (conflict C-13)
interactions.explanation: L203 sets 266=2 for ICEDMA/SDMA/DLP, L204 for USEDLP=1, L249 resets to 0 for orders starting at/after close, L524 sets 2 again when tag 383 is present.

tags.name: Broker ranking mode
tags.description: Broker-ranking (market update) mode used by WombatQuoteStream for this order.

tags.name: Participation monitor margin
tags.description: Tolerance (percent) above the max participation rate before the participation monitor intervenes: margin = 1 + max(0.5%, value/100). Value 0 makes the participation limit strict (strictPartLevelLimit=1).

example.explanation: Strict max participation, no tolerance.

interactions.title: Index trackers forced strict
interactions.explanation: Rule L201 sets 268=0 when indexTrackerAdaptionMode>0 (index tracker adaption also makes strictPartLevelLimit 1 in code).

tags.name: Order duration (minutes)
tags.description: Order duration in minutes (stored as ms); used in OrderMarketStat fair-limit / timing calculations (fair_limit_mdt * duration).

interactions.title: Used in T.Rowe compound leg
interactions.explanation: COMPOUND templates set 269=5 on the VWAP leg.

tags.name: Allow leaving orders over lunch
tags.description: 1 = keep orders on the market during the lunch break (no halt, goal sizes not zeroed); 0 = never; unset = algorithm default (Algorithm.allowLunchBreakLeave).

interactions.title: Asia markets default 270=1
interactions.explanation: Rule L275 sets 270=1 for C1/C2/CH/CN/HK/JP/IJ/TB/PM/MK/SP when unset.

tags.name: Send odd-lot mode
tags.description: Odd-lot handling: >0 allows routing odd lots to the exchange's odd-lot venue; >1 also enables extra odd-lot handling in ABSStrategy and keeps odd-lot aggression orders.

tags.name: Preload mode
tags.description: Integer; Value is only copied into the scheduler order-info map (OrderHolder); no other engine logic reads it in this source tree. (key preload_mode).

tags.name: Finish leftover
tags.description: Finishes small residuals: when open shares fall below a threshold the order completes. mode[,threshold]: modes 1-4 threshold is in local-currency thousands converted to shares by last price; 5-8 threshold is a fraction of order size; modes <3 (1-4) / <7 (5-8) take max with preferred min size. Even modes ignore the max participation cap. For OTD/VWAP/THX only applied near end time.

allowedValues.meaning: Fraction of size, respect max rate
Fraction of size, ignore max rate

tags.name: Dark chase price mode
tags.description: After a dark fill, chase the dark price: mode,nv,tmin,tmax. Mode 1 last fill price, 2 work-order price, 3 average fill price. Within tmin (x ref min duration) the chase price is set; up to tmax it is set only if market volume since the fill <= nv x chased makes.

interactions.title: Default 274=1,275=1 for schedule algos
interactions.explanation: Rule L187 sets 274=1 and 275=1 for VWAP/SHADOW/PART/LINE/SHADOWMIN/IIS/CASH when dark_mid_price_mode=0 (unconditional, overrides client values).

tags.name: Dark chase ping mode
tags.description: mode[,duration]: when >0 and priority is CHASELIQUIDITY, LCWorker builds ping allocations (pingAlloc) with the given ping duration.

interactions.title: Set by rule L187
interactions.explanation: Rule L187 sets 275=1 for schedule algos when dark_mid_price_mode=0.

tags.name: MOO PM rate types
tags.description: Rate type(s) for the afternoon (PM) opening auction: rate[,max[,min]]. 4 = same as morning MOO type. 11 = special worker handling (partRate set on PM open orders, kills orders with other rate). Returns 0 when the stock has no PM open. With 279=0 and the stock not yet PM-opened, the relay algorithm becomes SMART_OPEN.
tags.default: -1 (none); max type defaults to 5 if 277 adv pct given

interactions.title: PM open makes relay SMART_OPEN
interactions.explanation: If moo_pm_rate_type>0, stop_after_moo_pm (279)=0 and the stock has not opened PM, setSmartOpenRelay switches an invalid relay algorithm to SMART_OPEN.

interactions.title: No PM open market
interactions.explanation: All moo_pm_*_rate_type accessors return 0 when the stock has no PM open.

tags.name: MOO PM rates
tags.description: rate[,adv_pct[,min_rate]] for the PM opening auction. adv_pct caps PM open size at % of ADV; min_rate is also used as % of order size. With rate type 4 the morning MOO values are used. Divided across split sub-orders.

tags.name: IMBO PM rate
tags.description: Participation rate (percent) against the PM-open imbalance; used when 276 rate type is 1..9.

interactions.title: Needs PM rate type
interactions.explanation: Only applied when moo_pm_rate_type is between 1 and 9.

tags.name: Stop after MOO PM
tags.description: When >0 the order stops after the PM opening auction; also prevents the SMART_OPEN relay switch.

tags.name: IMBO PM rate type
tags.description: Parsed into _imbo_pm_rate_type but the accessor imbo_pm_rate_type() returns the morning _imbo_rate_type field, so this tag has no effect (bug).

interactions.title: Value ignored (accessor bug)
interactions.explanation: imbo_pm_rate_type() returns _imbo_rate_type, not _imbo_pm_rate_type; the PM imbalance rate type follows the morning setting.

tags.name: Moving-average mode
tags.description: mode[,bps] with mode 0..6; forwarded to the scheduler (mavg_mode, mavg_bps).

interactions.title: Mode outside 0..6 rejects
interactions.explanation: Sets _err_msg 'Invalid MAVG_MODE must be in range [0,6]'.

tags.name: No-history auction handling
tags.description: moo[,moc[,moopm]] flags controlling what happens when an auction-participating order has no auction volume history. 0 = reset doOpen/doClose/doPMOpen to 0 (with AUCTIONWARN alert); other values keep participation (still alerting); the value is also passed to openingVolume/closingVolume and values <2 change config handling.

example.explanation: Keep open and close participation even without auction volume history.

interactions.title: 0 drops auction participation without history
interactions.explanation: With moc_nohist=0 and no closing volume history, doClose is reset to 0 (alert 'no close volume data'); same for open/PM open.

tags.name: MOO base price source
tags.description: Base price for open-auction limit computation: 2/3 used by AuctionWorker when no candidate limit; 4 pre-open VWAP, 5 last price before open, 6 decayed pre-open price (only when last-price trade count exceeds threshold; fields 2/3 = trade-count threshold and order delay seconds); 11 = IPO price for IPO stocks. Default prev close.
tags.default: 0 (prev close); thresholds from AlgoConfig last_price_trdcnt_threshold / last_price_order_delay

interactions.title: KS IPO orders get 283=11
interactions.explanation: Rules L530/L531 set 283=11 (IPO price) with LOR for KS IPOs.

tags.name: Inherit old would/grab percentage
tags.description: would[,grab]: on amend/replace, keep the would (and grab) percentage of the old order (2 = alternative would handling). If only one field is given, grab follows would. Copied to sub-orders.

interactions.title: COMPOUND resets 284=1 to 0
interactions.explanation: Rule L521 sets 284=0 for COMPOUND orders that carry 284=1 (after templates L501/L502 set it).

tags.name: Ninja take mode
tags.description: mode[,pct]: for NINJA orders with a limit price, adjusts take sizes; mode>1 caps take at pct% of order size (default 100).

tags.description: offset_min[,vwap_pct[,estimate_mode[,estimate_once[,moc_max_part_rate]]]] for relative VWAP/TMX: start time is derived from end time minus offset minutes using profile volume; vwap_pct and moc_max_part_rate (% of theoretical close volume) size the close portion. offset>0 or pct>0 prevents conversion to the OPE scheduler algorithm.

interactions.title: Blocks OPE-scheduler conversion
interactions.explanation: Small orders of client algos using the OPE scheduler are converted to OPE<algo>, but only when rvwapStartEndOffset()<=0 and rvwapStartEndVWAPpct()<=0.

interactions.title: RVWAPRELATIVE/RTMXRELATIVE templates
interactions.explanation: Rules L583/L584/L628 build 287 from maxPartLevel*0.75 and moc_rate for clients using caiid RVWAPRELATIVE/RTMXRELATIVE.

interactions.title: 289=6 rewritten with 288=0
interactions.explanation: Rules L193/L194 replace 289=6 by 288=0^289=2 (non-AU) or 289=3 (AU).

tags.name: I-Would price risk check
tags.description: mode[,strike[,lit_bps[,dark_bps]]]: validates absolute I-Would (tag 10) and would-dark (207) prices against a strike price (quote last price by strike mode, or prev close before open). If the would price is more than lit_bps/dark_bps through the strike the order/replace is rejected (INVALIDWOULD). Modes 2-5 default the strike mode to NEAR/MID/CROSS/LAST and the bps to ~0. Mode 0 disables.

interactions.title: I-Would too far from market rejects
interactions.explanation: INVALIDWOULD: 'iwould price more than N bps away' when an absolute would price is beyond the configured range from the strike price.

tags.name: Grab price risk check
tags.description: mode[,strike[,range_bps]]: checks the grab threshold price against the strike (quote by strike mode, or prev close); if beyond range bps and mode>=2 (or the grab price is absolute) the order is rejected with INVALIDGRAB.

interactions.title: Grab price too far rejects
interactions.explanation: rejectOrder(INVALIDGRAB) when the grab threshold is more than range bps from the strike and risk mode >=2 or the grab price is absolute.

tags.name: Reject open order without venue

interactions.explanation: Rule L206 sets 294=1 for MFSIS LINE orders (consumed by the scheduler).

interactions.title: Short-sell rules by market (C-06/C-07)

interactions.title: ARROWST baskets get 314=20,5,1
interactions.explanation: Rule L303.

tags.description: mode[,range[,range4]]: limit price for close-auction orders computed by Statics.auctionLimit(mode, range, quote). Modes 5-9 (10 for portfolios) use a WAP from the quote and add moving-average subscriptions (205/210/215/220); mode 8 falls through and also adds 230 and mode 9 adds none (missing 'case' keyword). With CLO/QCLO TIF and range>0 a path is disabled.

interactions.title: China/JP defaults
interactions.explanation: C1/C2/CH get 315=3,1000 (3,2000 for ChiNext/STAR); JP short sells get 315=2,499 when unset.

tags.name: MOO PM limit price mode
tags.description: mode[,range] limit-price rule for PM open auction orders (Statics.auctionLimit).

tags.name: Trade filter
tags.description: filter1,filter2,...[:mode]: trade filters applied to the order's market statistics (volume counted). mode 1 also uses the filtered OMS for participation regulation and pmid worker.

interactions.title: AU/KS defaults
interactions.explanation: AU gets 317=CP:1 (when 239 also unset); KS with KTF=1 gets 317=NOKT.

tags.name: Synthetic SOR mode
tags.description: Synthetic smart-order-router for India dual listing: >=1 enables the synthetic India router (dual trade); 3 forces work orders to exchange IB, 4 to IS.

tags.name: IOI limit price
tags.description: Limit price for IOI (indication of interest) activity, in I-Would price syntax (M prefix = multi-price).

tags.name: OPE open buffer
tags.description: Seconds after continuous begin after which the OPE treats an unopened stock as opened (stock copy marked opened). Minimum 1 s when ope_open_mode>1.

interactions.title: Market defaults via rules
interactions.explanation: TB 300, KS 180, SDMA in MK/HK/CN/IN/PM/SP 1, others (non-JP) 60, together with 162=10.

tags.name: Reserved for scheduler
tags.description: Empty parser in the engine (comment: reserved for scheduler). The engine accepts and ignores the value; the external scheduler may use it.

tags.name: Allow volatility auction
tags.description: 1 = ignore stock halts (keep trading through volatility auctions); 2 = ignore halts only when the HLTA flag is set. Default per algorithm from OEO config.

tags.name: Dark chase price thresholds
tags.description: agg0,agg1,pas0,pas1,wait thresholds (in spreads, and wait x ref min duration) used by LCWorker to decide whether a dark order's price is far enough from the chase price to be repriced.

interactions.title: Needs dark chase
interactions.explanation: Only relevant when dark chase price mode (274) is active.

tags.name: Low/high would mode
tags.description: Parsed but low_high_would_mode() is never called in this tree; no observable effect.

tags.name: Take spread check
tags.description: mode0[,mode1_min[,avg[,factor%]]]: large-spread check before taking. mode0%10>0 compares against current near price, mode1 against the moving average over N minutes; spread is 'large' if it exceeds max(avg x stock spread, factor x price). <30 blocks takes when spread is large; 10-29 also affects LC/Concert; >=30 only raises a LargeSpread alert.

interactions.title: mode1 default bug
interactions.explanation: take_spread_mode1() writes the config default into _take_spread_mode0 instead of mode1.

tags.name: Portfolio lock wait
tags.description: Seconds to wait for the portfolio lock when issuing portfolio orders.

tags.name: Post chase price
tags.description: mode,agg0,agg1,pas0,pas1,wait: when to reprice a resting post relative to the reference price (distance measured in spreads). Within agg0/pas0 reprice only after wait x ref min duration; beyond agg1 reprice immediately; mode>1 never reprices between agg0 and agg1. Mode <=0 uses the default priceOff logic.

interactions.title: IN and KS short sell defaults
interactions.explanation: IN gets 327=1 when unset; KS RSHO short sells get 327=2,0,10.

tags.name: Order round-lot size override
tags.description: Overrides the stock round-lot size for this order.

interactions.title: STAR board 200 and odd-lot rules
interactions.explanation: China STAR/STGR buys (and SG sells) get 328=200; TT ODDONLY gets 328=1; ODDVWAP China orders smaller than a lot get 328=size.

tags.name: Moving-average relative limit windows
tags.description: t1,t2[,adaption[,window]]: two moving-average windows (subscribed as 11000+t) used for a relative limit price; candidates are held until both averages are available.

tags.name: S0 adjust (close)
tags.description: mode[,residual[,imb]]; mode>0 stops setEUMOCAfterClose from resetting the order for EU after-close MOC (unless 312 enforcement applies). Values also go to the scheduler.

tags.name: Uptick only
tags.description: For short sells: >0 restricts DMA/NDMA/Peg/ABS workers to uptick pricing; >1 also affects TakeWorker.

interactions.title: KS/TB/JP short sells
interactions.explanation: Rules set LORT=1^331=1 for KS/TB short sells and JP short sells under regSHO.

tags.name: Reject on remaining volume ratio
tags.description: ratio[,mode] (mode 0 greater, 1 less than). Parsed but the accessors are never called in this tree; no observable effect.

tags.name: Chain order
tags.description: mode[,expire_min[,refid[,size_jump]]]: chains a new order to a previous one (found by target id or client order id). On cancel the order stays live for expire minutes; refid replaces the client order id; if size change > threshold x remaining, the chain breaks. Chain orders skip relay-algorithm adjustment and ignore the split tag.

interactions.title: Split and relay adjustments disabled
interactions.explanation: split() returns empty and adjustRelayAlgorithm returns early when chain mode>0.

tags.name: Index tracker FX mode
tags.description: mode[,ccy|pair]: converts index-tracker reference strikes by an FX rate; field2 = 3-letter currency or currency pair.

interactions.title: Invalid currency rejects
interactions.explanation: Unknown 3-letter currency sets _err_msg 'index tracker currency invalid'.

tags.name: CODA block mode
tags.description: mode[,min_size[,min_size_part]] for CODA block/conditional handling (US only). Effective min sizes are max(given, config coda_min_size_str by market cap). coda_mode() returns 0 outside US or when the order is smaller than the min sizes. Mode 1 changes candidate, IoI and block handling.

interactions.title: Non-US or small orders
interactions.explanation: coda_mode() returns 0 if composite exchange is not US or order size < min sizes.

tags.name: Dark fill rate weight
tags.description: Weight for dark fill rate; Value is only copied into the scheduler order-info map (OrderHolder); no other engine logic reads it in this source tree. (key weight_agg).

tags.name: EOD max mode
tags.description: Integer; Value is only copied into the scheduler order-info map (OrderHolder); no other engine logic reads it in this source tree. (key eod_max_mode).

tags.name: LINE scheduler mode
tags.description: smode[,bound[,padvAcc]] for LINE; Value is only copied into the scheduler order-info map (OrderHolder); no other engine logic reads it in this source tree.

tags.name: Custom imbalance close (IMBC)
tags.description: mode[,pct]: imbcl_mode=1 makes the order eligible for scheduler CUSTOMIMBC (imbalance-close) candidates; other values ignore them. pct goes to the scheduler.

tags.name: Step-up MOC
tags.description: rate[,mode]: extra MOC 'step-up' shares as rate% of the close imbalance (mode 1 = join imbalance only; mode 0 = when in the money vs step-up limit 341). Below a round lot nothing is sent. Divided across split sub-orders (not for moc_rate_type%10==1).

tags.name: Step-up MOC limit
tags.description: Limit price (I-Would price syntax) for step-up MOC orders; falls back to AlgoConfig stepup_moc_limit_str.

interactions.title: Needs step-up MOC
interactions.explanation: Only used when step-up MOC (340) is active.

tags.name: Control venue % of makes
tags.description: [mode,]list of venue/broker/aggression:pct entries limiting the share of fills per venue; parsed by ExchangeMaster into exchange/broker/fixid/aggression maps with shut-off lists. Active when the string is longer than 2 chars.

tags.name: Pair lead mode
tags.description: Pair-trading lead mode. When >0, the pair cash-balancing step in CandidateProcessor no longer treats a leg with zero value as 'one-sided' (that one-sided rebalancing only applies when pair_lead_mode<1). For PAIR orders, pair_lead_mode>0 together with pair lead side (tag 67)>0 makes doCashOPE() return 1, so OPE-level cash balancing is used unless OCASH (1523) is set explicitly.

interactions.title: 343>0 with 67>0 turns on OPE cash balancing for PAIR
interactions.explanation: doCashOPE() returns 1 for pair algos when pair_lead_mode>0 and pair_lead_side (67)>0, unless OCASH (1523) was given explicitly (it is checked first).

tags.name: Post inverted spread move
tags.description: Threshold for the running spread move. When set (above -1e9), the OEO strategy keeps a running spread benchmark (0.25*spread + 0.75*previous) and computes the current spread move % against it. No code was found that reads the computed spread-move % afterwards, so the tag's effect beyond turning on that calculation is unclear.

tags.name: Start mode venue
tags.description: Venue used for the fast-start take when start mode (tag 196) = 2. At start, if the venue is valid and usable, the strategy sends one START work order for the full order size at the inside aggressive price to this venue.

example.explanation: With 196=2, send the start order to ARCA

interactions.title: SMV ignored unless start mode 196=2
interactions.explanation: start_mode_venue() is only read when start_mode()==2 and the start take has not been tried yet.

tags.name: Layered smart-open deltas
tags.description: Sets up a layered open-auction (smart MOO) order. The first field is the delta unit: B (=1, basis points of the theoretical open price), V (=2, scaled by stock volatility/15) or an integer mode. Then space-separated pairs 'delta rate' where rate is 'mooRate[:imbalanceRate]'. When valid, the open is worked by LayeredOpenWorker / LayeredImbOpenWorker, one layer per pair, priced at theoretical open +/- delta, sized by the layer rates. Sub-orders fall back to the parent's layer arrays.
tags.valueFormat: mode,delta1 orate1[:irate1] delta2 orate2[:irate2] ...  (mode = B | V | int)

allowedValues.meaning: deltas in bps of theoretical open price

example.explanation: Two layers: 10 bps through theo open at 20% MOO / 10% imbalance rate; 30 bps at 15% MOO

interactions.title: Malformed 346 rejects the order
interactions.explanation: If there is no layer list, or the list has an odd number of fields, _err_msg='invalid tag 346' is set, and checkForError() returns it.

interactions.title: Layered open also creates the imbalance-open worker
interactions.explanation: When do_layered_smoo() is true an imbalance (limbo) worker is set up even if moo_rate_type (217) / imbo_rate (219) would not otherwise create one.

tags.name: Close shares reserve cutoff
tags.description: Number of seconds before the end of the pre-close (close auction) period after which the order starts reserving shares for its close (MOC) portion. Before that point, the OrderHolder close-reserve calculation returns early and nothing is reserved.

example.explanation: Reserve close shares only in the last 120 s before pre-close end

interactions.title: Rule sets 347=120 with 26/27 for JP SHADOW min-part orders
interactions.explanation: ai.fixmsg.properties:350 writes 347=120^27=0^26=minPartLevel for SHADOW/SHADOWMIN in JP (not JT) with 15=1 and minPartLevel>0.

interactions.title: Rule sets 347=1300 for India VWAP with close
interactions.explanation: ai.fixmsg.properties:663 sets 347=1300 (only if not set) for IN VWAP orders with doClose>0 when the market has no close-VWAP period.

tags.name: Peg quote size factor
tags.description: For PEG orders: caps each peg candidate at factor x the inside passive quote size (rounded to lot, no more than the remaining size). With sendmore=0 (default) the peg worker does not send another order when live orders already sit at the current peg price (peg_skip_same_price).

example.explanation: Peg with at most half the inside quote size; don't stack orders at the same price

interactions.title: PEGQS only applies to peg algos
interactions.explanation: The size cap is applied only when the algorithm is PEG (CandidateProcessor) or algo().isPeg() (ConcertStrategy).

tags.name: Strict relative auction OOM
tags.description: When >0, auction working orders (OPG/CLO time in force) are closed with CLOSE_ORDER_HALT whenever the order info says shouldHaltStrict(), i.e. the order is pulled from the auction under the strict halt / out-of-money check.

tags.name: Lift quote threshold (special)
tags.description: High-touch special trigger. When threshold>0 the strategy watches the inside aggressive (opposite) quote size and moves a state machine when it goes above/below the threshold. The mode decides how normal candidates are handled: 1 = candidates get hard/min size 0 ('special high touch trigger, no hardsize'); 2 = candidate holder processing stops with no candidates.

tags.name: Smart close compound
tags.description: Turns on the SMART_CLOSE relay: when >0 and the order has a close rate (tag 26 >0 and tag 27 >-1), it is relayed as two sub-orders: an MOC sub-order (algo MOC, 26=100, 27=1, sized from the imbalance theo volume) from the auction start time, and the residual with the original parameters from continuous end minus the intraday rollback. Rollbacks are given in seconds.
tags.default: 0 (off); intraday rollback 300 s; auction rollback: accessor returns preCloseEnd+60s when not set

interactions.title: 351 relays the order as SMART_CLOSE (MOC child + residual)
interactions.explanation: setSmartCloseRelay() sets RelayAlgorithm.SMART_CLOSE when smart_close_compound>0, moc_rate_type (27)>-1 and moc_rate (26)>0. relaySmartCloseOrder then creates an MOC child and an intraday residual child. Note: the only call site found for setSmartCloseRelay is inside adjustRelayAlgorithm's splitting branch.

interactions.title: 351 needs a close rate (26/27)
interactions.explanation: Without moc_rate>0 and moc_rate_type>-1 the relay is not set (and an existing SMART_CLOSE relay is cleared).

tags.name: Block first MOO mode
tags.description: Blocks the first open-auction (MOO) order while nothing is yet on the open. 1 = block when the MOO size <= one round lot; 2 = block when the auction shows no volume (paired + imbalance); 3 = both conditions; 4 = either condition.

allowedValues.meaning: block when MOO size <= round lot
block when small AND no volume
block when small OR no volume

interactions.title: 352 only for the first MOO
interactions.explanation: The check runs only when leaveAndOnOpen()==0 (no open order yet).

tags.name: Day range mode
tags.description: Day price-range settings sent to the scheduler: mode (0 or 1) and range (default 5.0). Any other mode rejects the order. Only exported into the OrderHolder order-info map (sent to the scheduler side); no other engine logic reads it.

interactions.title: 353 mode outside 0..1 rejects
interactions.explanation: Mode <0 or >1 sets _err_msg='invalid tag 353'.

tags.name: MOC range mode / first-fill buffer
tags.description: Close price-range settings: mode (0..3) and range (default 5.0) are only sent to the scheduler via the order-info map. The third field is a first-fill buffer in minutes (negative = 30 min): if the order has no fill by continuous end minus the buffer, the info map reports the cutoff time and last trade price as its 'first fill'. Mode outside 0..3 rejects the order.

interactions.title: 354 mode outside 0..3 rejects
interactions.explanation: Mode <0 or >3 sets _err_msg='invalid tag 354'.

tags.name: Use late LOC
tags.description: Late limit-on-close mode. Only exported into the OrderHolder order-info map (sent to the scheduler side); no other engine logic reads it. (key LLOC_mode).

tags.name: Queue repost sensitivity
tags.description: For layered posting: when >0 the layered post worker decides whether to repost using a sensitivity check on the change in workable shares compared with this value, instead of the default repost_queue_delta check.

tags.name: Start-before-close offset
tags.description: Moves the order start to (continuous end - offset). Value is a duration with optional unit s/m/h (no unit = milliseconds). startstamp() becomes max(load time, continuousEnd - offset). If the order arrives after that point the offset is set to 0. If not set and opportunistic close (358) is on, the config opportunistic_close_start_end_offset is used.

example.explanation: Start working 30 minutes before the continuous close

interactions.title: 357 overrides the order start time
interactions.explanation: startstamp() returns continuousEnd - offset (not before load time), replacing the normal start time (9002 / 3).

tags.name: Opportunistic close
tags.description: Opportunistic close settings: mode, then close rates crate1/crate2 and intraday rates irate1/irate2 (ints; -1 = AlgoConfig defaults). Rate 1 applies while now is more than the start-end offset (357) before the close, rate 2 after. Mode>0 also makes 357 default to the config opportunistic_close_start_end_offset.
tags.default: mode 0; rates from AlgoConfig opportunistic_close_* (crate1, crate2, irate1, irate2)

interactions.title: 358 turns on a default 357 start offset
interactions.explanation: If 357 is not set and opportunistic_close_mode>0, start_end_offset uses the config value, so the order start moves close to the close.

tags.name: Take mode / factor
tags.description: Take mode and take factor (factor clipped to 0..1). Only exported into the OrderHolder order-info map (sent to the scheduler side); no other engine logic reads it. (keys take_mode, take_factor, only when mode>0).

tags.name: Periodic auction mode
tags.description: Controls use of periodic-auction dark venues. 0 = exclude all periodic-auction venues; 1 = allow only type-1; 2 = allow up to type 2 and prefer type-2 venues over type-1 (regular dark always kept); 3 = prefer type-3 venues, else regular dark + type 2, else fall back.

tags.name: Pre-open start time strict
tags.description: When >0 and the stock has not opened, the order is held by a timer until its start time instead of starting in the pre-open.

tags.name: Chain leg states
tags.description: For relayed / compound orders: when >0, each new sub-system order is initialised from the previous sub-order (initReplaceOrder), so leg state carries over from one leg to the next.

tags.name: Open auction backload
tags.description: When =1, the open-auction size is capped at order size x (opening volume / ADV) (PM opening volume during lunch), at least one round lot. Applies to SMOO relay legs (FlexOrderStream) and to the smart-open sizing of non-SMOO algos (ConcertStrategy).

tags.name: Max simultaneous shares
tags.description: Caps the shares working at the same time. Value in shares, or 'NP' = N% of order size (0..100). The cap is rounded to lot. Candidate hard/min/max/workable sizes are capped, and a new work order is refused if its size plus current leaves would go over the cap.

example.explanation: At most 20% of the order working at any time

tags.name: IEX RLP percent
tags.description: Percent of an IEX midpoint (IEX:ALGO_PMID) allocation to route to the IEX retail liquidity (RLP) venue instead. >99 sends it all to RLP; otherwise the size is split if both parts meet their min sizes.

tags.name: Allow limit-price open cash balance
tags.description: Parsed into _allow_limitprice_open_cash_balance, but no code reads it (its accessor is never called). Has no effect in this source.

tags.name: Max dark participation
tags.description: Max dark participation, in % of period volume. The dark (LC) worker caps the shares it works so dark makes stay under this % of (forward dark-volume estimate + period volume). Also exported to the order-info map.

tags.name: Scheduler MOC mode
tags.description: Close scheduling mode with min/target/max close rates. Mode>0: the scheduler handles the close goal; plain scheduler ':moc' candidates are ignored, doCloseScheduler() is forced to 1, and the strategy keeps thinking after OVERTIME. Mode 2 uses the 375 limit for MOC pricing and the 368 passive layer.

interactions.title: 368>0 forces scheduler close handling
interactions.explanation: doCloseScheduler() returns 1 when sched_moc_mode>0, before checking doCloseOpe/doclose (15), and scheduler ':moc' candidates are ignored.

interactions.title: 368=2 prices MOC from tag 375
interactions.explanation: With sched_moc_mode 2, final-auction pricing uses moc368Limit() (tag 375) and the 3681 passive layer is blocked when its price is too close to the base limit.

interactions.title: Would-close (369) skipped when 368 has a target rate
interactions.explanation: tryWouldClose returns if moc_rate>0 or sched_moc_target_rate>0 and nothing is on the close yet.

tags.name: iWould MOC rate
tags.description: Rate (%) for the iWould (dark) close portion. When >0, after continuous end the strategy sets up a would-close (wdmoc) worker and tryIWouldClose runs. Only for markets where the close auction comes after continuous end. Works with would-dark-close mode (1832): mode 1 switches the would-close only when 369>0.

interactions.title: 369 skipped with max simul auction or close rate
interactions.explanation: tryWouldClose returns when max_simul_auction (1721)==1, or when moc_rate (26)>0 / 368 target rate>0 and nothing is on the close yet.

tags.name: iWould MOC limit
tags.description: Limit price expression for the iWould close (369) portion, parsed lazily with IWouldPrice.parseIWouldPrice (relative to stock spread). Used as the dark limit by the close / auction workers. Only for markets where the close auction comes after continuous end.

tags.name: Cash balance unhold threshold
tags.description: Parsed into _cash_balance_unhold_threshold, but its accessor is never called. Has no effect in this source.

tags.name: SOR dark mode
tags.description: SOR dark mode flag. Only exported into the OrderHolder order-info map (sent to the scheduler side); no other engine logic reads it. (key sordark_mode, when >0).

tags.name: Allow SHADOW open
tags.description: SHADOW (not SHADOWMIN) orders with no min participation (tag 5 <=0) do not do the open auction by default. Set >=1 to let them take part in the open.

interactions.title: 373 lifts the SHADOW no-open rule
interactions.explanation: customtags_open is set to 0 for SHADOW with minPartLevel<=0 unless allow_shadow_open>=1; EO (1504), IIS and PAIR still exclude the open.

tags.name: Scheduler MOO mode
tags.description: Open scheduling mode. Mode 1: 'mode,min,target,max' rates. Other modes: 'mode,min,rmatch,rcontra,max' (rates for matched and contra-imbalance volume). When >0, plain scheduler ':moo' candidates are ignored ('expecting moogoal') and ':moogoal' / ':moolimit' candidates are used instead. Values are exported to the order-info map.

interactions.title: MOO goal candidates ignored without 374
interactions.explanation: ':moogoal' and ':moolimit' candidates are ignored when sched_moo_mode<1; a 217 moo_rate_type>0 takes priority over 374 for ':moo'.

tags.name: MOC 368 limit
tags.description: Limit price expression (IWouldPrice, relative to spread) for the close when scheduler MOC mode 368=2. Used to price final-auction orders and the lit limit in ConcertStrategy, and to block the 3681 passive layer when it is within a tick of the base limit.

interactions.title: 375 is used only with 368=2
interactions.explanation: Code comment 'used when 368=2'; final-auction pricing reads moc368Limit only when sched_moc_mode==2.

tags.name: Pair spread reject factor
tags.description: Pair spread reject factor. When not set it is filled from OEO config pairspread_reject_factor(stock). No code outside the accessor reads it, so no reject logic using it was found.

tags.name: Trade at last
tags.description: Trade-at-last (post-close) mode. 1[,price]: allows trading after continuous end at the given price (or the close price): end time becomes 23:59, no 'start time beyond market hour' reject, non-auction orders may be created after close, and test orders use the TAL price as firm. A negative value closes non-auction working orders after continuous end (CLOSE_AFTER_HOUR).

allowedValues.meaning: close non-auction orders after continuous end

interactions.title: 377>0 overrides end time and after-close blocks
interactions.explanation: With trade_at_last_mode>0, the end time becomes 23:59:00, the reject 'start time beyond market hour' is skipped, and WorkOrder allows non-close orders after continuous end.

tags.name: Intraday auction (IA) mode
tags.description: Enables taking part in intraday (volatility / post-halt) auctions: mode, rate (% of theoretical volume) and number of slices. When mode>0 the stock counts as 'in IA' (adjusted by 380) for halt handling, and the IA auction worker sizes at theo volume x rate. If no rate is given it is derived from participation settings: target participation, else (min 5 + max 6)/2, else by aggression.

tags.name: Intraday auction limit
tags.description: Limit price expression (IWouldPrice, relative to spread) for intraday-auction (IA, 378) orders, used by the IA worker.

tags.name: Intraday auction time adjust
tags.description: Seconds to adjust the intraday-auction window after a halt (stored x1000 ms). Used by stock.inIA(...) checks and as the IA auction begin = last halt time + this. When not set it comes from config ia_adj(exchange, composite).

tags.name: Circuit-breaker / participation rates
tags.description: cb_mode with start, resume and MOC participation rates. Only exported into the OrderHolder order-info map (sent to the scheduler side); no other engine logic reads it. (keys cb_mode, start_prate, resume_prate, moc_prate).

interactions.title: Rule fills 381 for CLOSEB
interactions.explanation: ai.fixmsg.properties:417 sets ALGO=CLOSEB and 381=0,0.2,0.6,0.05 (with other tags) when tag 88=CLOSEB and 381 is not set.

tags.name: Rebalance min exec mode
tags.description: When =1: only dark venues whose FIX id contains 'DMQDRK' are used, the dynamic min-qty tag is set on those orders, all candidates are worked (like work_all), and alwaysMinExec=2 enforcement is skipped.

tags.name: OPE would-post
tags.description: OPE-side opportunistic would-post. mode[,qty[,pqs[,padv[,rand[,cmp]]]]]: mode>10 means mode%10 using a take worker instead of a post worker. Size = max(qty, round lot), limited/raised by pqs x median quote size and the padv-minute average volume (cmp=1 caps, else floors); rand = randomisation. Modes 1-3: scheduler 'would' candidates are ignored. Any mode other than 4 makes PostWorker ignore normal would-post goals.

interactions.title: 383 with would-dark 11=1 is rejected by rule
interactions.explanation: ai.fixmsg.properties:554 writes KO='383 With WouldDark' when 383 is set and tag 11=1.

interactions.title: 383 modes 1-3 replace scheduler would candidates
interactions.explanation: Scheduler would candidates are ignored ('ope handles would') when 0<mode<4; PostWorker drops would-post goals unless mode=4.

tags.name: Scheduler would-post mode
tags.description: Scheduler-side iWould-post mode (code comment: for SHADOW). Only exported into the OrderHolder order-info map (sent to the scheduler side); no other engine logic reads it. (key iwouldpost).

tags.name: Would % of ADV
tags.description: Would percentage of ADV (clipped 0..100). When >0, iWould volume stats are collected even if the order is not would-dark, and the value is exported to the order-info map.

interactions.title: Rules set 385=20 in TROWE LINE compound leg
interactions.explanation: ai.fixmsg.properties:501-502 build a COMPOUND 9060 with a LINE leg using 385=20 for APIC TROWESWITCH orders.

tags.name: Extra dark limit price
tags.description: Second ('extra') dark limit price spec, same format as tag 182: 'mode[,range]' where range may be S<n> = n x spread. Parsed in parametersFinalProcess into dark_limit_price_mode2/range2, which are only exported to the order-info map.

tags.name: Extra lit limit price
tags.description: Second ('extra') lit limit price spec. Bug: parametersFinalProcess checks this tag but then parses the primary lit limit string (tag 183) instead of 387's value, so lit_limit_price_mode2/range2 copy 183. The values are only exported to the order-info map.

interactions.title: 387 value ignored; 183 is parsed instead
interactions.explanation: When 387 is set, Parameters.java:12188 splits _lit_limit_price_str (tag 183), not _lit_limit_price_str2. 387's own value is never used, and if 183 is missing this can throw a NullPointerException.

tags.name: Portfolio dollar cap
tags.description: Net dollar cap for a basket: '[CCY,]amount' with k/m/b suffix; sign gives direction (+ = cap net buy, - = cap net sell). Setting it makes the order portfolio-level and turns on OPE cash balancing. Candidates on the capped side are scaled so net dollars stay within the cap; the cap is converted to USD; the whole portfolio is rejected once the cap is reached after the smaller side is done.

example.explanation: Net buy dollars of the basket may not exceed $5m

interactions.title: 388 forces portfolio level and OCASH=1
interactions.explanation: A non-zero cap sets _portfolio_level=1 and _do_cash_ope=1 (same field as OCASH 1523), so OPE cash balancing is on.

interactions.title: One-sided basket against cap sign is rejected
interactions.explanation: BUY-only basket with negative 388, or SELL-only basket with positive 388, gets all orders rejected (BAD_INPUT).

interactions.title: 388 resets MWORK to 1
interactions.explanation: With a portfolio dollar cap, every live order in the portfolio has max_workable (MWORK 1518) set to 1.0.

interactions.title: 388 raises passive_only (173) by 10
interactions.explanation: passive_only() returns 10+value when 1<=173<=10 and a portfolio dollar cap is set.

tags.name: IOI min exec size
tags.description: Min execution size used for IOI venues. Number = shares; RLS<n> = n x round lot; ATS<n> = n x avg trade size; AQS<n> = n x average of median bid/ask size; <CCY><n> (e.g. USD50000) = min exec value in that currency. Overrides the normal min exec size on IOI aggression-level venues.

example.explanation: IOI min exec = 5 round lots

interactions.title: 389 with bad currency / missing stock data rejects
interactions.explanation: _err_msg is set when the currency code is unknown, or the stock has no round lot / avg trade size / quote size for RLS/ATS/AQS.

tags.name: Baseline MOC rate
