tags.description: Baseline close rate, as % of the total MOC slices. Used as brate=0.01x value in close-size calculations by the close workers and FlexOrderStream.

tags.name: Client-limit MOC rate
tags.description: Close rate as % of estimated market (close) volume for a layered client-limit close auction. When >0: doCloseOpe() becomes 1 (OPE handles the close), the strategy runs tryLayeredCAuction, and candidate processing stops once the OPE client-limit MOC size covers the remaining size.

interactions.title: 391 makes OPE handle the close
interactions.explanation: doCloseOpe() returns 1 when clientlimit_moc_rate>0 (if OPEMOC 1513 not set), so doCloseScheduler() returns 0.

tags.name: Cash cleanup dollar threshold
tags.description: Parsed into _cash_cleanup_dollar_threshold, but its accessor is never called. Has no effect in this source.

tags.name: PureStream EOD mode
tags.description: Pure-stream end-of-day (XEOD) handling. mode (>=10 means mode%10 with split mode 2), rollback seconds, and then a split % (split mode 1: share given to purestream, default 25) or a normal-EOD level (split mode 2: cap on normal EOD participation, default 25, capped by tags 6/9). Mode 1 is disabled when prevent-flip-EOD (1654)>0 or include-EOD-candidate (147)=0; mode 2 is disabled when close scheduler leftover est (1718)<=0. Default rollback: 2 s for mode 1, 15 s otherwise.

interactions.title: 393 mode 1 off with 1654 / 147=0
interactions.explanation: purestream_eod_mode() returns 0 for mode 1 if prevent_flip_eod (1654)>0 or include_eod_candidate (147)==0.

interactions.title: 393 defaults QCIC (1809) to 1
interactions.explanation: qcls_is_close() returns 1 when purestream_eod_mode>0 and 1809 is not set.

tags.name: VWAP would-make mode
tags.description: Parsed into _vwap_would_make_mode, but its accessor is never called. Has no effect in this source.

tags.name: Order-specific stock NMS flag
tags.description: Order-level override of the stock's NMS value. Setting it (>=0) makes the order need its own copy of the stock object (requires_individual_stock_object).

tags.name: VWAP tilt factor
tags.description: Tilts a VWAP schedule toward the auctions (clipped to -1..1). OPE open size = (1+tilt) x size x evopen/val1/v12, close size = (1-0.4 x tilt) x ..., both capped by max participation. A non-zero tilt also enables ope_handles_auction_vwap_tilt (1814) which makes OPE handle open/close.

interactions.title: 1814 only works when 396!=0
interactions.explanation: ope_handles_auction_vwap_tilt() returns 0 unless vwap_tilt_factor!=0; when on, doOpenOpe/doCloseOpe return 1.

interactions.title: Rule sets 396=0.5 for MK/KS short VWAP
interactions.explanation: ai.fixmsg.properties:599 writes 396=0.5^MAXSD=0 for sellshort VWAP in MK/KS when 396 is not set.

tags.name: Ladder open
tags.description: Ladder (layered) open-auction order: 'sizes:prices', each a comma list of the same length (at least 2). Sizes are % of the iWould open volume ('V' = -1, special); prices are layer prices ('V' = 0). Uses the LayeredOpenWorker, makes OPE handle the open (doOpenOpe=1) and disables the normal OPE MOO path.

example.explanation: Three open layers with 30/40/30% at 10.00, 10.05, 10.10

interactions.title: Malformed ladder throws during parsing
interactions.explanation: A RuntimeException is thrown if there is no single ':' delimiter, the lists differ in length, or there are fewer than two rungs.

interactions.title: 397 makes OPE do the open
interactions.explanation: doOpenOpe() returns 1 when do_ladder_open().

tags.name: Volume limit pro-rate
tags.description: When >0 and the order has a group basket id (GB 1501), orders of the group basket are processed together by processVolumeLimitProrate (sets per-order total size, max part and MOC), and the RVWAP estimate uses the pro-rated group size (needs enable_rvwap_pro_rate).

interactions.title: 398 needs GB (1501)
interactions.explanation: processVolumeLimitProrate runs only when tag9012('GB') and groupBasketID are set; else normal portfolio scheduling.

tags.name: OPE heartbeat size
tags.description: If >0 and the order has no fills and no heartbeat yet, OPE creates one custom heartbeat candidate of this size (once).

tags.name: IEX v6 percent
tags.description: Percent of an IEX midpoint (IEX:ALGO_PMID) allocation to send to the IEXV6 venue level instead (like 365 for RLP).

tags.name: Pair dark mode / factor
tags.description: PAIR dark handling: 'mode,factor' or just 'factor' (mode 0). Factor outside 0..5 is set to -1. Mode>0 makes pair-adjusted sizing of custom-dark, custom-take and normal candidates (keeping legs balanced), and special handling of dark custom candidates. Factor is exported to the order-info map.

tags.name: QAT mode
tags.description: QAT mode (0..2, invalid -> 0), wait (default 1, negative -> 1) and reset (0/1). Only exported into the OrderHolder order-info map (sent to the scheduler side); no other engine logic reads it. (keys qat_mode, qat_wait, qat_reset).

tags.name: iWould profile mode
tags.description: For scheduled algos: when iWould fills push the order ahead of its profile by more than 1%, the profile point is saved for the scheduler: 1 = compare to the VWAP volume profile, 2 = compare to the TMX time profile.

tags.name: Portfolio dollar cap (scheduler)
tags.description: Portfolio dollar cap and buffer. When >0: OrderHolder computes current buy/sell values of the portfolio and gives the scheduler size max_size_todo, and the portfolio's setPortfolioDollarCap() is called. The buffer is parsed but never read.

tags.name: Impact profile mode
tags.description: When >0, the stock's custom profile (sm_ keys) is added to the scheduler profile map, and max schedule deviation is forced to 0.

interactions.title: 406 forces max schedule deviation to 0
interactions.explanation: max_schedule_deviation() returns 0 when impact_profile_mode>0, ignoring any deviation tag/config.

tags.name: LINE d-mode
tags.description: LINE scheduling d-mode. Only exported into the OrderHolder order-info map (sent to the scheduler side); no other engine logic reads it. (key line_dmode).

tags.name: Open PWP prediction
tags.description: Smart-open rate prediction from participation-weighted price: mode, alpha, beta, buffer time (ms, default 210000) and minutes after open (default 2). Mode>0 recalculates the MOO rate; mode>1 with prefer-imbalance-weighted-evopen uses the profile theo volume as base; mode>2 averages it with the estimate. Beta is parsed but never read.
tags.default: mode -1; alpha 1; beta 1; buffer 210000 ms; 2 min

tags.name: Imbalance MOC
tags.description: Imbalance-driven close: mode, target size, threshold. Mode 1: target and threshold in shares; mode 2: target = fraction of theoretical volume, threshold in shares; mode 3: send only if in the money (buy limit >= theo price, sell <= theo price). When mode>0 the close workers price with computeImbMocPrice.

tags.name: Volume mode
tags.description: Volume mode. Only exported into the OrderHolder order-info map (sent to the scheduler side); no other engine logic reads it. (key vol_mode).

tags.name: Duration mode / factor
tags.description: Duration mode and factor. Only exported into the OrderHolder order-info map (sent to the scheduler side); no other engine logic reads it. (keys duration_mode, duration_factor when mode>0).

tags.name: Group id
tags.description: Group id of the order. When the config replaces wave names by group id (or the order has no wave name), the group id is used as the wave name for the new target order.

tags.name: Group basket id
tags.description: Group basket id. Needed by volume-limit pro-rating (398) to group orders.

tags.name: Do cash residual
tags.description: Cash-residual flag. Exported via OrderHolder.doCashResidual(); when <=0 the residual imbalance aggression rimb_aggr is reported as -1.

tags.name: Multi post
tags.description: Multi-post flag (1 = true). Only exported (order map 'multipost' and OrderHolder.multiPost()); no engine logic found.

tags.name: Exclude open
tags.description: EO=1 removes the open auction: moo_mode() returns 0 and the order gets doOpen=0 at setup.

interactions.title: EO=1 overrides open auction tags
interactions.explanation: excludeOpen forces customtags_open=0 (doOpen 14) and moo_mode 0, whatever 14/217 say.

interactions.title: Rules add 14=0^EO=1 for OCTC orders starting after open
interactions.explanation: ai.fixmsg.properties:572/573/578 write 14=0^EO=1 when OCTC is set and the start is after continuous begin / earliest auction.

tags.name: Exclude close
tags.description: EC=1 removes the MOC: moc_mode() returns 0.

interactions.title: EC=1 disables MOC mode
interactions.explanation: moc_mode() returns 0 when _exclude_close.

interactions.title: Rules set EC=1 (MK short sells, OCTC orders ending before close)
interactions.explanation: ai.fixmsg.properties:597 sets EC=1 for sellshort in MK; :574/:579 set 15=0^EC=1 for OCTC orders ending before continuous end.

tags.name: Min open size
tags.description: Minimum size of the open auction (MOO) order. All MOO candidates are merged into one of size min(max(MO, sum), order size), less what is already on the open.

tags.name: Primary only
tags.description: PO=1 routes only to the primary venue (non-primary venues are removed; broker-primary allowed).

tags.name: Participation excludes dark
tags.description: XD=1 makes the max participation apply to public (lit) volume only (maxPartLevelForPublic). It is also true automatically when max lit part (9) >0 and max part (6) <= max lit part.

tags.name: Split spec
tags.description: Comma list for SPLITTING relay: the order is split into N equal child orders (N = number of entries), with max/lit/min participation each divided by N. Entries starting with a digit get the impact child algorithm name as a prefix. Ignored when chain order mode (333)>0. Splitting needs the config split switch / min size, and a relay algo of SPLITTING.

interactions.title: Rules set SPLIT=3,4 for large LINE/TMX/VWAP with 79
interactions.explanation: ai.fixmsg.properties:241-243 write SPLIT=3,4 for LINE, TMX and VWAP with 79 set and size>8000.

interactions.title: SPLIT ignored with chain order mode
interactions.explanation: split() returns '' when chain_order_mode (333)>0.

tags.name: Exclude venue get-go
tags.description: Parsed (1 = true), but exclude_venue_getgo() is never called. No effect found.

tags.name: Major exchange percent
tags.description: If >0, the order is shut off for an exchange in the turn-off list when that exchange's share of the stock's volume is >= MJ %. Defaults to 20 for ARROWST baskets when config tmp_major_ex_usage is on.

tags.name: Begin alert format
tags.description: Alert format string for begin alerts. Defaults to '1' for SOROS baskets. No caller of the accessor was found.

tags.name: OPE does close
tags.description: Explicitly sets whether the OPE (strategy) handles the close auction. If not set, it is 1 automatically when moc_rate_type (27)>=0, TMX, close leftover est, client-limit MOC (391), auction vwap tilt, dual imbalance or above-lit-dark close is set. When >0 the scheduler does not handle the close (doCloseScheduler 0 unless 368>0).

interactions.title: OPEMOC overrides the automatic doCloseOpe
interactions.explanation: When set (>=0) doCloseOpe() returns it directly, ignoring 27/391/TMX defaults.

interactions.title: Rule sets OPEMOC=1 for JP VWAP ending at close
interactions.explanation: ai.fixmsg.properties:490 writes OPEMOC=1^PIWVC=0^PIWEVC=0 for JP VWAP when OPEMOC is not set.

tags.name: Simulated clock date
tags.description: Date used for the simulated clock (security master lookups, holidays). Only used in test mode (config test_mode>0); else returns null.

tags.name: Max size factor
tags.description: Factor that relaxes the stop-make limit in participation checks: stop limit = makes + FMAXS x allowed delta (not below min dark size).

tags.name: Workable factor
tags.description: Extra factor on the workable limit: work limit = makes + delta x FMAXS x FWORK.

tags.name: Max maxsize multiplier
tags.description: Bounds candidate max size relative to hard size: mode 2 = raise to at least MMAXS x hardsize, otherwise cap at MMAXS x hardsize. Applies only when hardsize>0 unless allowZero=1.

interactions.title: Rules set MMAXS for India
interactions.explanation: ai.fixmsg.properties:428 sets MMAXS=1 for IN VWAP/TMX if not set; :254 sets MMAXS=0 for IN VWAP/TMX with 155=SG.

tags.name: Max workable multiplier
tags.description: Bounds candidate workable size relative to max size: mode 2 = at least MWORK x maxsize, otherwise cap at MWORK x maxsize. Applies when maxsize>0 unless allowZero=1. Reset to 1.0 by a portfolio dollar cap (388).

interactions.title: 388 overrides MWORK with 1.0
interactions.explanation: With 388 set, setMaxWorkable(1.0) is applied to every live order.

interactions.title: Rules set MWORK=1 (IN, MAYBANK)
interactions.explanation: ai.fixmsg.properties:429 sets MWORK=1 for IN if not set; :407 sets 154=0^MWORK=1 for 155=MAYBANK.

tags.name: Min dark factor
tags.description: Multiplier on the min dark venue size used as the floor of the workable stop limit in participation checks.

tags.name: Venue selection mode
tags.description: Dark venue selection mode in the LC worker: >0 weights venue priorities by usage stats; 0 with no-chase gives all venues priority 0.5.

tags.name: FX rate
tags.description: FX rate (returned as 1.0 when fx mode >3). No caller of fx_rate() was found.

tags.name: Scheduler cash balance
tags.description: Explicit scheduler-side cash-balance flag. If not set it is derived (0 with cash lag side or sector mode 2, 2 with sector + cash ratio, else docash). Only exported via OrderHolder.

tags.name: OPE cash balance
tags.description: Explicit OPE-side cash-balance flag. If not set: 1 with cash lag side (130); for PAIR, 1 only if 343>0 and 67>0; else docash (13). With config oeo_cash_balance>0 and OCASH>0 the OPE balances candidate sizes across sides.

interactions.title: 388 forces OCASH=1
interactions.explanation: Portfolio dollar cap parsing sets _do_cash_ope=1.

interactions.title: Rules set OCASH
interactions.explanation: ai.fixmsg.properties:81 sets BCUS=3^OCASH=1 for PAIR with 97=2; :505 sets 147=0^OCASH=0 when prorate_mode>0.

tags.name: Stop time
tags.description: Time after which the order is expired (rejected EXPIRED). Value: a time, 'TL' (end of trade-at-last), or 'c' (continuous end). Prefix 'N' = do not expire if the order is in the close auction (MOC algo, close-only, on close, or close flags set). Clock times are converted from the algo zone.

interactions.title: TSTOP expires the order
interactions.explanation: After the stop time the order is rejected with EXPIRED (once), unless the value starts with N and the order is in the close auction.

tags.name: Kick-out (reject) message
tags.description: Reject message ('+' becomes space). If set, checkForError / checkForErrorFinal return it and the order is rejected with that text. Suppressed by NOKO (1766)>0. Mostly written by ai.fixmsg.properties rules to reject invalid tag combinations.

interactions.title: KO rejects the order
interactions.explanation: Any non-empty KO is returned as the order error by checkForError().

interactions.title: NOKO (1766) suppresses KO
interactions.explanation: kickout() returns null when _noko>0.

interactions.title: Many config rules write KO
interactions.explanation: ai.fixmsg.properties writes KO for invalid combinations, e.g. :196 (26 without 27), :197 (27 without 26), :263 (15=0 after continuous end JP/IN), :302 (passive 173 vs must complete 23=1), :473 (DMA with no limit and display size), :513 (217/218 with 14=0), :554 (383 with 11=1).

tags.name: Order tag
tags.description: Order tag used as an extra key ('@tag') when looking up per-client/basket venue preference maps.

tags.name: Open auction limit fraction
tags.description: Open (MOO) auction limit as a fraction away from the base price (previous close, or IPO price / theo price per 283): buy limit = base x (1+LOR), sell = base x (1-LOR). Returns 0 when the stock's moo price type is 2; when not set uses config moo_limit_fraction(composite), and for moo price type 1 with 0 uses the 'LOR' config default.

example.explanation: Open auction limit = base price +/- 5%

interactions.title: Rules set LOR=0 (with 164=0) when not given
interactions.explanation: ai.fixmsg.properties:138-140 inject 164=0^LOR=0 (most markets / HK) when LOR is not set; with both bands 0 no auction limit is computed and the auction child can go out with price 0 and be rejected downstream (doc).

interactions.title: Market rules set LOR
interactions.explanation: ai.fixmsg.properties:137 (IN market orders 0.1), :141 (HK 0.15), :142 (NZ/PM/IJ/MK 0.1), :411 (JP short 0.0999 cap), :530/:531 (KS IPO 3 / 0.4).

tags.name: PM open auction limit fraction
tags.description: Afternoon-open (MOOPM) auction limit as a fraction from a reference price; mode picks the reference: <=0 latest price, 1 VWAP (composite VWAP if composite mode), >1 previous close. Fallbacks as for LOR.

interactions.title: Rule sets LPR=0.05
interactions.explanation: ai.fixmsg.properties:151 sets LPR=0.05 for NZ/IJ/PM/MK when not set.

tags.name: Close auction limit fraction
tags.description: Close (MOC) auction limit as a fraction from a reference price; mode: <=0 latest price, 1 VWAP, >1 previous close. Capped by the exchange MOC limit (stock mocExchLimit) when present; 0 when moc price type is 2; may be reduced to dynamic/static limits by moc limit type (1601).

interactions.title: Market rules set LCR
interactions.explanation: Many rules set LCR when not given, e.g. ai.fixmsg.properties:155/159/160 (China 0.02 / 0.1,2 / 0.2,2), :163/:164 (JP), :166/:167 (HK 0 for market orders / 0.04), :170 (AU 0.05), :650 (IN 0).

interactions.title: Exchange MOC limit caps LCR
interactions.explanation: If the stock has an exchange MOC limit, LCR is min(exchange limit, LCR).

tags.name: OPE does PM open
tags.description: OPE handles the afternoon (PM) open auction. Returns 0 when the stock has no PM open. When >0 the scheduler does not do the PM open.

interactions.title: Rules set 171=1^OPEPMO=1 (JP/MK/TB/SP)
interactions.explanation: ai.fixmsg.properties:58-59 set OPEPMO=1 for many algos (and SHADOW with min part) in JP/MK/TB/SP when 171!=0.

tags.name: Open volume mix factor
tags.description: Parsed, but vopen_mix_factor() is never called (AlgoConfig has separate maps). No effect found.

tags.name: Close volume mix factor
tags.description: Parsed, but vclose_mix_factor() is never called. No effect found.

tags.name: Profile mix factor
tags.description: Parsed, but profile_mix_factor() is never called. No effect found.

tags.name: ADV mix factor
tags.description: Parsed, but adv_mix_factor() is never called. No effect found.

tags.name: Post price level
tags.description: Passive post price level (book level for posting), with a separate level for Reg SHO restricted short sells. If not set, uses OEO config post_passive_price_level / post_regsho_price_level. With Reg SHO and level <=0, the post price is kept at least one tick above the bid.

interactions.title: Short-sell rules set PPL
interactions.explanation: ai.fixmsg.properties:54 sets 173=1^PPL=1 for Reg SHO short sells; :132/:133 set PPL=-1,-1 or PPL=1 for HK short sells (non-ETF).

tags.name: Dark avg trade size factor
tags.description: Dark order sizing from average trade size: max dark size = min(maxsize, factor x avg trade size); minfactor sets the min slice (minfactor x avg trade size, not below round lot) when splitting workable shares.

tags.name: Block peg candidates
tags.description: Blocks scheduler peg candidates: 1 = block ':peg', 2 = block ':pegs', 3 = block both.

interactions.title: Rule sets BPEG=3 for all SHADOW algos
interactions.explanation: ai.fixmsg.properties:61 sets BPEG=3 when algorithm matches .*SHADOW.*.

tags.name: Block trade filter
tags.description: When >0, the order's bps-from-low/high block-trade settings are not applied to its market stats.

tags.name: Block custom candidates
tags.description: Blocks scheduler custom candidates: 1 = block ':custom', 2 = block ':customs' (and no customs workers), 3 = both, 7 = both; values >=4 also block ':opp'. 1/3/7 also skip the pair one-sided normal-candidate reset.

interactions.title: Rules set BCUS=3
interactions.explanation: ai.fixmsg.properties:81 (PAIR with 97=2, also OCASH=1) and :82 (ICENINJA with 73) set BCUS=3.

tags.name: Email mode
tags.description: Parsed, but email_mode() is never called. No effect found.

tags.name: DQTE venue
tags.description: Venue id prefix of the DQTE (close quote/auction) venue used when use_dqte (201)>0. If not set it comes from config dqte_venue(stock exQatt).

interactions.title: DQV needs use_dqte 201>0
interactions.explanation: dqte_venue is only used when use_dqte()>0.

tags.name: DQTE pre-close period
tags.description: Seconds before continuous end that define the DQTE pre-close window: begin offset, end offset (third value parsed too). With use_dqte, the order's market hours are copied and the pre-close period set to [continuousEnd - a, continuousEnd - b]. Defaults from config dqte_pca(exQatt).

interactions.title: DQPC needs use_dqte 201>0
interactions.explanation: The pre-close adjustment runs only when use_dqte()>0 and a DQTE venue exists.

tags.name: Modified order id (IDMOD)
tags.description: Client order id of the order this one replaces (cancel/replace). FlexOrderStream resolves it to the old order's internal id; ExecutionOptimizer then moves the old order's OEO strategy over to the new order rather than building a new one, unless the replace is handled as cancel-new (modCxlNew). The engine also sets it itself on replaces (setIdMod), and in that case writes it back into the tag map as IDMOD.
tags.default: none (set by the engine on replace)

interactions.title: IDMOD keeps the strategy of the replaced order
interactions.explanation: When IDMOD is set and the order is not handled as cancel-new, the existing ABSStrategy is taken from the map under the old id, re-bound to the new order and its allocations reset; for DMA/DLP a new initial goal may be created (dma_create_initial_goal_on_replace).

tags.name: Hard size posted loud (HPL)
tags.description: If > 0 (default 1), the candidate's hard size goes to the post worker as the amount to post as displayed (loud) orders. When the venue's ADV check does not allow fully loud posting, the post worker splits the work into public (loud) orders, sized by the loud fraction, and blind orders for the rest. 0 turns this off.

allowedValues.meaning: do not pass hard size as loud size
pass candidate hard size as loud size (default)

tags.name: Post ADV factor (PADV)
tags.description: Caps the posted size at the average N-minute volume, where N = PADV (ConcertStrategy.maxPostLimit). The final post cap is the larger of this and quote size x PQS. If neither PADV nor PQS gives a cap of at least 1 share, the engine uses the config post_adv_factor/post_quotesize_factor (ICENINJA and WOW have their own config values).
tags.default: unset (0) -> config post_adv_factor=1 is used as fallback (AlgoConfig post_adv_factor)

example.explanation: Post at most the average 5-minute volume, unless quote size x PQS is larger.

interactions.title: Post cap = max(PADV volume, quote size x PQS)
interactions.explanation: maxPostLimit takes the larger of avgNMinuteVolume(PADV) and quotesize*PQS, so a small PADV does not reduce a larger PQS cap, and the other way round.

tags.name: Post quote size factor (PQS)
tags.description: Caps the displayed post size at a multiple of the market's quote size. Field 1 is the multiplier. Field 2 picks the quote level: 1 = inside aggressive size, otherwise inside passive size. Field 3 chooses how the average bid/ask size is used: 1 = max(quote, avg), 2 = min, 3 = avg only, 0 = quote only; any value > 1 also stops the dynamic mode from lowering the factor. Field 4 (strict check): with 0, the cap is lifted completely in EOD mode; with >= 1, the cap still applies in EOD and the post worker clips each post to it. The factor is also passed to the scheduler's order-info map as pqsfloat.
tags.default: unset -> config post_quotesize_factor=1 (ICENINJA/WOW use their own config factors); level 1, useavg 1, strictcheck 0

example.explanation: Post at most half the inside aggressive quote size, use the live quote only, and keep the cap in EOD mode.

algorithmDependent.behavior: ai.fixmsg.properties sets PQS by aggression band (0.1-0.5) when not given
without PQS, the scheduler gets the config wow_post_quotesize_factor

interactions.title: PQS cap lifted in EOD unless field 4 >= 1
interactions.explanation: maxPostLimit returns an unlimited size when the strategy is in EOD and post_quotesize_factor_strict_check < 1 (the default). Field 4 = 1 keeps the cap through EOD.

interactions.title: PQS ignored when post-all is on
interactions.explanation: maxPostLimit returns unlimited when parameters.post_all()==1.

interactions.title: Config sets PQS for ICENINJA by aggression
interactions.explanation: When PQS is not given, ai.fixmsg.properties sets 0.5/0.33/0.25/0.15/0.1 (fields ,1,1,1) by aggression band. C1/C2/CH get 0.5,1,0,1 (line 33), IN gets 2,1,1,1 or 2,1,2,1 (lines 432/433, conflict C-09) and APIH gets 2,1,1,1 (line 498). These only apply if PQS is not already set, so a client value wins.

tags.name: Take quote size factor (TQS)
tags.description: Largest take order, as a multiple of the quote size (TakeWorker._max_quote_multiples) during normal (non-EOD) trading. A value <= 0 means the config value is used.
tags.default: config take_quotesize_factor=5; but ai.fixmsg.properties:113 sets TQS=1 for any order with size>1 that has no TQS/ETQS

interactions.title: Config default TQS=1/ETQS=5 for nearly all orders
interactions.explanation: When neither TQS nor ETQS is set, rule 113 writes TQS=1^ETQS=5 for any order with size>1, so in practice the defaults are 1 and 5, not the AlgoConfig 5/100. IN orders get TQS=5^ETQS=8 from rules 110-112 first (rule 112 is unreachable, conflict C-10).

tags.name: EOD take quote size factor (ETQS)
tags.description: Largest take order, as a multiple of the quote size, once the take worker enters EOD mode (TakeWorker.enterEOD replaces the TQS multiple with this one). A value <= 0 means the config value is used.
tags.default: config eodtake_quotesize_factor=100; ai.fixmsg.properties:113 sets 5 when TQS/ETQS are absent

interactions.title: Config sets ETQS with TQS
interactions.explanation: Rules 110-113 always write TQS and ETQS together (only if both are unset): IN gets 8, everything else gets 5.

tags.name: EOD price range (PEOD)
tags.description: End-of-day price range. Field 1 is the range: an unparseable value means the algorithm default (WOW 3; scheduled, LINE and passive 1; others 2). The order's aggression is added and the result is multiplied by field 2 (scale). Field 3 is the price base: 0 = quote, 1 = last trade. No caller of the accessor was found in this source tree (it may be consumed by code that is not in the repo), so the effect on the order is not confirmed.
tags.default: range by algorithm (WOW 3 / scheduled,LINE,passive 1 / else 2) + aggression; scale 1; base 0 (quote)

tags.name: Portfolio level (PORT)
tags.description: Forces portfolio-level handling on (1) or off (0). If unset (-1), the order is portfolio-level when compound_algo_mode=5, when the algorithm is a portfolio algo, when cash balancing is on, or when a portfolio/compound tracker is active. A value > 0 also stops the order from being split (canSplit=false). Portfolio algos and cash orders can never be split, whatever PORT says.

interactions.title: PORT is forced to 1 by prorate mode (261) and portfolio dollar cap (388)
interactions.explanation: Parsing tag 261 with prorate_mode>0, or tag 388 with a non-zero portfolio dollar cap, sets _portfolio_level=1, and 388 also sets do_cash_ope=1. Rule 506 sets PORT=1 when prorate_mode>0 (algoEnv!=APIL/APIM). Whichever is parsed last wins.

interactions.title: PORT=0 overrides the algorithm's portfolio-level default
interactions.explanation: isPortfolioLevel returns PORT==1 as soon as PORT>=0, so PORT=0 turns off portfolio-level handling even for portfolio algos. canSplit still returns false for those algos.

tags.name: Minimum value schedule (MVAL)
tags.description: Piecewise minimum-value table. Values are in USD and converted to the stock's currency at parse time: v0[,t1,v1[,t2,v2...]], where v_i is the value that applies above threshold t_i (t0=0). The tag is dropped if no USD->currency rate exists. The accessors (minval_values/minval_thresholds/minvals) have no caller in this source tree, so how the engine uses the table is not confirmed.
tags.default: unset; ai.fixmsg.properties supplies market defaults (e.g. 1,1,1 for China/IN, 250,5000,500 for IJ, 500,5000,1000 or 10 by avgTradeCount)

example.explanation: Value 500 USD below a 5000 USD threshold, 1000 USD above it (converted to local currency).

interactions.title: Config fills MVAL by market / trade count
interactions.explanation: Rules 121-125 set MVAL when it is absent (China/IN 1,1,1; IJ 250,5000,500; else 500,5000,1000 if avgTradeCount>1000, otherwise 10). Rule 457 forces MVAL=1 for TT ODDONLY. The trigger shows the guard as evaluated before the rule writes.

tags.name: Min value residual / rounding (MVR)
tags.description: Field 1 (residual factor, capped at 0.95, default 0.7): when the scheduler's small custom candidates are blocked, the preferred minimum size is lowered to factor x workable shares. Field 2 (round_hardsize, default 1): a goal increment smaller than preferred min size x factor is not issued (OrderRegulation resets must-make; Candidate uses it as the hard-size floor). Field 3 (round_maxsize, default 0, never above field 2): the floor for long-lived post candidates, based on the rounded post/take size.

tags.name: Cash catch-up duration (CDUR)
tags.description: Stores a cash catch-up duration (long; unit not stated). No caller of the accessor was found in this source tree (it may be consumed by code that is not in the repo), so the effect on the order is not confirmed.

tags.name: Odd-lot bunch period (OB)
tags.description: Minutes before the continuous-session end. Inside this window, for stocks with a round lot > 1, the order is allowed odd lots: the odd-lot remainder (size - must-make) mod round lot is added to the must-make goal so the residual odd lot trades together with the last round lots. 0 = off.

example.explanation: In the last 5 minutes of continuous trading, add the odd-lot residual to the goal.

tags.name: Primary post weight (PPW)
tags.description: Weight for posting on the primary venue, with an optional second field for dual-listed stocks. Negative or unset means the OEO config value for the algorithm. If only field 1 is given, the dual weight is reset to config. No caller of the accessor was found in this source tree (it may be consumed by code that is not in the repo), so the effect on the order is not confirmed.

tags.name: Auction reject as ND (AUCND)
tags.description: Chile close handling: when a limit order is rejected after the close (handleChileCloseReject), a value > 0 rejects the parent with error SEND_ND_AUCTION instead of AUCTION_CLOSED (message 'cannot create MOC orders').

interactions.title: Changes the Chile close reject reason
interactions.explanation: Only changes the error type of the reject (SEND_ND_AUCTION vs AUCTION_CLOSED). The reject itself happens anyway for limit orders after the Chile close.

tags.name: Max schedule deviation (MAXSD)
tags.description: Largest allowed deviation from the schedule for scheduled algos, as a fraction. Effective value = MAXSD x max(0.01, 1 + prof_dev_aggr), and 0 whenever impact_profile_mode > 0. MAXSD=0 turns off schedule-deviation control in CandidateRegulator and changes several end-time and would decisions in ConcertStrategy. Together with MINSD it forms a band that is widest at mid-schedule. Unlike the config value, a fixmsg value > 1 is not divided by 100.

interactions.title: MAXSD forced to 0 with impact profile mode
interactions.explanation: max_schedule_deviation() returns 0.0 whenever impact_profile_mode() > 0, whatever MAXSD says.

interactions.title: MAXSD=0 disables schedule-deviation control
interactions.explanation: CandidateRegulator only applies the deviation band when max_schedule_deviation()>0. With 0, MINSD has no effect, and ConcertStrategy treats end-time checks as always within threshold. Client templates (88=SgaMoc/GSFL*/GSBL*/GGS*) and KS/MK short-sell rules set MAXSD=0.

tags.name: Min schedule deviation (MINSD)
tags.description: Smallest schedule deviation, used at the start and end of the schedule. The band is d = MINSD + (MAXSD - MINSD) x 2 x min(s, 1-s), where s is schedule progress, and both values are scaled by max(0.01, 1 + prof_dev_aggr). Only used when MAXSD > 0.

interactions.title: MINSD ignored when MAXSD=0
interactions.explanation: The deviation band (CandidateRegulator:814) is computed inside the branch gated by max_schedule_deviation()>0.

tags.name: Post fraction (PFRAC)
tags.description: Fraction (clamped to 0..1) of the goal's stop-make size kept on lit posts when the strategy moves size to dark/midpoint (price in mid, or in spread with represent_dark_within_spread). The fraction becomes 1 during post/dark rotation (PDR inside its duration window) and when finishing an odd lot.

interactions.title: PDR rotation overrides PFRAC to 1.0
interactions.explanation: When post_dark_rotation_mode()>0 and the goal duration is within [min,max] duration, post_fraction is set to 1.0.

tags.name: Dark chase factor (DCL)
tags.description: Replenish size when chasing dark liquidity after fills. f > 1: f x the size of the last fills (capped at available shares). 0 < f <= 1: f x available shares. <= 0: all available shares. The result is split across the dark allocations and kept between a reasonable chunk size and the max size.

tags.name: Post chase factor (PCL)
tags.description: Replenish size for lit posts after fills (PostWorker.tryReplenish). f > 1: f x the last fill size. 0 < f <= 1: f x usable shares. Always at least the allocation min size and at most usable shares. If too few shares are available, live posts are freed (CHASE_LIQUIDITY).

tags.name: Dark ping mode (DPM)
tags.description: Dark-ping behaviour. Field 1 (mode): 0 = the dark ping limit comes from the scheduler's darkPingPrice candidate price, otherwise from DPP; 3 = route to DARKPING venues before taking (the code comment pairs it with 152=1^25=0 for GMO2); 4 = dark pings without a base dark exchange (ping allocations are built from all ping venues); <= 0 turns off periodic pings of resting dark orders. Field 2 (periodic_darkping): > 0 turns on periodic pinging and sets the maximum number of simultaneous dark-ping allocations in the take worker; 1 also blocks non-chase pings in shouldPing.

allowedValues.meaning: default; dark ping price from scheduler candidate
dark pings without base dark exchange

interactions.title: Periodic pings need DPM>0 and periodic>0; DPI sets the interval
interactions.explanation: LCWorker only sends periodic pings when darkping_mode()>0 and periodic_darkping()>0. The interval between pings is max(DPI interval, DPI factor x ref min duration).

tags.name: Dark ping interval (DPI)
tags.description: Minimum time between dark pings for the same order/venue: max(field 1 seconds, field 2 x the reference minimum duration). Used for periodic pings and for non-chase pings in shouldPing.

interactions.title: DPI only matters when dark pinging is on
interactions.explanation: The interval is checked only on the periodic ping path (DPM>0, periodic>0) and the shouldPing path.

tags.name: Allowed scheduler tags (AST)
tags.description: Per-order list of the 9012 tags the scheduler may change while the order runs. It is parsed with AlgoConfig.parseAllowedSchedulerTags and merged over the config allowed_scheduler_tags (order entries win). CandidateProcessor.update9012Tags blocks tags marked disallow, and blocks client-supplied tags unless their entry says respectClient=false.

interactions.title: Config sets AST=PPL~2 for LINE
interactions.explanation: Rule 365 writes AST=PPL~2 for every LINE order (no null-guard), replacing any client AST.

tags.name: Allow scheduler venue (ASV)
tags.description: Lets the scheduler choose venues (int). No caller of the accessor was found in this source tree (it may be consumed by code that is not in the repo), so the effect on the order is not confirmed.

tags.name: Sub-system reject propagates to parent (SRP)
tags.description: Map from error type to flag (parsed with AlgoConfig.setStrIntMap; keys are OrderErrorType.toSimpleString()). When a sub-system (child) order is rejected with an error whose value is > 0, the parent order is rejected too. Empty or 'null' means the config map (subsys_reject_parent, which also depends on the relay algorithm) is used.

interactions.title: Child reject can reject the parent
interactions.explanation: If subsys_reject_parent(error)>0, or the stock is closed, or it is past the final close, the parent sysorder is rejected with the child's error.

tags.name: Min-size limits (MSP)
tags.description: Six bounds for the minimum slice size: order-pct min,max; N-minute ADV min,max; average-trade-size factor min,max. Negative or unset means the config maps per composite exchange and algorithm (all 0 by default). No caller of the accessor was found in this source tree (it may be consumed by code that is not in the repo), so the effect on the order is not confirmed.

tags.name: Volume smooth mode (VSM)
tags.description: Volume-smoothing mode for the order's market statistics (OrderMarketStat). When > 0, the delayed quote size is capped at the delayed queue size.

tags.name: Volume smooth timeframe scale (VST)
tags.description: Multiplier on the time frame used to smooth volume in OrderMarketStat (applied when > 0).

tags.name: Out-order delay (OOD)
tags.description: Milliseconds. When an order is rejected later (rejectLater) after the stock has closed, and it still has live OEX/flex leaves after the cancel was sent, the engine sends an 'out' for the system order once this many ms have passed since the cancel. 0 = never.

tags.name: Moving-average VWAP (UMA)
tags.description: Publishes short moving-average prices into the order market-data map used by the scheduler: n >= 2 adds the 2-minute MA price/VWAP (st_p2, st_vwap2), and n >= 5 adds the 5-minute values (and so on).

tags.name: Split/merge order queue (MQ)
tags.description: In the send-work-order thread, relay-algo parents process their live sub-orders together, and sub-orders are skipped on their own.

tags.name: Keep dead order (IDO)
tags.description: Milliseconds to keep a completed order in the closed-order book. >= 0 adds it to the book; > 0 removes it after that many ms; a negative value (above -100) means it is not kept.

tags.name: Scale reject factor (SCR)
tags.description: Risk check for SCALE relay orders: the scale start/end price is checked against the benchmark with this factor plus a tick limit (field 2, max ticks). On failure the order is rejected with INVALIDSCALE ('scale start:...').

interactions.title: SCALE order rejected when scale price is too far from the market
interactions.explanation: checkLimitPrice(price, bench, SCR factor, ticks, SCR maxticks) fails -> rejectOrderAndNotify(INVALIDSCALE) and a LimitFarFromMarket alert.

tags.name: Skip OEO participation-rate check (NPR)
tags.description: 1 skips the OEO participation-rate check (CandidateRegulator.checkPartRate returns at once); 0 forces the check. Unset uses the algorithm default (Algorithm.noOEOCheckPartRate).

interactions.title: Config sets NPR=1 for China and client templates
interactions.explanation: Rule 594 sets NPR=1 for C1/C2/CH when not set. The SgaMoc/GSFL/GSBL/GGS templates (rules 316-341) always set NPR=1.

tags.name: Post-loud ADV threshold (PLA)
tags.description: ADV threshold for loud (displayed) posting. The post worker only posts loud when the stock ADV (plus dual-listing ADV when dual_trade is set) is >= PLA. In NA with lava_post_blind, a stock below PLA gets POSTBLIND aggression. Values >= 0 are raised to at least 0.1.

tags.name: Cancel order flag (CANCEL)
tags.description: Integer cancel-order flag. No caller of the accessor was found in this source tree (it may be consumed by code that is not in the repo), so the effect on the order is not confirmed.

tags.name: Dark price away (DPA)
tags.description: Ticks from the reference used to price dark orders. Default for SHADOW algos (with shadow_aggression_step>0) is 1 + aggression/step (at least -1); otherwise config dark_price_away=2. A value < -10 on EU SHADOW limit orders at mid-pegged venues switches to the EU shadow pricing (priceEUShadow).

algorithmDependent.behavior: default derived from aggression; < -10 enables EU shadow pricing at mid venues

tags.name: Preprocessor mode (PPM)
tags.description: Preprocessor mode (int). No caller of the accessor was found in this source tree (it may be consumed by code that is not in the repo), so the effect on the order is not confirmed.

tags.name: Allow open before start (OBS)
tags.description: Allows auction-open orders even if the order's start time is later than the earliest open auction. 1 = MOO, 2 = PM-session open (MOOPM), 3 = both. Without it, MOO/MOOPM work orders are not created before the start time, and the MOO candidate's issue time is moved to the start time.

interactions.title: Config sets OBS=1 with OCTC
interactions.explanation: Rules 577/581 set OBS=1 when OCTC=1 or 2 and EO!=1. Rule 581's environment filter is a bare token with no field (conflict C-05).

tags.name: Ignore dark limit (IDL)
tags.description: 1 ignores the scheduler's 'darklimit' candidate price, so dark orders are not limited by it. Unset uses the algorithm default (noDarkLimit). Always false (limit honoured) when dark_limit_price_mode > 0.
tags.default: algorithm default; ai.fixmsg.properties:592 sets 1 when absent (algoEnv!=APIL/APIM)

interactions.title: IDL ignored when dark limit price mode is set
interactions.explanation: ignore_dark_limit() returns false at once if _dark_limit_price_mode>0.

interactions.title: Config defaults IDL=1
interactions.explanation: Rule 592 writes IDL=1 when IDL is not set, outside APIL/APIM.

tags.name: Ignore scheduler halt (ISH)
tags.description: Ignore halts coming from the scheduler (int). No caller of the accessor was found in this source tree (it may be consumed by code that is not in the repo), so the effect on the order is not confirmed.

tags.name: Compound VWAP mode 1 child tags (CVM1)
tags.description: 9012 tag string for the child order in compound-VWAP mode 1 (CompoundVWAPTracker.algo(1)). '|' in the value becomes '^' so it can carry several sub-tags. Without it, RelayConfig compoundvwap_mode1_str is used; used as is.

example.explanation: Child order tags for mode 1.

tags.name: Compound VWAP mode 2 child tags (CVM2)
tags.description: 9012 tag string for the child order in compound-VWAP mode 2 (CompoundVWAPTracker.algo(2)). '|' in the value becomes '^' so it can carry several sub-tags. Without it, RelayConfig compoundvwap_mode2_str is used; the engine appends the high rate and '^6=' + cap, so a custom value should end with the matching '5=' or '6='.

example.explanation: Child order tags for mode 2.

tags.name: Compound VWAP mode 3 child tags (CVM3)
tags.description: 9012 tag string for the child order in compound-VWAP mode 3 (CompoundVWAPTracker.algo(3)). '|' in the value becomes '^' so it can carry several sub-tags. Without it, RelayConfig compoundvwap_mode3_str is used; the engine appends the low rate, so a custom value should end with the matching '5=' or '6='.

example.explanation: Child order tags for mode 3.

tags.name: Compound VWAP mode 4 child tags (CVM4)
tags.description: 9012 tag string for the child order in compound-VWAP mode 4 (CompoundVWAPTracker.algo(4)). '|' in the value becomes '^' so it can carry several sub-tags. Without it, RelayConfig compoundvwap_mode4_str is used; used as is.

example.explanation: Child order tags for mode 4.

tags.name: Max simultaneous posts (MPO)
tags.description: Largest number of venues posted at the same time. The DMA/DLP strategies pack posts with it (VenuePacker) and limit live posts to it. <= 0 means the OEO config value is used.

interactions.title: Config defaults MPO=1 for SDMA
interactions.explanation: Rule 273 sets MPO=1 for SDMA (if not set and 245!=2); rule 34 sets MPO=8 for C1/C2/CH; the KS short-sell template (rule 590) sets MPO=5 unconditionally.

tags.name: Max simultaneous pegs (MPE)
tags.description: Largest number of peg orders at the same time (PegWorker). <= 0 means the OEO config value is used.

tags.name: Initial number of posts (IPO)
tags.description: Number of venues sampled for the first posts (Statics.sampleVenues in PostWorker). <= 0 means the OEO config value is used.

tags.name: OEO strategy override (OEOS)
tags.description: Chooses the OEO execution strategy type by name, instead of the default strategy for the algorithm (config algoStrategy(algorithm)). ExecutionOptimizer creates that strategy if it is valid. An unknown name sets the error 'unknown oeo strategy'.

interactions.title: Unknown OEOS name -> 'unknown oeo strategy'
interactions.explanation: StrategyType.getStrategy(val) not valid -> _err_msg='unknown oeo strategy' (the parse error is reported as an order error) and the strategy falls back to config.

interactions.title: OEOS overrides the algorithm's default strategy
interactions.explanation: algoStrategy() returns the OEOS strategy, and only falls back to Util.config().algoStrategy(algorithm) when it is not set.

tags.name: Ignore candidate-info keys (ICK)
tags.description: Keys removed from the scheduler's candidate-info map for this order before it is processed (parsed with AlgoConfig.setStringMap). When empty, the config ignore_cinfor_keys is used.

tags.name: Wait for candidate info (WCI)
tags.description: If > 0, the strategy does nothing (no goal is issued) until the first candidate-info map arrives from the scheduler.

tags.name: Min-fill reject threshold (MFR)
tags.description: Validation threshold, as a fraction of order size. The order is rejected if its MinFill (min exec) quantity, or its IOI min fill, is more than MFR x order size. 0 turns the check off.
tags.default: config minfill_reject_threshold: 0.75 in NA region, 0 elsewhere

interactions.title: Order rejected when min fill > MFR x size
interactions.explanation: checkForError returns 'MinFill Qty Greater Than X of Order Size' (or IOIMinFill ...) and the order is rejected.

tags.name: Would take venue (WTV)
tags.description: Venue name that replaces the venue of would-lit custom candidates that take liquidity (CustomCandidate WOULD).
tags.default: config would_take_venue by composite exchange (AGGR_PING or empty)

tags.name: Min-size max part-rate (MPR)
tags.description: Mode and factor for min-size based on max participation rate. No caller of the accessor was found in this source tree (it may be consumed by code that is not in the repo), so the effect on the order is not confirmed.

tags.name: Stop MOC after close (SCM)
tags.description: Stops new MOC orders once the stock has closed. If the stock has a close time after the closing-auction begin, MOC creation (FlexOrderStream) and the auction worker stop sending when mode > 1, or when mode = 1 and the market has no trade-after-close, and the time is past auction begin + buffer (field 2, ms). 0 turns this off.

allowedValues.meaning: only if market has no trade-after-close

interactions.title: Config sets SCM=0 for TT odd-lot-only
interactions.explanation: Rule 457 writes SCM=0 (with 328, 245, AMAA, MSP, MVAL) for exchange TT ODDONLY orders.

tags.name: OPE cash exclude (OCX)
tags.description: Lets MOC (1), MOO (2) or both (3) candidates skip the delayed pair/cash-balance (imbalance) processing in CandidateProcessor.delayProcessCandidate.

tags.name: Queue with maxsize (QWM)
tags.description: If > 0 (and queue_mode > 0 with a valid quote), queue candidates are sized from the goal's remaining stop-make size.

interactions.title: QWM needs queue mode
interactions.explanation: Only applied when _parameters.queue_mode()>0 and the quote is valid.

tags.name: Take price away (TPA)
tags.description: Four price-away settings in ticks: take, aggressive take, aggressive-take duration (ms), odd lot. Unset parts use config (take_price_away=1, takeagg_price_away=1, takeagg_duration, oddlot_price_away map 'BZ 3 0'). The Parameters accessors have no caller in this tree; ExchangeMaster reads takeagg_duration from config, not from this tag. So the effect is not confirmed.

tags.name: Scale relay-to algo (SRA)
tags.description: Algorithm used for the child orders that RelayScheduler creates for each active bucket of a SCALE relay order.

interactions.title: SCALE children run as SRA algorithm
interactions.explanation: relayScaleAlgoOrder(sorder, bucket, scale_relayto_algo()) creates each bucket's child with this algorithm (SDMA by default).

tags.name: MOC limit type (LCT)
tags.description: How the MOC limit is set. 10 skips the limit-fraction logic. For m > 0 the auction worker waits for a latest quote with a valid reference limit (unless near the cutoff). m = 1/3 caps the fraction at the exchange's dynamic limit %. m > 1 adds reference-limit pricing. It is also passed into the close limit-price computation.

interactions.title: Config sets LCT=4 for HK and IN
interactions.explanation: Rules 168/169 (HK, except non-ETF short sells), 636 and 661 (IN, no close VWAP duration) set LCT=4 when absent.

tags.name: Strict end-time buffer (SEB)
tags.description: Milliseconds. If >= 10000, a day work order that would cover all workable shares while more than SEB remains to the raw end time is closed (CLOSE_AVOID_EARLY_FINISH) when the order has no would feature. This stops the order finishing early. SEB=0 turns the guard off.
tags.default: config strict_endtime_allowed_buffer (0) for strict-end-time algos, else 0

interactions.title: Config sets SEB=0 widely (short sells, templates)
interactions.explanation: Many rules write SEB=0 (HK/JP/KS/MK/TB short sells, client templates GSFL/GSBL/GGS, passive_only VWAP/TMX, IN SG), so the early-finish guard is off for those orders. Some MK/KS SEB rules are unreachable (conflicts C-06/C-07).

tags.name: Min/max smoothing (SMP)
tags.description: Sample period (seconds -> ms) and weight count used by the quote stream for min/max price smoothing (WombatQuoteStream).

tags.name: Adjust pair state (APS)
tags.description: For pair orders, a value > 0 makes CandidateProcessor call adjustPairState(cmap, mode) on the leg candidates.

tags.name: Previous-close no-feed mode (PCM)
tags.description: 1 = do not use the feed previous close for the stock itself (the order then needs its own stock object). 2 = do not use the feed close for index/reference symbols of trackers (stock.setUseFeedClose(0)). 3 = both.

allowedValues.meaning: stock prev close not from feed
index/reference prev close not from feed

interactions.title: Config sets PCM=1 for IPOs
interactions.explanation: Rule 307 writes PCM=1 for IPO stocks when absent.

tags.name: Adjust open imbalance (AIM)
tags.description: Turns on imbalance-based adjustment of the open auction order: field 1 for MOO, field 2 for MOOPM (field 2 defaults to field 1).

tags.name: Use min-duration venues (VMD)
tags.description: With 0, venues that have a minimum resting duration > 1 s (other than IOI venues) are excluded. With 1, they may be used. The default depends on config min_duration_venue_usage_mode: 0 = off; 1/2/3 = NINJA/SHADOW with aggression 1; 101/102/110 = basket ids starting with X; 10 = always.
tags.default: derived from config min_duration_venue_usage_mode (default 0 -> not used)

interactions.title: Config sets VMD=1 for China
interactions.explanation: Rule 35 writes VMD=1 for C1/C2/CH when absent.

tags.name: Grab as would (GAW)
tags.description: If > 0, grab executions are counted with would executions in the order-info figures sent to the scheduler (make_iwould, dollar_iwould, make_iwouldlit).

tags.name: Odd-lot leave, no reject (OLNR)
tags.description: Odd-lot residual handling. If > 0 and the order has leaves, it is not rejected for an odd-lot remainder (ExchangeMaster.rejectOddLot). It also blocks cancelling a work order whose remainder is an odd lot: mode 1 always, mode 2 only on POST venues. Near the close, field 2 (auction buffer, ms before pre-close begin) lifts the block when the order goes to the close.

interactions.title: CNOLNR=1 forces OLNR=0 for China sells
interactions.explanation: Rule 618 writes OLNR=0 for C1/C2/CH sell orders that carry CNOLNR=1.

tags.name: Check order-holder time (OHT)
tags.description: Drops scheduler candidates that are older than the order holder's last update. 1 uses the global processCandidateHoldersTime; > 1 first uses the per-order t_orderholder.

tags.name: Must-complete max-rate fraction (MCMR)
tags.description: For must-complete orders, the regulator only maximizes completion when remaining shares <= MCMR x max (lit) participation x remaining volume (including expected close volume when the close is used).

interactions.title: MCMR only for must-complete orders
interactions.explanation: Gated by _parameters.mustComplete().

tags.name: Dark ping price level (DPP)
tags.description: Price level for the dark-ping limit (Statics.priceAtLevel against bid/ask), never past the combined order limit. Not used when the scheduler gave a darkPingPrice and DPM=0.

tags.name: End-time rollback (ERB)
tags.description: Parsed as seconds (to ms), but only the sign is used in this tree. Any value >= 0 (including 0) turns off the automatic rolled end time, so the schedule runs to the full end time. Unset (-1) lets the engine roll the end back (by participation, market_close_roll_back near the close, or the IIS roll-back for IIS). The amount is ignored.

interactions.title: ERB value ignored; it only turns rollback off
interactions.explanation: Config rules write ERB=120, a random 120-240 (IN SG), 2, 3 or 5 as if it were seconds of rollback. In this tree all of them only turn the automatic rollback off.

tags.name: Reject churning (ROC)
tags.description: Churning limits for posts (field 1) and dark (field 2). No caller of the accessor was found in this source tree (it may be consumed by code that is not in the repo), so the effect on the order is not confirmed.

tags.name: SOR dark mode (SORDM)
tags.description: SOR dark mode (int). No caller of the accessor was found in this source tree (it may be consumed by code that is not in the repo), so the effect on the order is not confirmed.

tags.name: Stop post before close (SPB)
tags.description: Seconds before the continuous-session end at which the strategy stops posting: the post and midpoint workers are stopped with STOP_TO_FINISH. This only happens if the order is must-complete or SPBC (1700) > 0, and it can take or SPBC > 0. It is forced to 0 when must_eod is 2 or 3.

interactions.title: SPB needs SPBC or must-complete
interactions.explanation: checkStopPostDark only stops posting when mustComplete() or stop_post_before_close()>0. Rules 393/396 set SPBC=1^SPB=5 for HK and China, and a later rule rewrites SPBC to 2 (conflict C-14).

interactions.title: SPB forced to 0 with must_eod 2/3
interactions.explanation: postpool_zero_before_close() returns 0 when must_eod() is 2 or 3.

tags.name: Stop dark before close (SDB)
tags.description: Seconds before the continuous-session end at which dark is stopped: custom dark candidates are dropped, ConcertStrategy stops dark work, and the take worker sends no more take pings.

tags.name: MOC close buffer (MOCB)
tags.description: Seconds subtracted from the earliest closing-auction time to get the MOC candidate's issue time (never later than pre-close end minus 10 s). It is also used for the MOC reset/timing windows in FlexOrderStream and ConcertStrategy. A negative value issues after the earliest closing auction.

interactions.title: Config sets MOCB for JP and IN
interactions.explanation: Rule 527 sets MOCB=-20 for JP orders with tag 26 (if MOCB/CSLE are absent); rule 653 sets MOCB=200 for IN TMX close orders with no close VWAP duration.

tags.name: Synthetic close start time (ICSS)
tags.description: Start time of the Indian-style synthetic close (VWAP into the close), as a time string. Only used when the config synthetic_close_end_buffer for the exchange is >= 0. IN orders without it get config indian_close_start_str. Other markets fall back to continuous end minus closeVwapDuration. When set, the order is split into IIS/VWAP children (relayIndianCloseOrder) and tries to finish at the close.
tags.default: IN: config indian_close_start_str=17:30; else continuousEnd - closeVwapDuration

interactions.title: Synthetic close splits the order into IIS/VWAP children
interactions.explanation: relayIndianCloseOrder sends an IIS child up to the start stamp and a VWAP child from ICSS to continuous end, with rolled end = ICES.

tags.name: Synthetic close end time (ICES)
tags.description: End time (rolled end) of the Indian-style synthetic close VWAP. IN default is config indian_close_end_str. Otherwise it is continuous end minus synthetic_close_end_buffer seconds. Ignored when the exchange's synthetic_close_end_buffer < 0.
tags.default: IN: config indian_close_end_str=17:58; else continuousEnd - synthetic_close_end_buffer

tags.name: No-dark maxsize restriction (NDMF)
tags.description: Limits the stop/max size when the order has no dark allocations. 'mode,factor': mode 1 = made + int(factor) x (must - made); mode 2 = made + int(factor) x (stop - made); the result is rounded to lots and kept >= must size. A single value sets factor with mode 0, and mode 0 turns the restriction off. The factor is cast to int before multiplying, so fractions are truncated.

allowedValues.meaning: off (also what a single value sets)

interactions.title: Single-value NDMF disables the restriction
interactions.explanation: With a single value the parser sets mode=0, and noDarkRestrictMaxSize returns at once for mode 0. Rule 454 (IN passive_only) writes NDMF=1, which turns the feature off instead of setting factor 1 in the configured mode.

tags.name: Reject DMA with no post venue (RDNP)
tags.description: If > 0, a DMA/NDMA order that has to post but has no post venue is rejected with NO_POST.

interactions.title: No post venue -> NO_POST reject
interactions.explanation: tryMustMakePost with no post allocations calls rejectOrderAndNotify(NO_POST).

interactions.title: Config forces RDNP=1 for SDMA whenever RDNP is present
interactions.explanation: Rule 354 writes RDNP=1 when RDNP!=null and algorithm=SDMA, so a client RDNP=0 on SDMA becomes 1.

tags.name: Cancel min time on market (CMOM)
tags.description: Milliseconds. cancelWorkOrdersExceptMinOnMarket does not cancel work orders that have been on the market for less than this.

tags.name: MOO limit ticks from previous close (LORT)
tags.description: Caps the open-auction order price at previous close +/- N ticks (Statics.limit_price_from_nticks, by side). Active when > -10000. It also turns a market MOO into a LIMIT when the previous close is known. This is separate from LOR, so config can add it even when LOR is present.

interactions.title: Config sets LORT for short sells (HK/KS/TB/JP)
interactions.explanation: Rule 131: HK non-ETF short sells routed HKEX/SG get LORT=0 (limit at previous close). Rules 143/412: KS/TB and JP (regSHO) short sells get LORT=1^331=1.

interactions.title: LORT turns a market MOO into a limit
interactions.explanation: A market OPG order becomes LIMIT when moo_limit_nticks()>-10000 and prevClose>0.

tags.name: Allow uptick at ask (AUAA)
tags.description: Passed to Statics.uptick_limit when the short-sell uptick limit price is computed (work-order pricing, ABSWorker, auction worker). From the name, it allows pricing at the ask under the uptick rule.

tags.name: Min candidate duration (MINCD)
tags.description: Lower bound on the duration of scheduler candidates (applied when > 0).

tags.name: Max candidate duration (MAXCD)
tags.description: Upper bound on the duration of scheduler candidates (applied when > 0).

interactions.title: Config sets MAXCD (IN 15000, TMX 60000)
interactions.explanation: Rule 420 sets 15000 for IN VWAP/TMX and rule 423 sets 60000 for TMX when absent. Rule 465 (IN NOPOST 30000) is unreachable (conflict C-08). Rule 254 sets MAXCD=0 for IN SG.

tags.name: QClose imbalance-change threshold (QCIT)
tags.description: Threshold on the per-share rate of change of the imbalance and of theoretical volume. Above it, the DQTE close logic adjusts the imbalance/theoretical volume used for sizing.

tags.name: EOD take max ticks (ETTM)
tags.description: End-of-day take price allowance (eod take max ticks). A negative value means config. No caller of the accessor was found in this source tree (it may be consumed by code that is not in the repo), so the effect on the order is not confirmed.

tags.name: EOD take spreads (ETS)
tags.description: End-of-day take price allowance (eod take spreads). A negative value means config. No caller of the accessor was found in this source tree (it may be consumed by code that is not in the repo), so the effect on the order is not confirmed.

tags.name: EOD take bps (ETB)
tags.description: End-of-day take price allowance (eod take bps). A negative value means config. No caller of the accessor was found in this source tree (it may be consumed by code that is not in the repo), so the effect on the order is not confirmed.

tags.name: Candidate custom SOR venue (CCSV)
tags.description: Stores a custom SOR venue for candidates. CandidateProcessor reads Util.config().candidate_custom_sor_venue() directly, not the per-order accessor, so this tag appears to have no effect in this tree.

interactions.title: CCSV not read by CandidateProcessor
interactions.explanation: Candidate parsing uses _config.candidate_custom_sor_venue(), not parameters().candidate_custom_sor_venue().

tags.name: Reject if no take venue, pmonitor (RNT)
tags.description: Flag that, by its name and the config comment ('dont reject when VWAP ioi exclusively has no takes or posts'), makes the price monitor reject an order that has no take venues. No caller of the accessor was found in this source tree (it may be consumed by code that is not in the repo), so the effect on the order is not confirmed.

interactions.title: Config defaults RNT=1 (and 0 in templates/IOI)
interactions.explanation: Rule 304 sets RNT=1 when RNT and 173 are absent (non-short, non SHADOW/PEG). Client templates and rule 353 (tag 310 present) set RNT=0, and rule 539 resets it to 0 for use_ioi_exclusively VWAP.

tags.name: Reject if no post venue, pmonitor (RNP)
tags.description: Flag that, by its name and the config comment ('dont reject when VWAP ioi exclusively has no takes or posts'), makes the price monitor reject an order that has no post venues. No caller of the accessor was found in this source tree (it may be consumed by code that is not in the repo), so the effect on the order is not confirmed.

interactions.title: Config defaults RNP=1
interactions.explanation: Rule 305 sets RNP=1 when absent (OTAG!=NOPOST, not SHADOW); rule 540 resets it to 0 for use_ioi_exclusively.

tags.name: Post/dark rotation (PDR)
tags.description: Runs post and dark one after the other. With mode > 0, the strategy posts first for fraction x (goal duration - lead time), then moves shares to dark (tryRotatePostDark). This only applies to goals whose duration is within [min, max] ms, and in that window the post fraction is 1. Mode is forced to 0 if the fraction is not in (0,1], a duration is <= 0, or use_ioi_exclusively is set.

interactions.title: PDR off when IOI-only
interactions.explanation: post_dark_rotation_mode() returns 0 when use_ioi_exclusively() or the fraction/durations are invalid.

tags.name: DQTE market-order theo-price ticks (DMOTN)
tags.description: If > 0, within valid_time_theop_before_close of the continuous end, the QClose worker prices against the indicative auction price (theop) using this many ticks.

tags.name: Original client order id (CI)
tags.description: Original client order id, kept for reference. No caller of the accessor was found in this source tree (it may be consumed by code that is not in the repo), so the effect on the order is not confirmed.

tags.name: Original client algo (CA)
tags.description: Original client algorithm name. Used as the algorithm name in alerts (alertAlgorithm) unless AAM is 1 or 2.

interactions.title: AAM 1/2 takes precedence over CA in alerts
interactions.explanation: alertAlgorithm returns the engine algorithm (AAM=1) or tag 9001 (AAM=2) before it looks at CA.

tags.name: Min duration ratio for block hard size (MINBH)
tags.description: Duration ratio for block hard size (only values > 0 override config). No caller of the accessor was found in this source tree (it may be consumed by code that is not in the repo), so the effect on the order is not confirmed.

tags.name: Max duration ratio for block hard size (MAXBH)
tags.description: Duration ratio for block hard size (only values > 0 override config). No caller of the accessor was found in this source tree (it may be consumed by code that is not in the repo), so the effect on the order is not confirmed.

tags.name: Min size capped at round lot (MSRLS)
tags.description: If > 0, a venue's min size and min exec size are capped at the stock's round lot, but never below the venue's true min size.

tags.name: Take ping probability (TPNGP)
tags.description: Probability (0..1) that a take ping / dark ping attempt is made on a given cycle (Math.random() < p). Never in EOD.

tags.name: Min-participation catch-up duration (MPCD)
tags.description: Seconds given to catch up to min participation. The regulator sets the time upper bound to now + MPCD, sets the lower size bounds and forces a take (when in the money).

tags.name: Market-order lock-in open mode (MOLOO)
tags.description: For VF-type exchanges where only limit auction orders are accepted during lock-in: 1 = use lock-in time as the pre-open end, so market orders stop before lock-in (pre-open period cut to preOpenLimitOnly); 0 = use lock-out time. Only values > 0 override config, so 0 cannot switch off a config value of 1.

allowedValues.meaning: lock-out time (only if config is not 1)

interactions.title: MOLOO=0 does not override config
interactions.explanation: market_order_lockin_open_mode() returns the tag only if > 0; otherwise config (1 for VWAP/TMX).

tags.name: Market-order lock-in close mode (MOLOC)
tags.description: For VF-type exchanges where only limit auction orders are accepted during lock-in: 1 = use lock-in time as the pre-close end, so market orders stop before lock-in (pre-close period cut to preCloseLimitOnly); 0 = use lock-out time. Only values > 0 override config, so 0 cannot switch off a config value of 1.

allowedValues.meaning: lock-out time (only if config is not 1)

interactions.title: MOLOC=0 does not override config
interactions.explanation: market_order_lockin_close_mode() returns the tag only if > 0; otherwise config (1 for VWAP/TMX).

tags.name: Alert algorithm mode (AAM)
tags.description: Which algorithm name goes into alerts: 0 = client input (CA, then original/client algo), 1 = the algorithm the engine runs, 2 = tag 9001.

tags.name: Ref-quote aggressive limit (RQLA)
tags.description: If > 0, the final work-order price is capped at refAsk + RQLA (buy) or refBid - RQLA (sell), and never past the current ask/bid.

tags.name: EOD display size max % ADV (EODDA)
tags.description: EOD display size max % ADV (values > -1 override config). No caller of the accessor was found in this source tree (it may be consumed by code that is not in the repo), so the effect on the order is not confirmed.

tags.name: EOD display size quote-size multiple (EODDQ)
tags.description: EOD display size quote-size multiple (values > -1 override config). No caller of the accessor was found in this source tree (it may be consumed by code that is not in the repo), so the effect on the order is not confirmed.

tags.name: Pair deal input side (PDIS)
tags.description: Side ('B...' or 'S...', upper-cased) the pair deal inputs were given for. For PAIR orders, if it starts with B and pair_direction_mode=0, or with S and mode=1, the two legs' ratios, cash amounts and cash units are swapped.

interactions.title: PDIS can swap pair legs
interactions.explanation: Swaps _pair_ratio1/2, _pair_cash1/2 and the cash units depending on pair_direction_mode.

tags.name: Prefer inverted take (PIT)
tags.description: Prefer inverted (taker-rebate) venues when taking. No caller of the accessor was found in this source tree (it may be consumed by code that is not in the repo), so the effect on the order is not confirmed.

tags.name: Test random min-exec factor (TRMEF)
tags.description: Testing aid. With this probability, a work order's min exec size is replaced by a random size up to TRMES (when both are > 0 and the min exec size is <= round lot).

tags.name: Test random min-exec size (TRMES)
tags.description: Testing aid: upper bound for the random min exec size used with TRMEF.

tags.name: Prevent flip to EOD
tags.description: When > 0, the Concert strategy does not 'flip' the order into end-of-day (EOD) mode near the close: the EOD transition returns without setting the EOD flag. It also disables purestream EOD mode 1 (purestream_eod_mode() returns 0 when PFEOD>0).

example.explanation: Order stays in its normal mode through the close instead of switching to EOD aggressive completion.

interactions.title: PFEOD disables purestream EOD mode 1
interactions.explanation: purestream_eod_mode() returns 0 when purestream EOD mode (tag 393) is 1 and PFEOD>0, so the purestream EOD behaviour is switched off.

tags.name: Reject invalid volume profile
tags.description: Controls what happens when the order's volume profile fails validation (profile.checkValid() returns an error). >0 enables handling; value 2 replaces a non-default invalid profile with the 'Default<profileGroup>' profile and recomputes. Other positive values follow the reject path in FlexOrderStream (the code after the mode-2 branch).

allowedValues.meaning: fall back to Default<profileGroup> profile when current profile is not already a default one

interactions.title: Invalid volume profile may reject the order
interactions.explanation: With RPROF>0 an invalid volume profile triggers error handling; mode 2 substitutes the default profile instead.

tags.name: Adjust volume-auction leave fill
tags.description: Bitmask telling the volume-profile update to account for auction fills/leaves: bit 1 (1) = close (uses on-close leaves once past pre-close/continuous end), bit 2 (2) = opening auction fills, bit 4 (4) = PM opening auction fills. The resulting fractions are fed into profile.setVolumeFrac(moo, moopm, moc).

example.explanation: Adjust profile for both open and close auction fills.

tags.name: Auction order split count
tags.description: Number of child orders an auction worker splits the auction quantity into (AuctionWorker nsplit). For the 'ia' worker, ia_nsplit overrides it, and it is raised if size exceeds max MOO/market order size; it is capped by max_simul_auction (MSAU).

interactions.title: AUNS capped by MSAU
interactions.explanation: nsplit = min(max_simul_auction - live auction orders, nsplit); if <1 no auction order is sent.

interactions.title: Config sets AUNS=1 with DLP conversion
interactions.explanation: ai.fixmsg.properties writes 1=DLP^104=1^AUNS=1 for SDMA/DMA limit orders started after close-start when USEDLP=1/2.

interactions.title: India default AUNS=2
interactions.explanation: For India market orders without close VWAP, config sets AUNS=2 if not already set.

tags.name: Dark chase exclude venues
tags.description: Comma-separated list of venue ids to exclude when the dark (LC) worker chases/allocates to dark venues; allocations whose exchange id is in the list are filtered out.

example.explanation: Do not chase into these dark venue ids.

tags.name: Imbalance-open offset buffer
tags.description: Seconds before the open auction start at which the imbalance-open (imbo) worker starts working (start = max(start, openStart - buffer)); also applied to OpenWorker instances whose id contains 'imbo'. Input in seconds, stored in ms.

tags.name: Valid theoretical open price time before open
tags.description: Seconds before the opening auction (or limit cutoff) from which the indicative/theoretical open price is considered valid by the OpenWorker (_valid_theop_time is moved earlier by this amount). Input seconds, stored ms.

tags.name: Valid theoretical open price time before PM open
tags.description: Same as VTTBO but for the afternoon (PM) opening auction: shifts the OpenWorker's valid theoretical-price time earlier by this many seconds.

tags.name: Valid theoretical close price time before close
tags.description: Seconds before continuous end within which a DQTE/QClose market (zero-limit) auction order may be priced off the indicative auction price plus N ticks (dqte_market_order_theop_ntick, tag 1636 DMOTN). Before that window the market auction order is not generated.

interactions.title: VTTBC only used with DMOTN
interactions.explanation: The window is checked only when dqte_market_order_theop_ntick > 0 and the auction order has no limit price.

tags.name: Reset MOC rate after close
tags.description: When > 0 and the earliest closing auction is within closebuffer, the OPE EOD processing resets the MOC piece to min(available shares, MOC size from evclose - close shares) if nothing is yet on close (log: 'Reset MOC size for RVWAPRELATIVE'). The value is also referenced by config rules as the MOC rate for relative-VWAP orders.

interactions.title: RMRAC used in RVWAPRELATIVE config rule
interactions.explanation: ai.fixmsg.properties:584 builds tag 287 using _param.tag9012("RMRAC") for RVWAPRELATIVE VWAP orders.

tags.name: Late LOC limit ticks
tags.description: Parsed into _lloc_limit_nticks (late limit-on-close limit in ticks) but the accessor lloc_limit_nticks() is not referenced anywhere in the engine source; no effect found.

tags.name: Late LOC limit factor
tags.description: Parsed into _lloc_limit_factor but lloc_limit_factor() is never read in the engine source; no effect found.

tags.name: Late LOC adjustment
tags.description: Seconds (stored ms) for a late limit-on-close adjustment. The accessor late_loc_adj() forces the value to -2 when the AlgoConfig late_loc_adj map for the stock's exQatt is < 1; the field is otherwise only printed in the parameter dump. No functional reader found.

tags.name: Conditional with optional dark
tags.description: For SHADOW-type orders: if no dark pools are available/usable, CWOD>0 switches the order to use conditionals (IOIs) exclusively (sets ioi_mode=2) instead of rejecting with NO_DARKPOOL.

interactions.title: No dark venues: CWOD switches to IOI-only mode
interactions.explanation: When no usable dark venues are found, CWOD>0 sets ioi_mode (tag 57) to 2 = conditionals exclusively.

interactions.title: Without CWOD a shadow order with no dark venues is rejected
interactions.explanation: When npmid==0 and CWOD is not set, the order is rejected with OrderErrorType.NO_DARKPOOL.

tags.name: QClose intraday max rate
tags.description: max_rate[,scale_minutes[,scale_max]]. For non-IIS, non-scheduled algos the DQTE/QClose minimum participation rate is max_rate% (capped by maxPartLevel), scaled up linearly with time-to-close dt: scale = 1 + dt/(scale_minutes*60s)*(scale_max-1), capped at scale_max.

example.explanation: Base 20% close-rate, scaling to 3x when 5+ minutes to close.

algorithmDependent.behavior: ignored; rate from available shares / volume

interactions.title: QCIR ignored for IIS and scheduled algos
interactions.explanation: minpr is 0 for IIS and computed from volume for scheduled algos; QCIR only used otherwise.

tags.name: Stop queue duration
tags.description: Seconds before order end at which the strategy stops queue (queue-position) child orders when in the money or STQOM set. -1 (or any value <= -1) means stop flag is set but queues keep being processed (comment: 'we want to continue processing queues for HK ssh'). Input seconds, stored ms.

allowedValues.meaning: never kill queue orders (HK short sell)

interactions.title: HK short-sell config sets STQD=5
interactions.explanation: Config writes STQD=5^SEB=0^23=0^312=3 for HK short sells (VWAP/TMX), STQD=-1 for other algos.

interactions.title: STQD only acts when in-the-money or STQOM>0
interactions.explanation: The stop-queue check runs only if the order is in the money or stop_queue_oom > 0.

tags.name: Unified open imbalance pricing
tags.description: When > 0, the imbalance-open worker's goal limit uses the order's own limit price instead of the theoretical open price.

tags.name: Open imbalance wait threshold
tags.description: Milliseconds: smart-open logic does nothing until the auction time (min of continuous begin and pre-open end) is within this threshold. Parsed as a raw integer (no seconds conversion).

tags.name: DQTE price mode
tags.description: mode[,price_str]. 0 = follow client limit (NASDAQ uses DMOTN); 1 = use imbalance price as reference and follow DMOTN; 11-19 = compute a DQTE limit from the strike price using price_str, applied when the strike is set (12 also uses the client limit as benchmark when it is better than strike). price_str is an absolute price or a number with suffix B (bps), C (cents) or S (multiples of average spread).

example.explanation: Close auction limit no worse than 10 bps from the strike price.

interactions.title: Spread-based DQTE price without average spread rejects
interactions.explanation: With suffix S and no stock average spread the order is rejected with DQTE_NO_SPRD.

interactions.title: QClose auction orders wait for DQTE price
interactions.explanation: With mode >10 the QClose worker will not create the auction order until a dqte_price has been computed.

tags.name: DQTE reduce mode
tags.description: mode[,min_lots[,chg_pct[,order_pct]]]. Sets the DQTE (close) worker's reduce mode; mode 2 also converts the order to QClose. In reduce mode 3 the auction worker refuses to reduce if the remaining change is smaller than min_lots round lots, chg_pct% of shares left, order_pct% of unfilled size, or theoretical volume change < chg_pct%. If not set (<0), reduce mode 1 is used.

interactions.title: DQRM=2 converts order to QClose
interactions.explanation: Setting reduce mode 2 calls _sysorder.convertQClose().

tags.name: Max take percent
tags.description: Caps aggressive taking to this percent of the order size: in TakeWorker, take size is restricted when (takes + net leaves + new size - grab takes - would takes) exceeds MTP% of order size. Grab and would takes are not counted.

example.explanation: At most 30% of the order may be executed by take orders (excluding grab/would).

tags.name: Apply scheduler MOC limit
tags.description: When > 0, limits supplied by the external scheduler (eodlimit, moclimit, moclimit2, limit2, fairPt/fairPc/nearPc/dayRange/mocRange) are applied to the order; the MOC limit becomes the close auction limit candidate. When > 1, close (CLO/QCLO) work orders other than layer 0 and OPE EOD MOC sending wait until a scheduler MOC limit has been received.

allowedValues.meaning: apply and wait for scheduler MOC limit before sending close orders

interactions.title: ASCL>1 holds MOC until scheduler limit arrives
