interactions.explanation: Close work orders (non layer 0) return -1 and processEOD sets opemoc=0 while SchedMocLimit is not set (when use_dqte<3 and moc_mode==0).

tags.name: Skip legacy DQTE control
tags.description: When >= 1, skips the legacy rule that raises the QClose minimum participation rate to at least availshares/(theov+aimb+vres) (capped at 1); only the QCIR-derived rate is used.

interactions.title: SLDC changes how QCIR rate is floored
interactions.explanation: With SLDC>=1 the QCIR rate is not floored by the available-shares/volume ratio.

tags.name: OMS DB write target debug
tags.description: When = 1, scheduler-supplied limit targets (eodlimit, moclimit, moclimit2, limit2, fairPt, fairPc, nearPc, dayRange, mocRange) are also written to the OMS DB via addOMSTargetDebug. Debug/monitoring only.

interactions.title: TDBG requires ASCL>0
interactions.explanation: The debug writes happen inside the branches gated by apply_scheduler_moclimit()>0.

tags.name: Use up to dark pool count
tags.description: If > 0, sets the dark (LC) worker's venue packer to use at most this many dark pools (VenuePacker.setUseMaxNum).

tags.name: Count grab block as would
tags.description: Flag stored with an AlgoConfig fallback (count_grab_block_as_would), but the accessor is not read anywhere else in the engine source; intended to count grab-block fills as would fills. No effect found.

tags.name: IOI start time delay
tags.description: Delay after the order start before the IOI (conditional) worker begins acting. Accepts a number with optional unit suffix s/m/h (default seconds).

example.explanation: Do not send conditionals during the first 5 minutes of the order.

tags.name: Would post add leave
tags.description: When = 1 and the would percentage is 100, the would-post size includes the currently leaving lit would shares (leaveWouldLit).

interactions.title: Config sets WPAL=0 when tag 385 is set
interactions.explanation: ai.fixmsg.properties writes WPAL=0 if not set and 385 is present; also WPAL=0 for LINE.

tags.name: Index tracking strictness level
tags.description: What to block when the index tracker halts the order (out of line): 1 = block auction work orders; 2 = block all work orders; 3 = block auction orders only when the halt is on the favorable side (CloseWorker stops sending more).

allowedValues.meaning: do not send auction orders when halted
do not send any orders when halted
block auction orders when halted on favorable side

interactions.title: ITSL needs an index tracker
interactions.explanation: Blocking only happens when orderInfo().shouldHalt(INDEXTRACKER) is true, i.e. an index tracker (tag 55) is configured.

tags.name: Passive pricing from quote and last price
tags.description: When > 0, passive (post) prices are computed with Statics.calculate_passive_price_quote_lastprice (from quote and last price) and the work order price is adjusted to that, limited by the order limit; applied in PostWorker, LCWorker and on final price check.

tags.name: QClose worker begin mode
tags.description: 1 = the QClose/DQTE logic does not start until the DQTE pre-close begin time (DQPC); 0 = default.

allowedValues.meaning: do not start until DQPC begin time

tags.name: EOD venue buffer min
tags.description: Minimum time buffer (ms) before continuous end used for EOD set-up: the EOD cutoff buffer is max(EODBN, min(EODBX, cycle delay)); also used for cancel-before-close handling. Overridden by the must-EOD lead time from tag 192 if set.

interactions.title: Must-EOD lead time beats EODBN
interactions.explanation: eod_venue_buffer_min() returns _must_eod_lead_time (from tag 192 second field) when > 0.

tags.name: EOD venue buffer max
tags.description: Maximum buffer (ms) before continuous end at which EOD handling starts: EOD set-up task scheduled at continuousEnd - EODBX, DMA/NDMA strategies enter EOD, candidate processing, relay scheduler and US EOD amendment window use it.

tags.name: Represent dark within spread
tags.description: When > 0, the post/pmid balancing that ensures both dark (pmid) and post representation is also applied when the order is in-spread (not just at mid).

tags.name: Self-cross work order mode
tags.description: mode[,identifier]. Work-order-level self-cross prevention: 0 = no restriction; 1 = debug mode; 2 = no work-order self-cross, no priority; 3 = no self-cross, take orders have priority (cancels existing non-take orders). Identifier replaces clientID/basket as the self-cross grouping id. Mode >=1 also disables multi-order transmission.

allowedValues.meaning: prevent self-cross, take orders have priority

interactions.title: WXM on LINE sets 15=0 and 112=2
interactions.explanation: ai.fixmsg.properties writes 15=0^112=2 when WXM is set on LINE orders.

interactions.title: WXM disables multi-order transmission
interactions.explanation: transmitmulti requires selfcross_workorder_mode < 1.

tags.name: Index tracking MOC margin
tags.description: Margin passed to IndexTracker.safePrice for close/auction (non-day) orders when deriving a safe limit from the index-tracking reference price (MOC, dual close, QClose, auction workers).

interactions.title: ITMM needs an index tracker
interactions.explanation: Only used when an IndexTracker is configured for the order.

tags.name: Index tracking day margin
tags.description: Margin passed to IndexTracker.safePrice for day (continuous) work orders and IOI orders when an index tracker is active.

tags.name: Tag 26 deduct scheduler size
tags.description: When on and a MOC rate (tag 26) is set, the on-close quantity is deducted from the scheduler size and volume fractions use the no-close profile (v12nc/t12nc) when close is not scheduler-driven. Returns false whenever moc_rate()<=0.

interactions.title: T26DS has no effect without tag 26
interactions.explanation: tag26_deduct_scheduler_size() returns moc_rate()>0 && flag.

interactions.title: China PERD rule sets T26DS=1
interactions.explanation: Config writes 26=5^27=1^T26DS=1 for China when PERD=1 and 26 is unset.

interactions.title: RVWAP/RTMX relative rules set T26DS=0
interactions.explanation: Config sets 88=VWAP/TMX^T26DS=0^RPIO=1 for relative VWAP/TMX.

tags.name: Venue cost factor
tags.description: Venue cost weighting factor (float). Parameters exposes venue_cost_factor() with AlgoConfig fallback, but no reader of this accessor exists in the engine source.

tags.name: Venue quality factor
tags.description: Venue quality weighting factor (float); accessor has AlgoConfig fallback but is not read elsewhere in the engine source.

tags.name: Venue quality choice
tags.description: Venue quality choice parameter (float); accessor has AlgoConfig fallback but is not read elsewhere in the engine source.

tags.name: Post cost factor
tags.description: Posting cost factor (float); accessor has AlgoConfig fallback but is not read elsewhere in the engine source.

tags.name: Post fill-rate factor
tags.description: Posting fill-rate factor (float); accessor has AlgoConfig fallback but is not read elsewhere in the engine source.

tags.name: Allow trading on unverified quote
tags.description: When the quote is not 'latest' (stale/unverified), the final price check normally blocks the child order; ATUQ=3 always allows it, other values are passed as a mode to quote.isLatest(true, mode) which may accept the quote.

allowedValues.meaning: always allow trading on unverified quote

tags.name: Post EOD price buffer
tags.description: Milliseconds before continuous end within which posting (POST-level) orders are priced with the EOD price (Statics.eodPrice / computeEODPrice) instead of normal passive pricing.

tags.name: Dark/lit index tracker overwrite
tags.description: When > 0, enables exporting dark/lit limit prices (overwritten by index tracker) to the BBox export (exportDarkLitLimitToBbox); when <= 0 the export is skipped.

tags.name: Stop post before close
tags.description: Controls stopping passive posts before close together with SPB (postpool_zero_before_close, tag 1616): >0 stops posts SPB before continuous end even if the order is not mustComplete and cannot take; value 1 lets posts resume when the order cannot take, value 2 keeps them stopped.

allowedValues.meaning: stop posts before close; may resume if cannot take
stop posts before close; do not resume

interactions.title: SPBC requires SPB
interactions.explanation: Post stopping is gated by postpool_zero_before_close() > 0.

interactions.title: Config sets SPBC=1^SPB=5 for HK/China, later rewritten to SPBC=2
interactions.explanation: L393/L396 set SPBC=1^SPB=5; L615 then rewrites SPBC=1 to 2 (conflict C-14), so 1 is never final there.

tags.name: RVWAP ignore order target
tags.description: When > 0, the participation-tracking ratio in the candidate regulator uses the full order size instead of the scheduler size as target (relative VWAP).

interactions.title: Set to 1 by relative VWAP/TMX rules
interactions.explanation: Config writes RPIO=1 for RVWAPRELATIVE / RTMXRELATIVE.

tags.name: Imbalance volume historical adjustment factor
tags.description: Weight of historical MOC size vs imbalance-based MOC size when estimating close size: est = imb_size + IHAF*(hist_size - imb_size).

tags.name: Strict take check
tags.description: Extra take check against limitLowHigh: 1 = do not take if ask > limit (buy) or bid < limit (sell); 2 = also block when equal (>= / <=).

tags.name: Leave use OEX
tags.description: Boolean flag (>0) exposed as leave_use_oex() with AlgoConfig fallback (default 1 for the flexapiom trading source, else 0), but the accessor is not read elsewhere in the engine source.

tags.name: Reject on take failure (market)
tags.description: When > 0, the parent order is rejected (OrderErrorType.TAKEFAILURE) once take child orders have failed or been rejected too many times on a venue.

interactions.title: Repeated take failures reject the order
interactions.explanation: After takeRetriedTooMany on a venue, RTFM>0 calls rejectOrderAndNotify(TAKEFAILURE).

tags.name: Close trigger value
tags.description: Enables DQTE/QClose close handling even without DQTE market hours: when > 0 the regular market hours are used with the pre-close window from DQPC (tag 1542); 2 = NYSE RVWAP DQTE size at least one round lot (non-Nasdaq); 3 = always rebuild hours from DQPC and enables US EOD amendment like doClose. Also enables index-tracker based close limit (with ITACL) and IOI index tracking.

allowedValues.meaning: use regular hours + DQPC window for close
as 1, and DQTE size >= 1 round lot for non-Nasdaq
always rebuild DQTE hours from DQPC; triggers US EOD amend

interactions.title: CLOSETRIG uses DQPC to define pre-close window
interactions.explanation: With CLOSETRIG>0 and DQPC set, the DQTE pre-close period is rebuilt from continuousEnd minus DQPC values.

interactions.title: CLOSETRIG + ITACL apply index tracker close limit
interactions.explanation: In QClose, the index-tracker target price is applied only when close_trigger_value>0 (ITACL 1 = use target, 2 = safer of the two).

tags.name: Self-cross handle after close
tags.description: When > 0, work-order self-cross checking (WXM) stays active until 5 minutes after continuous end instead of stopping 2 seconds before it.

interactions.title: SHAC needs WXM>=1
interactions.explanation: Self-cross logic returns early when selfcross_workorder_mode < 1.

tags.name: Index track apply close limit
tags.description: Whether the index-tracker safe price (with ITMM margin) is applied as limit for close auction orders: >0 applies it to MOC/dual MOC prices; in QClose with CLOSETRIG, 1 = use the tracker target as the limit, 2 = use the safer of DQTE limit and tracker target. In AuctionWorker, <1 vs >0 selects how market auction orders are limited.

interactions.title: ITACL needs an index tracker
interactions.explanation: checkIndexTrackerMOCPrice only acts when an IndexTracker exists and tracks.

tags.name: Take iceberg size limit (avg N-minute volume)
tags.description: If > 0, take work orders smaller than the average N-minute volume (N = this value) are not turned into icebergs; only larger ones get iceberg display sizing.

tags.name: Step-up MOC lead buffer
tags.description: Milliseconds before the latest close auction within which a step-up MOC order may be sent (0 = no lead restriction).

tags.name: Skip limit-close range
tags.description: When > 0, the MOC limit fraction (LCR, tag 1529 moc_limit_fraction) is set to 0 for close orders when a tick-price candidate is provided / skiplcr is requested, i.e. the close limit range is skipped.

interactions.title: SLCR zeroes LCR
interactions.explanation: With SLCR the moc_limit_fraction used for close pricing becomes 0 when skiplcr/tickprice applies.

tags.name: Max MOC percent of volume
tags.description: Caps MOC order size to this fraction of the expected mean close volume (cap = MCPV * meanclose); also caps the OPE scheduler expected close.

tags.name: ADVIT from first candidate time
tags.description: Parsed into _advit_from_first_candidate_time but the accessor is never read in the engine source; no effect found.

tags.name: Use up to IOI count
tags.description: If > 0, the IOI worker's venue packer uses at most this many IOI/conditional venues.

tags.name: Participation rate monitor close buffer
tags.description: When the order ends at the close, within this buffer (ms) before the end the participation monitor adds expected closing volume to the max participation volume.

tags.name: Limit only on open
tags.description: When > 0, opening auction orders are sent as LIMIT orders (never market).

interactions.title: Config sets LOOO=1 for RLMOO/NRLMOO
interactions.explanation: ai.fixmsg.properties writes LOOO=1 when RLMOO=1 or NRLMOO=1.

tags.name: Close scheduler leftover estimate
tags.description: est[,send_buffer_ms[,close_maxpart[,imb_close_maxpart[,minsize_nrls]]]]. >0 makes OPE estimate leftover shares and send them to the close (doCloseOpe=1); send_buffer = time before pre-close end to submit; close_maxpart = desired % of estimated close volume for extra leftover; imb_close_maxpart enables an imbalance-close slice; minsize_nrls = minimum slice in round lots. Also disables purestream EOD mode 2 when <=0.
tags.default: -1; sendbuffer 0; maxpart 0; minsize from AlgoConfig close_scheduler_leftover_minsize_nrls

interactions.title: CSLE forces OPE close handling
interactions.explanation: doCloseOpe() returns 1 when close_scheduler_leftover_est() > 0.

interactions.title: Japan MOCB default skipped when CSLE set
interactions.explanation: Config sets MOCB=-20 for JP only when CSLE is null; for exchange JT, CSLE is forced to -1.

tags.name: Synthetic close
tags.description: mode[,cap_adv_pct[,cap_value]]: synthetic close mode, cap as % of ADV, and cap value in units of 100000 (optionally prefixed with a 3-letter currency). Parsed, but synthetic_close_* accessors are not read elsewhere in the engine source.

interactions.title: India rule resets SYNC=0
interactions.explanation: ai.fixmsg.properties sets SYNC=0 for India when no close VWAP duration.

tags.name: Preemptive max-part margin
tags.description: When > 0, the computed max participation rate is always divided by the part-rate monitor margin, for all algorithms (normally PART/PART2/PAIR are exempt).

tags.name: Max simultaneous auction orders
tags.description: Maximum number of live auction (non-day) work orders; new auction orders beyond it are not created, auction split and layered close workers are capped by it, and value 1 disables would-close and an extra close path.

interactions.title: MSAU=1 disables would-close
interactions.explanation: tryWouldClose returns immediately when max_simul_auction==1.

tags.name: Stop post threshold
tags.description: pct[,size]: the postblind size adjustment (NINJA/SHADOW minimum post) is skipped once filled fraction exceeds pct or remaining size <= size.

tags.name: At price limit quote size
tags.description: factor[,mode] for quote size at price limit; parsed but accessors not read elsewhere in the engine source.

tags.name: Imbalance venue based on cutoff buffer
tags.description: Milliseconds before open start that defines a regular-open cutoff in the imbalance-open worker; when non-zero, regular OPEN-level venue allocations are set up and used after that cutoff.

tags.name: QClose late LOC adjustment
tags.description: start_s[,end_s]: seconds before continuous end defining a window; inside it QClose auction orders are routed to the late-LOC (LLOC) venue. 0,0 disables. A 2-element value also bypasses the close-only early-return in trySmartClose.

example.explanation: Between 5 min and 1 min before continuous end, send QClose orders to the LLOC venue.

tags.name: Cleanup IOI-only order
tags.description: flag[,algo]: when an IOI-only order finds no usable IOI venues, CIOO>0 switches it to a cleanup relay algorithm (sub-tag 1 = algo, ':' turned into '^') instead of rejecting with NO_VENUE.

interactions.title: No usable IOIs: convert to cleanup algo
interactions.explanation: setSwitchToCleanupAlgo(true); setCleanupRelay sets relay CLEANUP with 1=<algo>.

interactions.title: Without CIOO, no usable IOIs rejects
interactions.explanation: rejectOrderAndNotify(NO_VENUE).

tags.name: Stop queue out-of-money
tags.description: When > 0, the stop-queue logic (STQD) applies even when the order is not in the money.

tags.name: Reject at price limit
tags.description: flag[,close_buffer_s]: reject at price limit (limit up/down). Parsed, but reject_at_price_limit accessors are not read elsewhere in the engine source.

tags.name: Queue min duration
tags.description: Per-layer minimum time (ms) a queue post must stay on market before it is considered for repricing/cancel (index = post layer).

interactions.title: China default QMD=0,30000,60000
interactions.explanation: Config sets QMD for China.

tags.name: Resume at price limit delay
tags.description: Minutes delay to resume after price limit; parsed but not read elsewhere in the engine source.

tags.name: At price limit mode
tags.description: 0 both sides, 1 favorable direction, 2 unfavorable direction (per comment); parsed but not read elsewhere in the engine source.

tags.name: Index tracking IA margin
tags.description: Margin passed to IndexTracker.safePrice for intraday auction (IA) orders.

tags.name: Index track apply IA limit
tags.description: Whether the index-tracker safe price (ITIAM margin) is applied as the limit for intraday auction market orders (>0) or not (<1).

tags.name: Adjust ADVIT on replace
tags.description: Parsed into _adjust_advit_on_replace but the accessor is never read in the engine source.

tags.name: Pair match end times
tags.description: For PAIR orders: when > 0 and the two legs have different end times, both legs are set to the earlier end time.

tags.name: EOD participation rate margin
tags.description: Percent margin added to the max participation rate during EOD processing: multiplier = 1 + max(0.005, EODPRM/100). Without it, max(1.005, AlgoConfig eod_part_rate_margin).

example.explanation: EOD max participation may exceed the configured max rate by 10%.

tags.name: Shadow rotate cycle
tags.description: Milliseconds for the shadow/dark rotation cycle: used as minimum rotate duration in the LC (dark) worker and as end-time offset for odd-lot work orders outside NA.

tags.name: RVWAP to MOC
tags.description: For relative-VWAP orders with a start/end offset (tag 287): if R2C>=1 and remaining volume before close * rate + MOC size covers the whole order size, the order is converted to IIS. Also allows index-tracker MOC price fallback from last/strike price when no safe price exists.

interactions.title: R2C converts RVWAP to IIS
interactions.explanation: When the MOC piece plus remaining volume participation can cover the order, algorithm is set to IIS.

tags.name: Close cleanup round lots
tags.description: Close cleanup size in round lots; accessor falls back to OEOConfig close_cleanup_rls but is not read elsewhere in the engine source.

tags.name: Close cleanup fraction
tags.description: Close cleanup fraction; accessor falls back to OEOConfig close_cleanup_fraction but is not read elsewhere in the engine source.

tags.name: Prefer imbalance-weighted vclose
tags.description: Flag preferring imbalance-weighted close volume; accessor has AlgoConfig fallback but no reader outside Parameters was found. Set by Japan config rules together with PIWEVC.

interactions.title: JP rules set PIWVC/PIWEVC
interactions.explanation: L484 sets PIWVC=1^PIWEVC=1 for JP doClose orders started after close start; L490 sets OPEMOC=1^PIWVC=0^PIWEVC=0 for JP VWAP.

tags.name: Prefer imbalance-weighted evclose
tags.description: When < 1, the tag-312 mode 3 short-sell close logic waits for the imbalance map (subject to MOCWIB) and uses imbalance info; when >= 1 that branch is skipped and the expected close volume is used.

interactions.title: Set by JP rules
interactions.explanation: See ai.fixmsg.properties:484/490.

tags.name: No-dark post work size
tags.description: When > 0 and the order has no dark (no_dark, no LC worker, or zero dark venues), the post size is the full work size (capped by maxPostLimit).

tags.name: Max allowed open shares market order multiplier
tags.description: For mustComplete orders: multiplier of max(minfinish, 15-second average volume) defining how many open shares may still be completed with a market order; if open shares exceed it before the buffer, mustComplete finishing is triggered.

interactions.title: MAMM only for mustComplete
interactions.explanation: Used only when param.mustComplete() (tag 23).

tags.name: Enforce work order price vs avg price
tags.description: When > 0, day work orders priced better than the order's average fill price are closed (CLOSE_INVALID): child prices must be worse than avgprice (special CLOSEB logic).

interactions.title: CLOSEB rule sets EWPVA=1 and NTBCE=60,16
interactions.explanation: Config converts 88=CLOSEB to ALGO=CLOSEB with RNT=0^232=0^76=0^EWPVA=1^NTBCE=60,16.

tags.name: No take before continuous end
tags.description: seconds[,spread_bps]: within the last N seconds before continuous end, do not take when the quoted spread exceeds spread_bps.

example.explanation: In the last 60 s, no take if spread > 16 bps.

interactions.title: Set by CLOSEB rule
interactions.explanation: See ai.fixmsg.properties:416.

tags.name: Block decreasing candidates
tags.description: When > 0, a normal regulator candidate that is 'decreasing' relative to the previous candidate is dropped.

interactions.title: Config defaults BDC=1 for PCAP and China VWAP/TMX
interactions.explanation: Config defaults BDC=1 for PCAP and China VWAP/TMX (config default).

tags.name: Post quote size dynamic
tags.description: mode[,max[,min]]: mode 1 scales the post quote-size factor (PQS, tag 1546) by sqrt(avg quote size / current quote size), clamped to [min, max].

interactions.title: PQSD requires PQS
interactions.explanation: Only applies when post_quotesize_factor > 0.

interactions.title: India default PQSD=1,10,1
interactions.explanation: India default PQSD=1,10,1 (config default).

tags.name: Dark passive mode
tags.description: 1 = special dark passive state handling when dark passive (tag 215) is 3, 4 or 5 (midpoint pegged vs passive pegged considered separately).

interactions.title: DPASM only with 215=3..5
interactions.explanation: dpasm() requires darkPassive between 3 and 5.

tags.name: Wrap odd lot
tags.description: When > 0, a child order is enlarged to include remaining shares if what would be left is below the min order size / round lot (avoids leaving an odd lot).

interactions.title: China defaults WOL=1 (STAR board, sells)
interactions.explanation: China defaults WOL=1 (STAR board, sells) (config default).

tags.name: Initial take skip min size
tags.description: When on, the first take (no fills yet) ignores the preferred/venue minimum size. Default: on if aggression > OEOConfig initial_take_skip_minsize_aggression.

tags.name: MOO wait imbalance buffer
tags.description: Milliseconds after order creation during which smart-open waits for imbalance data if none has arrived yet (handles data-feed subscription delay).

tags.name: DMA odd lot
tags.description: When > 0 for DMA/DLP strategies, if the leftover is less than a round lot the allocation minimum sizes are reset to allow sending the odd lot.

interactions.title: China sells default DMAO=1
interactions.explanation: China sells default DMAO=1 (config default).

tags.name: Enforce auction passive price limit
tags.description: Accessor with OEOConfig fallback; not read elsewhere in the engine source.

tags.name: MOC wait imbalance buffer
tags.description: Milliseconds after order creation during which close logic (tryClose, QMOC, would-close, tag-312 mode 3) waits for the imbalance map if empty.

tags.name: Print full volume profile
tags.description: 1 = log the full volume profile on profile update.

tags.name: Algo sweep low threshold
tags.description: Parsed (default 0.2) but accessor not read elsewhere in the engine source.

tags.name: Algo sweep high threshold
tags.description: Parsed but accessor not read elsewhere in the engine source.

tags.name: DMA post price level
tags.description: Price level (relative to the quote, via Statics.priceAtLevel) at which DMA/NDMA/DLP strategies post and chase; enables price chasing even for limit orders. Values > -10000 are active.

interactions.title: HK short-sell DMA default DMAPPL=-1
interactions.explanation: HK short-sell DMA default DMAPPL=-1 (config default).

tags.name: Randomize post size factor
tags.description: Sigma for randomizing post sizes (capped by queue/under-post config); 0 disables. Default uses AlgoConfig alloc_randomize_factor.

interactions.title: MAYBANK default RPSF=0
interactions.explanation: MAYBANK default RPSF=0 (config default).

tags.name: Prefer aggressive ping over take
tags.description: When on, take aggression is replaced by AGGR_PING (IOC ping) and DMA take allocations use AGGR_PING venues.

tags.name: Check price book atime
tags.description: Parsed but accessor not read in the engine source.

tags.name: Prefer sweep-post would
tags.description: When > 0, would executions use the 'smartpost' execution customizer exchanges if available.

tags.name: Post reserve expected fill rate
tags.description: Fraction: reserves shares from posting so take has shares: reserved = mustMake - excluded - post*rate; post at least hard size.

tags.name: Hold post for take
tags.description: 1 = do not post passively while the take worker is in take-play-take mode.

tags.name: No kickout
tags.description: When > 0 the kickout text set by sub-tag 1525 (KO) is suppressed: Parameters.kickout() returns null, so the KO kickout is ignored for this order.

example.explanation: Ignore any 1525/KO kickout string on this order.

interactions.title: NOKO disables KO kickout
interactions.explanation: With NOKO > 0, kickout() returns null, so any kickout configured via 1525 (KO) has no effect.

tags.name: Venue quality choice 3
tags.description: Up to three comma-separated floats that override the config venue_quality_choice_3 array (default "0.67 0.2 0.06"). The override is only used if the first value is >= 0. No reader of this value was found in the engine source outside its own accessor, so setting it appears to have no effect.

example.explanation: Replace the three venue-quality weights for this order.

tags.name: Venue allocation mode
tags.description: Turns on max/min ratio balancing of dark (liquidity-seeking) venue allocations. When > 0, LCWorker caps the sizes it sends across venues that have net leaves so the largest/smallest allocation ratio does not exceed the VAMR ratio.

example.explanation: Balance dark venue allocations using VAMR (default ratio 2).

interactions.title: VAM needs VAMR ratio > 1
interactions.explanation: LCWorker applies the balancing only when venue_allocation_maxmin_ratio (VAMR, sub-tag 1770; default 2) is > 1 and at least one venue has net leaves.

tags.name: Venue allocation category FRF
tags.description: String of venue-category/ratio pairs (config default "PMID 0.5") meant to scale allocations for venues whose name contains the category. The per-order parser splits on the regex "\s+:," (whitespace followed by the literal ":,"), so normal values like "PMID 0.5" are not split and no ratio is stored; the accessor venue_allocation_category_frf(String) also has no callers in the source, so the tag appears to have no effect.

example.explanation: Intended: halve allocations to venues whose name contains PMID.

tags.name: Venue allocation max/min ratio
tags.description: Parameters for VAM balancing: the max/min ratio between venue allocations, an exponent that caps the ratio at numVenuesWithLeaves^exp, and a size-scale exponent. Only the first two are read (LCWorker); the size-scale exponent has no reader.

example.explanation: Allow up to 3x between largest and smallest venue allocation, but at most sqrt(number of venues with leaves).

interactions.title: VAMR only used when VAM > 0
interactions.explanation: The ratio is applied only if venue_allocation_mode (VAM, 1768) > 0 (from tag or config).

tags.name: Allow MOC after auction end
tags.description: When >= 1 the engine may still create/send MOC orders after the closing-auction deadline: createMOCOrder skips its 'exceeded closing auction deadline' stop and AuctionWorker does not switch on its after-cutoff state. Unset (-1) or 0 keeps the normal cutoff.

example.explanation: Keep sending closing-auction orders past the usual deadline.

interactions.title: Rule sets AMAA=1 for TT odd-lot orders
interactions.explanation: ai.fixmsg.properties sets 328=1^245=2^AMAA=1^SCM=0^MSP=0,0,0,0,0^MVAL=1 for exchangeCode=TT with orderTag=ODDONLY, so these orders may send MOC after the auction deadline.

tags.name: Prefer imbalance-weighted vopen
tags.description: Flag meant to prefer an imbalance-weighted opening volume estimate (falls back to config prefer_imbalance_weighted_vopen). No reader of this value was found in the engine source outside its own accessor, so setting it appears to have no effect.

example.explanation: Set together with PIWEVO by the JP pre-open rule.

interactions.title: JP rule sets PIWVO=1 but it has no reader
interactions.explanation: ai.fixmsg.properties sets PIWVO=1^PIWEVO=1 for JP pre-open doOpen orders (non VWAP/TMX); only PIWEVO is read by the engine.

tags.name: Prefer imbalance-weighted evopen
tags.description: When > 0 and open_pwp_prediction_mode > 1, the opening-auction strategy uses the profile/imbalance-weighted theoretical open volume (getProfTheov(1)) as the base volume for its MOO participation instead of the plain estimate.

example.explanation: Base the MOO size on imbalance-weighted expected open volume.

interactions.title: PIWEVO needs open_pwp_prediction_mode > 1
interactions.explanation: The flag is only checked when open_pwp_prediction_mode() > 1.

interactions.title: JP pre-open rule sets PIWEVO=1
interactions.explanation: ai.fixmsg.properties sets PIWVO=1^PIWEVO=1 for JP orders before the open with doOpen>0 (algorithm not VWAP/TMX, algoEnv not APIL/APIM).

tags.name: Post price from bench
tags.description: Sets the price of passive (post) child orders relative to a quote benchmark: when bench > 0 PostWorker prices the post order with priceAtBench. Fields: bench (1 near, 2 mid, 3 far touch; <=0 off), bps offset, offset in units of historical spread (default -1e5 = unused), mode (0 = use the smaller of the bps and spread offsets, 1 = the larger), cap. The price is computed by Statics.priceAtBench (library code not in the source tree), so the exact sign/cap semantics are inferred from field comments.

example.explanation: Post at mid +/- 5 bps.

tags.name: Dark price from bench
tags.description: Sets the limit of dark (liquidity-seeking) orders and of custom candidates routed to venue 'dark' relative to a quote benchmark via priceAtBench. Fields: bench (1 near, 2 mid, 3 far touch; <=0 off), bps offset, offset in units of historical spread (default -1e5 = unused), mode (0 = use the smaller of the bps and spread offsets, 1 = the larger), cap. The price is computed by Statics.priceAtBench (library code not in the source tree), so the exact sign/cap semantics are inferred from field comments.

example.explanation: Price dark orders at the mid.

interactions.title: WPFB beats DPFB for would custom candidates
interactions.explanation: In CustomWorker the would-price bench (WPFB, 1845) is checked first for would candidates; DPFB is only used in the else-branch for venue 'dark'.

tags.name: Day endstamp rollback
tags.description: Milliseconds by which DAY child orders end before the parent's raw end time: the child endstamp is min(endstamp, parentEnd - DERB), but never earlier than now + DERB.

example.explanation: Child DAY orders expire 5 s before the parent end time.

tags.name: Post all
tags.description: When = 1 the engine posts all remaining shares: the minimum workable size and the guideline post size become size - makes, and the post quote-size limit (PQS) is lifted.

example.explanation: Show the full leaves passively.

interactions.title: POSTALL=1 makes PQS quote-size cap ineffective
interactions.explanation: With POSTALL=1 the post quote-size limit returns 1e9 before post_quotesize_factor (PQS, 1546) is evaluated, so PQS has no effect.

tags.name: Check bad price
tags.description: Bad-price guard for child orders. A child price is bad when its relative distance from the bid/ask (and from the last price) exceeds diff AND the absolute distance exceeds max(ticks x tick size, cents). Checked for market orders and limit orders not priced at the client limit; a bad price raises a BADWORKORDERPRICE alert and the child is not sent. diff <= 0 disables the check.

example.explanation: Block child orders more than 5% (and > max(5 ticks, 2 cents)) away from the quote.

tags.name: Finish odd lot dark
tags.description: Sets up an odd-lot dark worker to finish a leftover odd lot in dark pools: num (> 0 enables; number of attempts/venues passed to LCOddLotWorker) and duration. Used when leftover is below the max odd-lot size and at the FINISH life-cycle stage.
tags.default: num: config finish_oddlot_dark_num per exchange; duration: config finish_oddlot_dark_duration (Parameters.java:9235-9242)

example.explanation: Try to finish an odd-lot leftover in dark venues.

tags.name: Preemptive would-dark check
tags.description: When > 0 (and would-dark percentage mode is 0) the would-dark limit check also counts shares currently working in would-dark orders (leaveWouldDark), not just filled would-dark shares, so the cap is applied preemptively.

example.explanation: Count open would-dark orders against the would-dark limit.

tags.name: Reject basket when one canceled
tags.description: When > 0 and this order completes without being fully filled (makes < size), every other live order in the same portfolio/basket is rejected with BASKET_ONE_CXLED.

example.explanation: If one basket leg is cancelled unfilled, cancel/reject the rest.

interactions.title: RBOC rejects the rest of the basket
interactions.explanation: When an order with RBOC>0 ends with makes < size, all other alive orders of the portfolio are rejected (BASKET_ONE_CXLED).

tags.name: Halt basket order out-of-money
tags.description: Mode and count (default count 2) apparently for halting basket orders that go out of the money; the name is the only hint. No reader of this value was found in the engine source outside its own accessor, so setting it appears to have no effect.

tags.name: IOI price from bench
tags.description: Sets the price of IOI orders relative to a quote benchmark: when bench > 0 IoIWorker prices the IOI with priceAtBench. Fields: bench (1 near, 2 mid, 3 far touch; <=0 off), bps offset, offset in units of historical spread (default -1e5 = unused), mode (0 = use the smaller of the bps and spread offsets, 1 = the larger), cap. The price is computed by Statics.priceAtBench (library code not in the source tree), so the exact sign/cap semantics are inferred from field comments.

example.explanation: Price IOIs at the mid.

tags.name: Take at client limit
tags.description: When = 1 and the order has a limit price, child orders sent to venues whose aggression includes TAKE are priced at the client limit (safe of raw price and limit) instead of the computed take price. Applies in the Concert (OEO), DMA and NDMA strategies.

allowedValues.meaning: take orders priced at client limit

example.explanation: Sweep up to the client's limit price.

interactions.title: TPCL needs a client limit price
interactions.explanation: Only applies when the order price is > 0 (limit order).

tags.name: Max limit (DAY) child order size
tags.description: Per-order override of the maximum size of a single limit (DAY) child order (shares). Caps limit-priced DAY children, the venue packer for executions and the max post order size. If unset (-1) the config value for the stock's compositeExchangeCode is used.

example.explanation: Split limit (DAY) orders into pieces of at most 5000 shares.

tags.name: Max market child order size
tags.description: Per-order override of the maximum size of a single market child order (shares). Caps market-priced children and is the fallback cap for MOO/MOC children when MAXOSO/MAXOSC are <= 0. If unset (-1) the config value for the stock's compositeExchangeCode is used.

example.explanation: Split market orders into pieces of at most 5000 shares.

tags.name: Max MOO (opening auction) child order size
tags.description: Per-order override of the maximum size of a single MOO (opening auction) child order (shares). Caps opening-auction children; larger MOO quantities are split into several orders (or partly sent as limit orders in the split-MOO path). If unset (-1) the config value for the stock's compositeExchangeCode is used.

example.explanation: Split MOO (opening auction) orders into pieces of at most 5000 shares.

tags.name: Max MOC (closing auction) child order size
tags.description: Per-order override of the maximum size of a single MOC (closing auction) child order (shares). Caps closing-auction children (chunk size); the total MOC is further limited to MMC x chunk. If unset (-1) the config value for the stock's compositeExchangeCode is used.

example.explanation: Split MOC (closing auction) orders into pieces of at most 5000 shares.

interactions.title: MCPV volume cap replaces MAXOSC
interactions.explanation: If max_moc_pctvol (MCPV, 1713) x mean close volume is >= 1 share, that value is used as the MOC slice cap instead of MAXOSC.

tags.name: Max IOI child order size
tags.description: Per-order override of the maximum size of a single IOI child order (shares). Caps children sent to IOI venues and the IOI venue packer. If unset (-1) the config value for the stock's compositeExchangeCode is used.
tags.default: config max_ioi_order_size per exchange, default 0 (= no cap) (AlgoConfig.java:1751)

example.explanation: Split IOI orders into pieces of at most 5000 shares.

tags.name: Max block child order size
tags.description: Per-order override of the maximum size of a single block child order (shares). Caps children sent to block venues. If unset (-1) the config value for the stock's compositeExchangeCode is used.

example.explanation: Split block orders into pieces of at most 5000 shares.

tags.name: Custom obey spread threshold (325)
tags.description: Makes custom and would-dark candidates obey the take-spread threshold of sub-tag 325. Value > 0: a custom 'take' candidate is blocked when the spread is not within the large-spread threshold and 325 mode < 30. Value > 1: would-dark orders are also blocked when 10 <= 325 mode < 30 and the spread is outside the threshold.

example.explanation: Block custom takes and would-dark when the spread is wide.

interactions.title: M325 depends on take_spread_mode0 (325)
interactions.explanation: The block only happens when take_spread_mode0 (325) < 30 (and >= 10 for would-dark).

tags.name: No smart-open relay
tags.description: When > 0 the engine skips setting up the smart-open relay (setSmartOpenRelay returns early).

example.explanation: Do not relay the order into the smart open algorithm.

interactions.title: NRLMOO=1 rule also sets NRSMOO=1
interactions.explanation: ai.fixmsg.properties writes 206=3^NRSMOO=1^LOOO=1 whenever NRLMOO (1830) = 1, so the smart-open relay is disabled.

tags.name: Would start delay
tags.description: Delay after the order start before any would / would-dark activity: until the delay has elapsed, would and would-dark custom candidates are ignored and would-type child orders are closed (CLOSE_WOULD_DELAY). Value is a number with optional unit suffix s, m or h; no suffix means seconds.

example.explanation: No would orders for the first 5 minutes.

tags.name: Retry over throttle
tags.description: Behaviour when a venue's send throttle is exceeded. < 1: the child order is blocked/closed (CLOSE_OVER_THROTTLE). > 0: the child order is still created but transmission waits (NOT_YET) until the throttle clears.

example.explanation: Queue child orders while a venue is throttled instead of dropping them.

tags.name: Always allow auction market out
tags.description: When true, a non-DAY (auction) child of a market order (no client limit) whose final price could not be computed is sent as a MARKET order instead of being rejected for bad final price.

example.explanation: Send auction pieces at market when no price is available.

tags.name: Volume profile halt level
tags.description: Override of config volume_profile_halt_level. No reader of this value was found in the engine source outside its own accessor, so setting it appears to have no effect.

tags.name: OPE amend EOD
tags.description: When = 1 (North-America region only) the engine amends existing close/EOD pieces near the end of continuous trading: applies to doClose orders (or close_trigger_value 3) inside 0.8 x eod_venue_buffer_max before the close, once per order, not for cash, index-tracking, IIS, auction or compound algos.

tags.name: Volume profile adjust close leave
tags.description: When > 0 (and adjust_vauc_leavefill bit 1 set, doClose order) the volume profile's close fraction is set from the shares already working on close (leaveAndOnClose + OPE MOC leave) / order size even before the pre-close end.

tags.name: PEG max-part block churn
tags.description: When > 0, for PEG-type algorithms the peg candidates are not adjusted by the max-participation regulation (avoids churn of peg orders).

algorithmDependent.behavior: only used when algotype isPeg and candidate isPeg

tags.name: Trade-at-last mode
tags.description: When > 0 and the residual is sent after the close (send_residual_after_close, 312 > 0) on a market with a trade-after-close session, the residual goes to the TAL (trade-at-last) venue instead of the CLOSE venue.

interactions.title: TALM needs send_residual_after_close (312)
interactions.explanation: TAL routing only happens when 312 > 0, the stock has a close price and the market has trade-after-close.

interactions.title: TAL mode bypasses WDCM=2 dark close
interactions.explanation: When TAL mode is on, would_dark_close_mode=2 (WDCM, 1832) does not switch the venue to DARKCLOSE.

tags.name: Apply scheduler day limit
tags.description: When > 0 a 'daylimit' value delivered by the external scheduler target is applied as the order's scheduled day limit price (orderInfo.setSchedDayLimit).

tags.name: PQS at least round lot
tags.description: Modifier for PQS: when > 0 and the post size computed from the quote-size factor is below one round lot, the post size is raised to one round lot.

interactions.title: PQSRL modifies PQS (1546)
interactions.explanation: Only affects the quote-size based post limit driven by post_quotesize_factor (1546).

tags.name: Custom take uses post backup
tags.description: When > 0 and a custom 'take' candidate finds no take venues, the engine uses the 'post' venues instead.

interactions.title: Rule sets CTPB=1 for HK PAIR short sells
interactions.explanation: ai.fixmsg.properties sets CTPB=1 for HK PAIR sellshort orders (algoEnv APIH).

tags.name: Queue ADV factor
tags.description: Factor x average quote size added to the passive max/min participation volume when sizing passive orders (lets passive queue size exceed the strict participation bound). 0 disables.

interactions.title: Rule sets QADVF=0.5 for PART/LINE
interactions.explanation: ai.fixmsg.properties sets QADVF=0.5 for PART and LINE (algoEnv not APIL/APIM).

tags.name: Queue reduce must-make
tags.description: When > 0 and the strategy can take, workable (queued) shares are reduced by factor x the schedule's must-make delta 10 s ahead.

tags.name: Queue reduce min-part
tags.description: When > 0 and the strategy can take, workable shares are reduced using the min/max participation levels (minPartLevel, minLitPartLevel, maxPartLevel default 100).

tags.name: Pair replace mode
tags.description: Pair order replace mode (name only). No reader of this value was found in the engine source outside its own accessor, so setting it appears to have no effect.

tags.name: QCLS is close
tags.description: Treats quasi-close (QClo) child orders like closing-auction orders for cancellation: when set they cannot be cancelled once inside the close restrictions. Defaults to 1 when purestream_eod_mode (393) > 0 and QCIC is not set.

interactions.title: 393 implies QCIC=1
interactions.explanation: If purestream_eod_mode (393) > 0 and QCIC is not given, qcls_is_close() returns 1.

tags.name: Workable extra hardsize factor
tags.description: Intended to add extra workable shares; the only reader (totalWorkableShares) has an empty if-block, so the value has no effect.

interactions.title: EXTHF rule has no effect
interactions.explanation: ai.fixmsg.properties sets EXTHF=1 when prorate_mode>0, but the engine's reader is an empty block.

tags.name: MOC submission no wait
tags.description: When true, MOC orders are submitted at the start of the pre-close period instead of later. Defaults to true for DLP orders and for algorithms listed in config moc_submission_no_wait_algos.
tags.default: true if isFromDLP or algo in moc_submission_no_wait_algos, else false (Parameters.java:9560-9565)

tags.name: Aggressive limit n ticks
tags.description: Override of config aggr_limit_ntick (per exchange). No reader of this value was found in the engine source outside its own accessor, so setting it appears to have no effect.

interactions.title: HK short-sell rule sets ANTICK=0
interactions.explanation: ai.fixmsg.properties sets ANTICK=0 for HK short sells (non-ETF, 155 not HKEX/SG); no engine reader was found.

tags.name: Open no-history fallback
tags.description: Controls the smart-open base-volume fallback. When < 1 and there is no base volume or matched MOO, the opening strategy falls back to the default smart-open base volume (from historical theov). Setting 1 disables that fallback.

interactions.title: Rule sets ONHFB=1 for PART/LINE
interactions.explanation: ai.fixmsg.properties sets ONHFB=1 for PART and LINE orders.

tags.name: OPE handles auction VWAP tilt
tags.description: When > 0 and vwap_tilt_factor (396) is non-zero, the OPE strategy sizes the auctions for the VWAP tilt and handles both the open and the close auction itself (doOpenOpe and doCloseOpe return 1).

interactions.title: OHAVT needs vwap_tilt_factor (396)
interactions.explanation: ope_handles_auction_vwap_tilt() returns 0 when vwap_tilt_factor is 0.

interactions.title: OHAVT moves auctions to OPE
interactions.explanation: With OHAVT>0 (and 396 set) doOpenOpe/doCloseOpe default to 1, so the scheduler no longer handles open/close auctions.

tags.name: CSLE aggression
tags.description: Aggression for the close-scheduler leftover estimate; it is only passed to the order info map as cal_left_aggr when CSLE (1718) > 0. Its downstream meaning is not visible in this source.

interactions.title: CSLEA needs CSLE (1718)
interactions.explanation: Only published when close_scheduler_leftover_est (1718) > 0.

tags.name: Strike skip odd lot
tags.description: When > 0, trades smaller than a round lot are not used to set the order's strike (arrival) price.

tags.name: Prioritize custom MOC
tags.description: When = 1 and a custom MOC candidate needs more shares than are available, the candidate is held and the OEO strategy reduces other working orders to free the shares.

tags.name: CSLE extra slices
tags.description: Extra close-scheduler-leftover (CSLE) MOC slices: mode (>= 1 enables extra slices), buffer ms before pre-close end at which the final slice is sent and no further clips follow, ratio (extra leftover below ratio x already-sent CSLE shares is postponed to the final slice). With mode < 1, a CSLE MOC smaller than roundlot x CSLE minimum is not sent.

interactions.title: CSLEE needs CSLE (1718)
interactions.explanation: Extra slices extend the close-scheduler leftover estimate of 1718.

tags.name: TMX open max fraction
tags.description: Override of config tmx_open_max_fraction (default 0.1). No reader of this value was found in the engine source outside its own accessor, so setting it appears to have no effect.

tags.name: TMX close max fraction
tags.description: Override of config tmx_close_max_fraction (default 0.1). No reader of this value was found in the engine source outside its own accessor, so setting it appears to have no effect.

interactions.title: TMX rule sets TCMF=1.0 with no reader
interactions.explanation: ai.fixmsg.properties sets TCMF=1.0 for TMX orders starting near the close, but no engine code reads it.

tags.name: DMA close iceberg mode
tags.description: For DMA orders with iceberg size (73) > 0, controls the MOC: mode 1 sends one MOC of iceberg_size x mult (capped by available shares; not resent if already on close); mode 2 sends all available shares on close.

interactions.title: DCIM needs DMA + iceberg (73)
interactions.explanation: Only applies when algo is DMA and iceberg_size (73) > 0.

tags.name: IOI honor min firm
tags.description: When > 0, IOI firm-ups honour the IOI minimum: the firm-up uses the strategy's workable shares and treats the case workable >= minfirm but available < minfirm specially (honor_minfill0).

tags.name: Prioritize DQTE over intraday
tags.description: When > 0 the DQTE (close/EOD) worker may use all available shares, instead of the size computed from VWAP room/spread/volatility.

tags.name: Prevent compound switch before open
tags.description: When = 1, the relay scheduler does not switch the order to its next (compound) algorithm while the stock has not opened.

tags.name: JS389 IOI min exec
tags.description: When = 1 and the order has an IOI minimum execution size (389), venues with a configured js389_ioi_default_minsize get special min-exec handling in the IOI worker.

interactions.title: JS389 needs IOI min exec (389)
interactions.explanation: Checked only when hasIoiMinExec() (389 IOIMF) is true.

tags.name: Opportunistic post (383) precedence/stop
tags.description: Controls the opportunistic post worker (OPE would-post, 383): stop_buffer ms (default 5000) stops opportunistic posting that close to the continuous-session end; precedence < 1 stops it when the remaining quantity is below one round lot + opportunistic size.

tags.name: CSLE thresholds
tags.description: Minimum size for a close-scheduler leftover (CSLE) MOC: threshold = max(ADV x adv% , min(shares, leftover estimate x residual%)). A CSLE MOC smaller than the threshold is not sent. All three values must be > 0 and the order must have close leaves.

interactions.title: CSLET needs all three fields
interactions.explanation: If any of adv%, shares or residual% is missing or <= 0 the threshold check is skipped.

tags.name: Max MOC chunks
tags.description: Maximum number of MOC child orders (chunks of the max MOC order size); the total MOC is capped at chunks x chunk size and an AUCTIONWARN alert is raised when the MOC is reduced.

interactions.title: AU rule sets MMC=20
interactions.explanation: ai.fixmsg.properties sets MMC=20 for AU stocks when MMC is not already set.

tags.name: Excluded SOR sweep venues
tags.description: Comma-separated venue names excluded from SOR sweeps: each is mapped to its SOR destination (config sor_order_dest) and added to the order's sweep shut-off mask.

example.explanation: Do not sweep ARCA or BATS.

tags.name: No relative limit protection (index tracking)
tags.description: When >= 1, child orders of an index-tracking order (55/T) are not repriced to the index tracker's relative safe price. The fixmsg rules also react to it.

interactions.title: NRLMOO=1 sets 206=3, NRSMOO=1, LOOO=1
interactions.explanation: ai.fixmsg.properties writes 206=3^NRSMOO=1^LOOO=1 when NRLMOO=1 (also disabling the smart-open relay).

interactions.title: NRLMOO set blocks 164=5 market-order rule
interactions.explanation: The rule setting 164=5 for orders without price only fires when NRLMOO (and LOF/LOR/LORT/RLMOO/164) are not set.

interactions.title: NRLMOO only matters with index tracking
interactions.explanation: The relative limit is only applied when an index tracker (55) that should track is present.

tags.name: Max IOI firm-up failures
tags.description: Number of firm-up failures after which an IOI venue is avoided for this order; optional second field > 0 also counts firm-ups that end without a fill as failures.

tags.name: Would dark close mode
tags.description: Routes the closing auction to dark-close venues: mode 2 sends the MOC to a DARKCLOSE venue (if any; not in TAL mode; only while the stock has no close price); mode 1 does this only for the would-MOC portion when iwould_moc_rate (369) > 0. Offset (seconds) delays the would-dark MOC until preCloseEnd - offset.

interactions.title: WDCM=1 needs iwould_moc_rate (369)
interactions.explanation: Mode 1 and the offset only act when iwould_moc_rate (369) > 0.

tags.name: Dark passive destination mode
tags.description: When > 0, dark passive orders are only sent to venues whose order destination has no live child order. Mode 1 falls back to the unfiltered list if that leaves nothing; mode 2 keeps the (possibly empty) filtered list.

allowedValues.meaning: one order per destination, fallback allowed

tags.name: Stop IOI buffer
tags.description: Seconds before the continuous-session end at which IOI activity stops (stream IOI worker etc. stopped with STOP_IOI). Stored x1000 (ms); unset uses config ioipool_zero_before_close.

tags.name: Pair dark mode control
tags.description: When > 0 together with pair_dark_mode (401), regular candidates are also regulated to keep the two pair legs balanced (prevent legging).

interactions.title: PDMC needs pair_dark_mode (401)
interactions.explanation: Only applies when pair_dark_mode (401) > 0.

tags.name: Client price limit check
tags.description: Pre-open risk check: if the client limit is more aggressive than the benchmark (last price) by more than bps, the order is rejected. reject_type 0 -> CLIMIT_TOO_AGGRESSIVE, otherwise ALIMIT_TOO_AGGRESSIVE.

interactions.title: CPLCB rejects too-aggressive client limits
interactions.explanation: Before the stock opens, a limit order whose price is more than bps through the last price is rejected (CLIMIT/ALIMIT_TOO_AGGRESSIVE).

tags.name: IIS after-close mode
tags.description: Reserves shares for after-continuous executions: mode > 0 enables; continuous_rate % of remaining volume is expected in continuous trading; the leftover is split into an EOD order of min(leftover, eod value - used as shares) sent eod_buffer ms before the continuous end, and an imbalance-cross auction order of imbc_rate % of expected close volume sent through the DQTE worker within imbc_buffer ms after the continuous end. Also makes pre-close market hours use the DQTE PCA like use_dqte.
tags.default: mode 0, rates 0, eod_buffer 2000 ms, imbc_buffer 20000 ms (Parameters.java:9875-9880)

tags.name: Pair dark legging mode
tags.description: Legging tolerance for pair dark: 0 (< 1) zeroes take candidates when both legs want to take and constrains custom-take and regular candidates to the other leg's fill ratio; 1 allows custom takes unconstrained (pair dark max-lit adjustment for two-sided takes); 2 also leaves regular candidates unconstrained.

tags.name: IMBC send backward
tags.description: Override of config imbc_send_backward (ms, default 5000). No reader of this value was found in the engine source outside its own accessor, so setting it appears to have no effect.

tags.name: RVWAP forward start time
tags.description: Forward start time for RVWAP: the order's start is moved to this time and trading is triggered when it is reached. Can also be computed and set by the engine when RVWAP pro-rate (ERPR) is on.

tags.name: Preferred min size
tags.description: Preferred minimum child size (name only). No reader of this value was found in the engine source outside its own accessor, so setting it appears to have no effect.

interactions.title: IN rule computes PMS but nothing reads it
interactions.explanation: ai.fixmsg.properties computes PMS (5% of avg quote size / order size, min 10) for IN VWAP/TMX orders with 155=SG; no engine reader was found.

tags.name: Order-specific stock min size
tags.description: Per-order minimum order size for the stock: replaces the stock's minOrderSize in odd-lot wrapping (WOL, 1750), raises the MOC estimate to at least min(OSSM, size), and stops freeing up fewer shares than OSSM. Forces an individual stock object.

interactions.title: STAR-market sell rule sets OSSM
interactions.explanation: ai.fixmsg.properties sets OSSM=floor(min(size,200)) for STAR/STGR sells on C1/CG if not set.

tags.name: Auction period block custom dark
tags.description: When > 0, custom candidates for venue 'dark' are blocked during the pre-close (closing auction) period.

tags.name: Last close auction mode
tags.description: Which time counts as the latest close for MOC cutoffs and close timers: 0 = pre-close end; 1 = trade-at-last end if the market has one, else pre-close end; 2 = trade-at-last end, else the third close time if later than pre-close end, else pre-close end.

tags.name: Would price from bench
tags.description: Sets the price of would orders (lit would posts and would custom candidates) relative to a quote benchmark via priceAtBench, capped by the system/candidate limit. Fields: bench (1 near, 2 mid, 3 far touch; <=0 off), bps offset, offset in units of historical spread (default -1e5 = unused), mode (0 = use the smaller of the bps and spread offsets, 1 = the larger), cap. The price is computed by Statics.priceAtBench (library code not in the source tree), so the exact sign/cap semantics are inferred from field comments.

interactions.title: WPFB beats DPFB for would candidates
interactions.explanation: CustomWorker checks WPFB first; for would candidates the dark price bench (DPFB, 1775) is not used.

tags.name: Open at least one round lot
tags.description: When > 0 and the adjusted MOO estimate is below one round lot, the MOO is upsized to one round lot.

tags.name: Include same-side imbalance
tags.description: For the opening base-volume estimate (case 32): > 0 uses theov + 0.5 x same-side imbalance; > 1 also keeps the highest value seen.

tags.name: Signalled extra MOO rate
tags.description: Extra MOO participation (percent) driven by the last-minute opening imbalance (within 30 s of the open): no change on same-side imbalance, + SEMR% when opposite imbalance > 5% of theov, otherwise + SEMR/2 %.

tags.name: Profile halt mode
tags.description: Halt mode stored into the volume-profile parameters ('HM') when sub-tag 77 has more than one field. Because 77 reads profile_halt_mode() while parsing, PHM only takes effect if parsed before 77; otherwise config profile_halt_mode is used.

interactions.title: PHM only used through 77
interactions.explanation: The value is only read when building 77's profile parameters.

tags.name: Imbalance MOC price source
tags.description: Price of imbalance MOC orders: source 0 = touch (bid for buy, ask for sell; labelled far touch), 1 = client limit, 2 = imbalance theoretical price, 3 = indicative far price; for sources other than 1 an offset of offset x 1e-4 x spread x mid is added (buy) / subtracted (sell).

tags.name: Dual stock open mode
tags.description: When > 0 and the dual-listed counterpart has an opening strike, the stock is treated as opened with that strike.

tags.name: Stream IOI
tags.description: Stream IOI (IOI venue type 3) settings: mode > 0 enables a stream IOI worker; minrate/maxrate are set on stream IOIs; fraction > 0 sizes the stream IOI as fraction x available shares.

tags.name: Stream IOI price from bench
tags.description: Sets the price of stream IOIs relative to a quote benchmark via priceAtBench. Fields: bench (1 near, 2 mid, 3 far touch; <=0 off), bps offset, offset in units of historical spread (default -1e5 = unused), mode (0 = use the smaller of the bps and spread offsets, 1 = the larger), cap. The price is computed by Statics.priceAtBench (library code not in the source tree), so the exact sign/cap semantics are inferred from field comments.

interactions.title: SIPFB needs stream IOI (SIOI)
interactions.explanation: Only stream IOIs (SIOI, 1853) are priced with this bench.

tags.name: Cash cleanup reject
tags.description: mode, dollar and seconds (default 30) apparently for rejecting cash cleanup orders; the name is the only hint. No reader of this value was found in the engine source outside its own accessor, so setting it appears to have no effect.

tags.name: LULD close max
tags.description: When mode > 0, closing-auction child orders are capped when the stock is at its price limit (LULD): max size = min(shares, value / last price, pct % of expected close volume) minus shares already on close; the close price is also clamped to the price-limit threshold.

tags.name: Open cancel-cutoff resize buffer
tags.description: Milliseconds before the opening cancel cutoff within which a MOO worker with more working than needed resizes instead of ignoring the reduced goal.

tags.name: Dual imbalance mode
tags.description: Dual-listed close handling: mode > 0 adds dual MOC venues, loads imbalance info and makes OPE handle the close; with dual_trade, mode 1 zeroes the OPE MOC (avoid duplicate) and mode 2 moves it to a dual MOC. rate/maxrate (percent) drive the DualCloseWorker target and max rates.

interactions.title: DIM moves close to OPE
interactions.explanation: dual_imbalance_mode > 0 makes doCloseOpe return 1 (if not explicitly set) and skips the regular MOC estimate.

tags.name: Above lit/dark close
tags.description: Mode and exactly four comma-separated rates ("mode:r1,r2,r3,r4"). Mode > 0 makes OPE handle the close and sends an 'above close' MOC POV order with close/lit/dark limit prices (lit from the 368 MOC limit, dark from the would-MOC limit) and the given rates. A value without four rates throws an error while parsing.

interactions.title: Malformed ALDC fails parsing
interactions.explanation: The parser throws RuntimeException('Tag ALDC is malformed') unless exactly 4 rates follow the colon.

interactions.title: Dual close wins over ALDC
interactions.explanation: ConcertStrategy tries the dual close first; ALDC is the else-branch.

tags.name: RVWAP dual mode
tags.description: When > 0, a dual-listed stock also gets dual MOC venues and a MOC on the dual stock is sent once from the close workers.

tags.name: MOC cutoff limit fraction
tags.description: After the market's limit-only pre-close time, closing child orders are priced at last price +/- fraction x last (buy +), capped by the strict client limit and tick-adjusted, so market-on-close becomes limit-on-close.

example.explanation: LOC 2% through the last price after the limit-only cutoff.

tags.name: Maximize completion mode
tags.description: When >= 1 (and the order is not must-complete), the max-participation size extension (deltamax) in the candidate regulator is not computed.

tags.name: Index tracker close only
tags.description: With an index tracker (55/T), applies the tracker only to closing orders: tracker built close-only, intraday tracking skipped, MOC prices checked with the tracker, and an otherwise invalid tracker is accepted instead of rejected.

interactions.title: ITCO avoids 'incorrect index tracker' reject
interactions.explanation: Without ITCO a tracker that should not track sets _err_msg='incorrect index tracker' (order rejected); ITCO > 0 accepts it for close-only use.

tags.name: Work price limit bench
tags.description: Caps the price of working child orders (DAY orders, custom, DMA/NDMA, IOI, dark, peg workers) at a quote-benchmark price via priceAtBench (the order's price becomes the safer of its price and the cap). NDMAStrategy passes the arguments in a different order than the other callers (possible bug). Fields: bench (1 near, 2 mid, 3 far touch; <=0 off), bps offset, offset in units of historical spread (default -1e5 = unused), mode (0 = use the smaller of the bps and spread offsets, 1 = the larger), cap. The price is computed by Statics.priceAtBench (library code not in the source tree), so the exact sign/cap semantics are inferred from field comments.

tags.name: China A abnormal trading rule check
tags.description: China A-share abnormal-trading-rule size limits. check >= 1 constrains candidate hard size, >= 2 also max size, >= 3 also every non-auction child before sending (CH/C1/C2 stocks). warn_reject >= 1 raises alerts; >= 2 rejects the order (ABNORMAL_TRADING_RULE_VIOLATION) when the allowed size is 0; >= 3 rejects whenever a child is constrained in the send path.

interactions.title: EARC can reject the order
interactions.explanation: With warn_reject >= 2 the order is rejected (ABNORMAL_TRADING_RULE_VIOLATION) when the abnormal-rule max size is 0 (>= 3: whenever constrained before sending).

interactions.title: EARC reset to 0,0 outside China
interactions.explanation: ai.fixmsg.properties overwrites EARC with 0,0 for non-China (not C1/C2/CH) orders.

tags.name: Prevent endtime reset (doClose)
tags.description: When > 0, the engine does not reset the end time of doClose orders (reset_close_endstamp logic).

interactions.title: Rules set PERD from OCTC
interactions.explanation: ai.fixmsg.properties sets PERD=1 when OCTC=1 (or 2) and EC (1505) != 1. OCTC has no parser in Parameters.java, so it is referenced by alias.

interactions.title: PERD=1 in China sets 26=5^27=1^T26DS=1
interactions.explanation: ai.fixmsg.properties writes 26=5^27=1^T26DS=1 for China (C1/C2/CH) orders with PERD=1 and 26 not set.

tags.name: Ensure min-exec round lot
tags.description: When true, a minimum execution size below one round lot is raised to one round lot.

tags.name: Always Reg SHO
tags.description: For short sells, always treat the order as Reg SHO / short-sale restricted: the uptick rule is applied to child and auction orders, the raw end time is not shortened, and the end-time reject is skipped when 302 is set. The fixmsg rules use RSHO to apply KS/MK short-sell settings.

interactions.title: RSHO short sells: uptick rule always applied
interactions.explanation: When the side is sellshort and RSHO=1 the SSR uptick rule is applied regardless of the stock's Reg SHO state.

interactions.title: KS short-sell RSHO rules
interactions.explanation: For KS short sells with RSHO=1 the rules write 327=2,0,10 and, for VWAP, SEB=0 / 302=900,1 / 112=0^MPO=5^STQD=5^26=100^27=10^SEB=0^MAXSD=0.

interactions.title: MK short-sell RSHO rules (partly unreachable)
interactions.explanation: For MK VWAP short sells with RSHO=1 the rules write SEB=0 and 302=300,1, but an earlier rule already sets 302=600^SEB=0^STQD=5 for APIH, so these never fire (conflict C-06).

tags.name: Close price LULD mode
tags.description: When mode > 0, close/quasi-close children of a buy are priced one tick below limit-up when the latest price is within threshold (fraction) of limit-up (sell: one tick above limit-down), capped by the client limit. The nticks field is parsed but not read.

tags.name: China A reject pattern
tags.description: Text pattern (> 3 chars) matched against close-order reject reasons; on a match the close reject count is incremented and the next close order is reduced in 10% steps.

tags.name: Endtime expired reject buffer
tags.description: Seconds (stored x1000 ms) after the order's end time before the end-time reject fires; replaces the computed buffer of endtime_reject_mode (112).

interactions.title: EERB sets end-time reject delay
interactions.explanation: The order is rejected once now - raw end time > EERB (endtime_reject_mode > -100, no doClose, no 312=3).

tags.name: Enable RVWAP pro-rate
tags.description: When > 0 with volume-limit pro-rate (398), RVWAP adjusts its target volume pro-rata and computes a forward start time (RFST, 1840); also stores volume_limit_moc/ordersize.

interactions.title: ERPR sets RFST
interactions.explanation: The engine computes and sets rvwap_forward_start_time (1840) from the pro-rate calculation.

tags.name: Feed lead time
tags.description: Overrides the stock's feed lead time (config feed_lead_time per exchange) when computing the strike time from the quote feed. Unit not visible in source.

tags.name: Close wait intraday cancel mode
tags.description: When the pre-close starts after the continuous end and intraday leaves remain, the strategy normally waits for the intraday cancel; CWICM >= 1 skips waiting for the first cancel.

interactions.title: Rules default CWICM=1
interactions.explanation: ai.fixmsg.properties sets CWICM=1 for 155=SG and whenever unset (algoEnv not APIL/APIM).

tags.name: MOC 368 n ticks
tags.description: Tick count for 368 MOC layers (name only). No reader of this value was found in the engine source outside its own accessor, so setting it appears to have no effect.

tags.name: KS close trigger
tags.description: KS (Korea) close handling: mode 1 blocks all non-close candidates (close only) and splits baseline MOC layers by the 25% imbalance rule; mode 2 sends no second layer. Baseline MOC layers are priced at last intraday price +/- p0 bps (layer 0) / p1 bps (layer 1); defaults 100/300 (mode 1) or 300 (mode 2).

interactions.title: KSCTRIG=1 blocks intraday trading on KS
interactions.explanation: Normal (non-close) candidates are blocked for KS stocks when KSCTRIG=1.

tags.name: MOC 368 passive layer mode
tags.description: When >= 0 with sched_moc_mode (368) = 2, the passive 368 MOC layer (venue 3681 / lmoc1) is blocked when its limit is not at least one tick passive vs the base limit.

interactions.title: MPL368 needs 368=2
interactions.explanation: Only applies when sched_moc_mode (368) == 2.

tags.name: Work order min duration
tags.description: Minimum time (ms) a child order must stay on the market before it can be cancelled; the larger of this and the venue's minDuration is used.
